qe: What is 'Viticulture' specifically famous for in the Mediterranean region?
qh: भूमध्यसागरीय क्षेत्र में 'विटीकल्चर' (Viticulture) विशेष रूप से किसके लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
e: Viticulture ka matlab hai angoor (grape) ki kheti aur usse sharaab (wine) banana. Mediterranean region mein garmi-sookhe ki lambi avadhi, samundar ki nami wali thandi sardiyan aur chikni-chuni (limestone) mitti mil kar angoor ke liye aadarsh mausam banati hai - isliye France, Itali, Spain aur Greece yahan wine ke bade utpadak hain. Apple ki kheti thande mausam mein, machhli palan jheel/talab mein aur dhaan ki kheti paani bhare khet mein hoti hai. Exam point: viticulture = grape + wine; Mediterranean climate (garam sookha garmi + baarish wali thandi) ka classic product.

qe: In which type of mining is a vertical 'Shaft' required to reach deep mineral ores?
qh: गहरे खनिज अयस्कों तक पहुँचने के लिए किस प्रकार के खनन में 'शाफ्ट' (Shaft) की आवश्यकता होती है?
e: Zameen ke gehre hisse mein pahunchne ke liye ek lambavat (vertical) shaft (surakh) banaya jaata hai, jisse hat (lift) aur ventilation ka bandobast karte hain; phir surakhon se horizontal (kshetij) gallery bana kar khanij nikalte hain. Ise underground mining kehte hain - jaise Jharia aur Raniganj ki koyla ki khaanein. Alluvial placer mining nadi ke baal (sand) mein sone jaisa bhaari khanij dhoondne ki vidhi hai, opencast/strip mining mein satah ki mitti (overburden) hata kar upari khanij nikaalte hain. Exam point: shaft = vertical surakh = underground mining ka pehla kadam.

qe: Which type of agriculture is highly developed in the Mediterranean region due to its winter rainfall regime?
qh: सर्दियों की वर्षा के कारण भूमध्यसागरीय क्षेत्र में किस प्रकार की कृषि अत्यधिक विकसित है?
e: Mediterranean jalvaayu mein garmiyan garam aur sookhi hoti hain, lekin sardi mein paschimi hawaayein baarish laati hain. Ye mausam santre, nimbu, mausambi aur angoor jaisi citrous fasalon ke liye perfect hai, isliye ise citriculture kehte hain. Reindeer pastoralism Arctic ke thande tundra ka, wet paddy (geela dhaan) monsoon wale Asia ka, aur intensive dairy ranching thande yurop/America ka tarika hai. Exam point: Mediterranean = citriculture + viticulture + olive; iska naya naam 'hot summer Mediterranean climate' (Csa) hai.

qe: The physical detachment and transportation of weathered regolith by wind or water is termed:
qh: पवन या जल के माध्यम से अपक्षयित 'रेगोलिथ' के स्थानांतरण को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Chattaan ka tutna (weathering) sirf wahi tak hota hai jahan chattaan padi rehti hai, lekin erosion mein us toote hue regolith (dhool-mitti ka parat) ko hawa ya paani apne sthaan se utha kar doosri jagah le jaate hain. Isliye erosion = detachment + transportation + deposition, teeno ka kaam. Weathering mein sirf sthir (in-situ) tutna hota hai, lithification (patthar banna) deposition ke baad ki prakriya hai, aur carbonation ek rasayanik weathering ki kriya hai. Exam point: weathering (tutna) + erosion (dho kar le jaana) + deposition (jama hona) - teenon alag-alag kadam hain.

qe: Which geochemical acronym represents the dense basaltic oceanic crust?
qh: कौन सा संक्षिप्त नाम महासागरीय क्रस्ट का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है?
e: Prithvi ki satah ki chattaan do pramukh bhedon mein banti hai - Sial (Silica + Aluminum) jo halki granitic chattaan hai aur Sima (Silica + Magnesium) jo bhaari basaltic chattaan hai. Sima samudri tal (ocean floor) ki mukhya chattaan hai, kyunki iska ghanatva zyada hone se ye dhansi zameen par hoti hai aur samudri basin banati hai. Sial khamandali (continental) bhoomi banati hai. Nife prithvi ke core ka naam hai (Nickel + Iron), aur KREEP chandrama ki chattaan se juda ek acronym hai. Exam point: Sima = basaltic + bhaari + samudri tal; Sial = granitic + halki + mahadeep.

qe: A 'V-shaped' valley is a typical erosional landform created by which youthful geomorphic agent?
qh: 'वी-आकार' की घाटी किस युवा भू-आकृतिक कारक की अपरदनी विशेषता है?
e: V-shaped valley (V aakar ki ghati) nadi ki jawani (youth) ki nishani hai. Jahan nadi tez behti hai aur zameen unchi ho, wahan nadi dono kinaron ko kat-ti jaati hai aur niche gahra karti jaati hai; kinare ka katav (lateral erosion) lagbhag seedha hone se ghati ka profile 'V' jaisa ban jaata hai. Samundri lehrein cliff banati hain, hawa (aeolian) registan mein barchan, aur glacier 'U' aakar ki ghati banata hai. Exam point: V-shaped valley = tez bahati nadi (young river), U-shaped valley = glacier.

qe: The Mohorovičić (Moho) Discontinuity marks the boundary between which two layers?
qh: 'मोह' (Moho) असंबद्धता किन दो परतों के बीच स्थित है?
e: Moho (Mohorovicic discontinuity) wo reyna hai jahan khamandali chattaan (crust) khatam hoti hai aur neeche ka mantle (lakh km ka kambal) shuru hota hai. Yahan P-wave ki rafthaar achanak badal jaati hai kyunki chatton ka ghanatva alag hai. Iski khoj Yugoslav vaigyanik Andrija Mohorovicic ne 1909 mein ki thi. Crust aur mantle ke chhote (lower) hisse ke beech isi tarah Gutenberg discontinuity (core-mantle boundary) aur Lehmann discontinuity (inner-outer core boundary) hoti hai. Exam point: Moho = crust aur mantle ke beech; Gutenberg = mantle aur core ke beech.

qe: What geological process consolidates loose mineral sediments into coherent sedimentary rock?
qh: 'अवसादों' को ठोस 'शैल' में बदलने वाली भूवैज्ञानिक प्रक्रिया क्या कहलाती है?
e: Bhatke hue (loose) mineral gaad (sediment) ko sadiyon ke dabaav aur rasayanik jodne wale agent (cementation) se sakht patthar banana lithification kehlata hai. Iske do kadam hote hain - compaction (jhuk kar kasna) aur cementation (chuna, silica ya iron oxide ka gaad ke kanon ke beech bhar jaana). Metamorphism se chattaan garmi-dabaav se roop badalti hai, subduction se plate niche dhansata hai, weathering se chattaan toot-ti hai. Exam point: sediment (gaad) + lithification = sedimentary rock; yahi nadi-registan-khaari ki mitti se patthar banne ki vidhi hai.

qe: Which diagnostic physical property of a mineral measures its resistance to scratching?
qh: खनिज का कौन सा गुण 'खरोंच के प्रति प्रतिरोध' को मापता है?
e: Kisi khanij (mineral) par nakhun ya chaku ya kokhli se khurach banane ki khinchat (resistance) ko hardness kehte hain. Mohs scale par talc sabse mulaayam (1) aur diamond sabse sakht (10) hota hai. Lustre chamak ka naam hai, cleavage ek hi disha mein phatne ki pravritti hai, aur streak us powder ka rang hai jo khurachne par milta hai. Exam point: hardness = khurachne ki khinchat; Mohs scale: 1 talc, 2 gypsum, 3 calcite, 4 fluorite, 5 apatite, 6 feldspar, 7 quartz, 8 topaz, 9 corundum, 10 diamond.

qe: Which seismic body wave travels fastest and arrives first at a seismograph station?
qh: कौन सी भूकंपीय तरंग सिस्मोग्राफ स्टेशन पर सबसे पहले पहुँचती है?
e: Bhukamp (earthquake) ki lehrein (waves) mein Primary ya P-wave sabse tez chalti hai - matlab solid, liquid, gas sabhi mein first pahunchti hai. Isliye seismograph par sabse pehle P-wave ka nishaan record hota hai; ye ek dhakka (push-pull) wali longitudinal (lambavat) wave hai. S-wave (secondary) uske baad aati hai aur sirf solid mein chalti hai, Rayleigh aur Love waves sabse dheeme hain lekin sabse zyada nuksan karti hain. Exam point: P-wave = sabse tez (solid-liquid-gas sabhi mein), S-wave = doosri sabse tez (sirf solid mein), surface wave = sabse dheemi.

qe: What is the primary astronomical cause of differential solar heating across Earth's surface?
qh: पृथ्वी की सतह के 'विभेदी तापन' का प्राथमिक खगोलीय कारक क्या है?
o: Angle of incidence of solar rays (due to planetary curvature and axial tilt)
e: Suraj ki kiranein jab prithvi ki golai (curvature) aur jhuke hue axis ke karan alag-alag konon (angle of incidence) par padti hain, to kuchh hissa zyada garm aur kuchh kam garm hota hai - yahi differential solar heating kehlata hai. Equator ke paas kiranein seedhi padti hain isliye wahan sabse zyada garmi milti hai, aur dhruvon ke paas tirchi padti hain isliye thand rehti hai. Yahi cooling ka antar hawa ka dabaav, hawaayein aur mausam banata hai. Vayu ki dhool, chandrama ki duri ya paudhon ka albedo iska mukhya kaaran nahi hain. Exam point: kirane ka kon + prithvi ki golai = jalvaayu ka pehla adhishthan (primary cause).

qe: The geodynamic process of 'Subduction' occurs along which type of plate boundary?
qh: 'सबडक्शन' (अधोगमन) की प्रक्रिया किस प्रकार की प्लेट सीमा पर होती है?
e: Subduction ka matlab hai ek plate ka doosre ke neeche dhansana. Ye convergent ya destructive plate boundary par hota hai - jahan do plate ek doosre ke paas aa kar takrate hain, wahan bhaari samudri plate halki khamandali plate ke neeche chali jaati hai. Isi se deep trench, jwalamukhi chain aur bhukamp aate hain. Divergent boundary par plate door jaate hain (naya samudri tal banta hai), transform par wo ek doosre ko ragad-te hain. Exam point: subduction = convergent (destructive) margin; iska classic udaharan Andes aur Japan ka island arc hai.

qe: Which phase of matter completely arrests the propagation of seismic Secondary (S) waves?
qh: पदार्थ की कौन सी अवस्था भूकंपीय एस-तरंगों (S-waves) के संचरण को पूरी तरह रोक देती है?
e: S-wave (secondary ya shear wave) ek solid ke andar vibration kar sakti hai kyunki usme particles ek doosre se chipke rehte hain. Lekin liquid (taram) mein shear stress chalti nahi to S-wave ruk jaati hai. Prithvi ka bahri core (outer core) taram (molten iron-nickel) hai, isliye S-waves wahan se nahi guzar sakti - aur yahi is baat ka sabse bada pramaan hai ki bahri core liquid hai. Iske ulta P-wave taral mein bhi chalti hai (thodi dheemi hokar). Exam point: bahri core = taral (liquid) = S-wave shadow zone yahin se banta hai.

qe: In physical geography, 'Regolith' is defined as:
qh: भौतिक भूगोल में 'रेगोलिथ' (Regolith) को किस रूप में परिभाषित किया जाता है?
o: A mantle of loose, weathered rock debris and soil overlying unweathered bedrock
e: Regolith zameen ke upari hisse ka wo dheela parat hai jo chattaan ke tootte (weathering) se bana hai aur jismein mitti, pathre ke tukde aur khanij ka malba shamil hota hai. Iske neeche asliy wala aprakrut (unweathered) bedrock hota hai. Ore ki khaan, tunnel, building aur kheti sab isi regolith par nirbhar hain; chandrama par bhi regolith ka mota parat milta hai. Intrusive magma ya humus only iska hissa nahi. Exam point: regolith = loose weathered material + soil over bedrock; ise 'bhoomi ka basalt ka dheela patta' samjho.

qe: The petrological term 'Sial' designates continental rocks rich in:
qh: 'सियाल' (Sial) शब्द किन तत्वों से भरपूर महाद्वीपीय चट्टानों को संदर्भित करता है?
e: Sial naam do words se bana - Silica (SiO2) aur Aluminum (Al). Ye khamandali (continental) chattaan ka saralta (average) sanghatan hai, isliye pahadi ilaake granitic chattaan Sial kehlate hain. Iska ghanatva Sima se kam (lagbhag 2.7 g/cm3) hota hai, isi liye ye samudri chattaan par tairti hai. Silica + Magnesium ka mel Sima, aur Iron + Nickel ka mel Nife (core) hai. Calcium aur Sodium bhi ismein thoda hota hai lekin naam Aluminum se hi bana hai. Exam point: Sial = continental granitic crust; Sima = oceanic basaltic crust.

qe: Which mineral establishes the absolute benchmark hardness value of 10 on the Mohs scale?
qh: मोह स्केल पर किस खनिज का कठोरता मान मानक 10 है?
e: Mohs scale par sabse sakht (hardest) khanij Diamond hai - iski value 10 hai. Diamond asal mein carbon ke atom ka ek bahut kaske jude hue chauri (tetrahedral) jaal hai, isliye ye khurach padne par tUta nahi. Quartz 7 par, Corundum 9 par aur Topaz 8 par aata hai, isliye te sab isse pehle (mulaayam) hain. Diamond hi sirf dusre Diamond se kata ja sakta hai, aur isi karan ye drill aur cutter mein lagta hai. Exam point: Mohs scale: 1 Talc, 2 Gypsum, 3 Calcite, 4 Fluorite, 5 Apatite, 6 Feldspar, 7 Quartz, 8 Topaz, 9 Corundum, 10 Diamond.

qe: Which seismic surface wave induces horizontal transverse ground shaking perpendicular to the direction of propagation?
qh: कौन सी भूकंपीय धरातलीय तरंग प्रसार दिशा के लंबवत क्षैतिज रूप से कंपन कराती है?
e: Surface wave do prakar ki hoti hai - Rayleigh wave, jisme particles ret (roll) jaisa movement karte hain (up-down + aage-piche), aur Love wave, jisme particles ek disha ke samantar (perpendicular to propagation) horizontal hilte hain. Ye horizontal transverse hilna hi imaraton ki foundation ko todta hai; Love wave alag-alag paraton (layers) ke beech pura (trap) ho kar tez aur nuksandeh hoti hai. P-wave aur S-wave body waves hain jo zameen ke andar chalti hain. Exam point: Love wave = horizontal transverse shaking (sabse zyada nuksan); Rayleigh wave = rolling motion.

qe: The semi-fluid, ductile upper portion of the mantle, the Asthenosphere, is petrologically composed of:
qh: 'एस्थेनोस्फीयर' (दुर्बलता मंडल) मुख्य रूप से किस शैल से बनी है?
e: Asthenosphere mantle ka wo upari hissa hai jo lagbhag 100 se 350 km gehrai mein hai. Yahan dabaav itna zyada aur garmi itni zyada hoti hai ki chattaan thodi dheeli (ductile, semi-fluid) ho jaati hai, isliye ye plate ke khisakne (motion) ka aadhar hai. Iski mukhya chattaan Peridotite hai, jo olivine aur pyroxene khanijon se bani ghaas hara-bhoora patthar hai. Sandstone sedimentary, Granite aur Andesite igneous chattaan hain jo mantle mein nahi hoti. Exam point: asthenosphere = peridotite + ductile + isi par plate tair-te hain.

qe: What geochemical characteristics define 'Mafic' igneous rocks?
qh: 'मैफिक' (Mafic) आग्नेय चट्टानों की क्या विशेषताएं होती हैं?
o: Dense, dark-colored, rich in magnesium and iron, with low silica content
Lightweight, pale-colored, rich in potassium and quartz
e: Mafic naam Magnesium aur Ferric (Iron) se bana hai. Aise igneous rocks mein Magnesium aur Iron zyada tatha Silica kam hota hai; isliye ye bhaari, gehra rang wale (dark coloured) hote hain aur inka ghanatva zyada hota hai - jaise Basalt, Gabbro aur Peridotite. Inka ulta FELSIC hota hai (Feldspar + Silica), jisme Silica zyada aur rang halka hota hai - jaise Granite. Vesicular ya glassy structure mafic hone ka pramaan nahi. Exam point: Mafic = dark + iron-magnesium + low silica = basalt; Felsic = light + high silica = granite.

qe: In the geological rock cycle, how does a metamorphic rock transform into an igneous rock?
qh: शैल चक्र में कायांतरित चट्टान किस प्रक्रिया से पुनः आग्नेय चट्टान में बदलती है?
o: Complete melting into magma followed by cooling and crystallization
e: Bhoomi ki chattaan (rock cycle) ke chakra mein metamorphic rock ke igneous rock banne ke liye hi ek rasta hai - chattaan ko itna garam karna ki wo poori tarah pighal kar MAGMA ban jaaye, phir wo magma thanda hokar crystallize ho jaaye. Isi liye igneous rock ko 'primary rock' kehte hain. Sirf dabaav ya hydration se magma nahi banta - wo kaam metamorphism ya weathering ka hai, aur lithification sediment ko sedimentary banata hai. Exam point: igneous = melt-cool; sedimentary = deposit-cement; metamorphic = heat-pressure; teeno chakra mein ek doosre mein badalte rehte hain.

qe: Which diagnostic mineral property refers to the color of its finely ground powder?
qh: खनिज का कौन सा गुण उसके बारीक पिसे हुए चूर्ण के रंग को दर्शाता है?
e: Streak us rang ka naam hai jo khanij ko kisi safed unglazed tile par ragadne par banta hai (powder ka rang). Ye khanij ki pehchan ka sabse vishwasniya tareeka hai kyunki satah (surface) ka rang weathering se badal jaata hai lekin powder ka rang wahi rehta hai - jaise Hematite ka rang gehra-bhoora hota hai lekin streak laal-cherry hota hai. Lustre chamak, cleavage pathar ke phatne ki disha, aur fracture tootne ki tedhi satah batata hai. Exam point: streak = powder ka rang; khanij ki pehchan ke liye sabse pakka test.

qe: What geometric cross-sectional shape characterizes a concordant 'Laccolith' intrusion?
qh: 'लैकोलिथ' (Laccolith) अंतर्भेदी आग्नेय पिंड का ज्यामितीय आकार कैसा होता है?
e: Laccolith ek concordant (paraton ke saath chalti hui) intrusive structure hai jiska tal (floor) samtal (flat) hota hai lekin upari satah dome ya mushroom jaisi ubhari hui hoti hai - kyunki andar ka magma upar wali paraton ko uncha kar deta hai. Iska diameter kuchh kilometre tak ho sakta hai. Batholith vishaal aur discordant hota hai (paraton ko kaat kar nikla), lopolith ek tashiya (saucer) jaisa dhansa hua basin hai, aur dike ek lambavat sheet hai. Exam point: laccolith = flat floor + dome roof; lopolith = saucer shape; batholith = sabse bada discordant.

qe: Which class of geomorphic forces operates continuously to erode elevated structural relief down to a base level?
qh: धरातल के उच्चावच को घिसकर समतल करने के लिए कौन से भू-आकृतिक बल कार्य करते हैं?
e: Exogenic forces (bahri shaktiyan) wo hain jo prithvi ki satah par bahar se kaam karti hain - nadi, hawa, glacier, samundar ki lehrein aur bhumi-jal (groundwater). Inhe gradational processes bhi kehte hain kyunki ye uncha sthaan (relief) ko kat-ti hain aur gaad ko neechi jagah (base level) tak dhoti hain - matlab zameen ko barabar karne ki koshish karti hain. Endogenic (andar ki) shaktiyan jaise plate movement, orogeny aur jwalamukhi zameen ko uncha karti hain yani relief badhati hain. Exam point: endogenic = uncha karta hai (build), exogenic = kat-ti aur barabar karta hai (degrade); dono saath kaam karte hain.

qe: The true 'Geoid' shape of the Earth signifies that it is:
qh: पृथ्वी के 'जॉइड' (Geoid) आकार का सटीक भौगोलिक अर्थ क्या है?
o: Pear-shaped with identical northern and southern hemispheres
Flattened at the poles and bulged at the equator
e: Prithvi ka asli aakaar perfect gol nahi balki 'geoid' hai - matlab dhruvon (poles) par thoda chapta (flattened) aur equator par thoda ubha (bulging). Iski wajah ye hai ki prithvi apne axis par ghoomti hai, aur ghoomne se utpann apakendriya bal (centrifugal force) equator par sabse zyada hota hai, jo wahan ki satah ko bahar khinchte hai. Isliye equatorial radius (6378 km) polar radius (6357 km) se lagbhag 21 km bada hai. Ye aakaar hydrostatic equilibrium ka nateeja hai. Exam point: geoid = poles par chapta, equator par ubha; isi karan geoid = 'earth-shaped' ya oblate spheroid.

qe: Which seismic waves propagate with the slowest velocity while inflicting the greatest structural damage?
qh: कौन सी भूकंपीय तरंगें सबसे धीमी गति से चलती हैं लेकिन धरातल पर सर्वाधिक विनाश करती हैं?
e: Rayleigh aur Love waves surface waves hain; inki rafthar body waves (P aur S) se kam hoti hai lekin amplitude (hilne ki matra) sabse zyada hoti hai, isliye ye imaraton ke liye sabse khatarnak hoti hain. Rayleigh wave mein particles ret (elliptical) jaisa movement karte hain aur zameen upar-neeche tatha aage-piche hilti hai; Love wave mein horizontal transverse shaking hota hai. Ye waves surface ke saath hi chal pati hain, gehre tak nahi jaati, isliye energy ek patli satah mein jam ho kar nuksan badha deti hai. Exam point: slowest + most destructive = surface waves (Rayleigh + Love).

qe: Which mineral establishes the baseline hardness value of 1 on the Mohs scale?
qh: मोह पैमाने पर न्यूनतम कठोरता स्तर 1 किस खनिज का होता है?
e: Talc sabse mulaayam (softest) khanij hai, isliye Mohs scale par iski hardness 1 hai - ise nakhun se aasani se khurach sakte hain. Ye Magnesium silicate hydrate hota hai aur soapstone (chrrm pathar) ka mukhya hissa hai, isliye iska istemal talcum powder, soap aur ceramic mein hota hai. Gypsum 2 par, Calcite 3 par aur Fluorite 4 par aata hai, matlab ye sab talc se sakht hain. Exam point: Mohs scale ka mulaayam sira Talc (1), sakht sira Diamond (10); 2 Gypsum, 3 Calcite.

qe: Which geological eon marked the sustained rise of atmospheric oxygen to modern levels?
qh: किस भूवैज्ञानिक युग (Eon) में वायुमंडलीय ऑक्सीजन आधुनिक स्तरों तक पहुँची?
e: Oxygen ka sthayi (sustained) badhna aur aaj ke star (modern level) tak pahunchna 'Phanerozoic' eon mein hua - ye kalpana 541 million saal pehle shuru hua aur aaj tak chalta hai. Ismein Palaeozoic, Mesozoic aur Cenozoic eras aate hain, jab samudri aur bhoomi dono par jeevan ki bahut vividh (diverse) roop bane. Pehle ka Proterozoic mein 'Great Oxidation Event' se kuchh oxygen bana, lekin uski matra aaj se bahut kam thi. Archean aur Hadean mein oxygen lagbhag shunya tha. Exam point: Phanerozoic = 'visible life' ka kal, jismein aaj ki oxygen-rich vayu ka vikas hua.

qe: Which atmospheric constituent acts as the primary thermodynamic 'engine' driving weather disturbances and latent heat transfer?
qh: वायुमंडल में कौन सा घटक मौसम परिवर्तन और गुप्त ऊष्मा स्थानांतरण के 'इंजन' के रूप में कार्य करता है?
e: Jallvaashp (water vapour) ko vayu ka 'regulator' kehte hain. Baadal banne par ye badal ki boond mein badalta hai (sanghanan) aur us samay chhupi hui garmi (latent heat) chhodta hai, jisse hawa garam hokar upar uthti hai aur dabaav aur girav (gradient) badhta hai - isi se garm hawa chakkar (cyclone), monsoon aur thandaf (thunderstorm) jaise saare mausam ke toofan chalte hain. Ozone UV sokhta hai, Argon nishkriya hai aur Nitrogen mausam mein bhaag nahi leta. Exam point: water vapour = mausam ka engine + sabse mukhya greenhouse gas bhi.

qe: What technological innovation during the Industrial Revolution expanded deep-crust mineral extraction?
qh: औद्योगिक क्रांति के दौरान किस तकनीकी विकास ने खनिज निष्कर्षण को व्यापक रूप से बदल दिया?
o: Steam-powered pumping, mechanized ventilation, and dynamite blasting for deep shaft mining
e: Industrial Revolution se pehle khaanein sirf utni gehri ho paati thi jitni mein hawa pahunch sake; 18-19vima shatabdi mein steam engine se paani pump karna, mechanized ventilation aur dinamite se blasting shuru hui, jisse log 1000 feet se zyada gehri shaft bana kar gehre ore tak pahunchne lage. Isse koyla, loha, tamra aur zinc ka utpadan tez badha aur factory system ko dhakal mili. Rail logistics band hone ya wooden pickaxes par nirbhar rehne ka is vikas se koi sambandh nahi. Exam point: deep mining = steam pump + ventilation + dynamite (Industrial Revolution ke teen hathiyar).

qe: What defines 'Shaft Mining' (Underground mining)?
qh: 'कूपकी खनन' (Shaft Mining) का क्या अर्थ है?
o: Sinking vertical shafts and driving horizontal galleries underground to reach deep ore bodies
e: Shaft mining (underground mining) mein zameen par ek lambavat (vertical) surakh (shaft) khoda jaata hai aur usmein lift ya hat lagta hai; uske baad khanij ki parat tak pahunchne ke liye horizonntal tunnels (galleries/drifts) bante hain. Ye tareeka tab lagta hai jab khanij ki parat bahut gehri ho - jaise bhumi ke neeche 300-1000 m par koyla. Nadi ke kAtav (placer), samundar ki dredging ya bulldozer se satah scraping opencast/surface mining ke tarike hain. Exam point: shaft = vertical + galleries = horizontal = deep ore extraction (e.g. Kolar gold, Jharia coal).

qe: In atmospheric science, an 'Aerosol' is defined as:
qh: वायुमंडलीय विज्ञान में 'एरोसोल' (Aerosol) किसे कहते हैं?
o: A suspension of fine solid particles or liquid droplets dispersed in the air
e: Aerosol hawa mein thos kanak (solid particles) ya taral boondon ka itna chhota chhitrao (suspension) hai jo hawa mein tairta rehta hai - jaise dhool, dhuen ka soot, samundri namak ke kiran aur jwalamukhi ki raakh. Ye nuclei ka kaam karte hain jispar jallvaashp jama hokar baadal bunte hain, aur suraj ki roshni ko bikhair kar (scattering) dhup ko peeela/mail (pollution haze) bana dete hain. Radioactive gas, ozone vacuum ya shuddh oxygen aerosol nahi hain. Exam point: aerosol = hawa mein tairte chhote kan; yeh cloud seeding aur air pollution dono se jude hain.

qe: What role do 'Hygroscopic Nuclei' play in the condensation process of the atmosphere?
qh: वायुमंडल में 'हाइग्रोस्कोपिक नाभिक' (Hygroscopic Nuclei) क्या भूमिका निभाते हैं?
o: Providing micro-surfaces for water vapor condensation to form cloud droplets and fog
e: Hygroscopic nuclei wo chhote-chhote kanak hain (jaise samundri namak, dhool ka kan, dhuen ka soot aur sulfates) jo jallvaashp ke anuyon ko apni satah par khinch kar chipka lete hain. Ye nuclei condensation ke liye aadharya (platform) ka kaam karte hain - inke bina jallvaashp ko boond ya barf banne ke liye bahut zyada supercooling chahiye hoti. Isi liye inhe 'cloud condensation nuclei' bhi kehte hain aur inki kami ke samay cloud seeding (silver iodide) ka istemal hota hai. Exam point: hygroscopic nuclei + thanda tapman = condensation = baadal aur kohra.

qe: The 'Specific Gravity' of a mineral is defined as the ratio of its mass to the mass of an equal volume of:
qh: खनिज का 'विशिष्ट गुरुत्व' (Specific Gravity) किसके समान आयतन के द्रव्यमान का अनुपात होता है?
e: Kisi khanij ka specific gravity (vishesh gurutva) uska bhaar aur utne hi aayatan ke shuddh paani (4 degree C par) ke bhaar ka anupat (ratio) hota hai. 4 degree C par paani ka ghanatva sabse zyada (1 g/cm3) hota hai, isliye ise manak (standard) maana gaya hai. Isse pata chalta hai ki khanij paani se kitna bhaari hai - jaise galena ka specific gravity lagbhag 7.6 aur hematite ka lagbhag 5.2 hota hai. Hawa, basalt ya mercury standard nahi hain. Exam point: specific gravity = mineral ka bhaar / barabar aayatan ke paani ka bhaar (4 degree C par).

qe: What characterizes 'Open-Cast Mining' (Surface Quarrying)?
qh: 'विवृत खनन' (Open Cast Mining) की क्या विशेषता है?
o: Stripping overlying soil and rock (overburden) to extract shallow mineral beds from the surface
Drilling petroleum through deep marine water columns
Excavating deep vertical shafts with elevators
e: Open-cast ya surface mining mein pehle upar wali mitti aur kamzor chattaan (jise overburden kehte hain) hataayi jaati hai, phir satah ke kareeb (0-30 m gehrai) padne wali khanij ki parat nikaali jaati hai. Ye tareeka shaft mining se sasta aur zyada surakshit hai lekin bade kshetra ko khod kar khadda kar deta hai; isliye ise 'strip mining' bhi kehte hain aur kheti-bhoomi nasht hoti hai. Petroleum ka drilling samundar mein alag vidhi hai, manual panning nadi ke placer ki hai. Exam point: open-cast = overburden hatao + satah ke kareeb khanij = sasta par paryaavaran par bojh.

qe: The core of the Earth is designated by the shorthand 'Nife' because of the dominance of:
qh: पृथ्वी के कोर को 'निफे' (Nife) क्यों कहा जाता है?
e: Prithvi ka core ghaas (iron) aur nickel se bana hai, isliye iska shorthand 'NIFE' hai - NI (Nickel) + FE (Ferrous ya Iron). Ye core do hisson mein bata hai - bahri core (outer core) taral aur andar ki core (inner core) thos. Isi taral loha-nickel ke convection se prithvi ka chumbakiya kshetra (geomagnetic field) banta hai. Core ka tapman 5000 degree C se bhi zyada hai, aur iska ghanatva poore grah ka sabse zyada hai. Niobium, Fluorine ya Nitrogen se ye naam nahi bana. Exam point: Nife = Nickel + Iron = core; Sima = Silica + Magnesium = ocean crust; Sial = Silica + Aluminum = continent.

qe: What dynamic parameter determines the explosive viscosity of ascending volcanic magma?
qh: ऊपर उठते हुए मैग्मा की 'श्यानता' (गाढ़ेपन) को नियंत्रित करने वाला मुख्य कारक क्या है?
e: Jwalamukhi se nikalne wale magma ka tapman, gas content aur viscocity (chipak) is baat par nirbhar karta hai ki visphot (explosion) kitna bhayankar hoga. Silica (SiO2) ka percentage jitna zyada hoga, magma utna hi garhee (viscous, thick) aur silsila (sticky) hoga, gas andar phans jaayegi aur visphot zyada tez hoga. Isliye granitic (silica-rich) magma ka visphot bahut bhayankar hota hai, jabki basalt (silica-poor) ka lava patla aur shaant bahata hai - jaise Hawaii. Hawa, samundri namak ya aadrata isse sambandhit nahi. Exam point: high silica = thick magma = explosive eruption (Japan, Philippines).

qe: What characterizes a massive 'Batholith' intrusive igneous structure?
qh: 'बैथोलिथ' (Batholith) अंतर्भेदी आग्नेय शैल की क्या विशेषता है?
o: A thin horizontal sheet concordant with bedded strata
A gigantic, discordant plutonic rock mass with an exposed surface area exceeding 100 sq km
A volcanic ash cone around a crater
e: Batholith sabse bada intrusive (andar ghusa hua) igneous rock mass hai. Ye discordant hota hai yaani aas-paas ki paraton (strata) ko kaat kar aage badhta hai, garden (bottomless) hota hai aur iska satah ke upar nikalne wala kshetra 100 square km se zyada hota hai. Iska udaharan Sierra Nevada (USA) aur Chota Nagpur ke granite batholith hain. Thin horizontal sheet concordant sill kehlati hai, saucer-shaped dhansi lopolith hoti hai, ash cone ek bahri jwalamukhi sanrachna hai. Exam point: batholith = sabse bada + discordant + bottomless plutonic mass.

qe: What defines a discordant 'Dike' (Dyke) in structural geology?
qh: संरचनात्मक भूविज्ञान में 'डाइक' (Dike) किसे कहा जाता है?
o: A near-vertical, wall-like planar magmatic intrusion that cuts across pre-existing country rock strata
A horizontal sill parallel to bedding planes
e: Dike (dyke) ek lambavat (vertical ya steep) dip wali plate jaisi magmatic intrusion hai jo upar ke pehle se maujood pattharon (country rock) ki paraton ko kaat kar nikal jaati hai - matlab ye discordant hoti hai. Ye zameen ke andar ki taraf (fissure) mein ghus kar jama hoti hai aur satah tak pahunchti hai to doosre ilaake ka bojh utha kar dist der (wall) jaisi dikhti hai. Sill uske ulta hoti hai - wo paraton (strata) ke saath samantar (concordant) hoti hai. Lopolith saucer-shaped hota hai aur caldera ek dhansa hua jwalamukhi muhana hai. Exam point: dyke = lambavat + discordant (strata kate), sill = horizont + concordant (strata ke saath samantar).

qe: Why can seismic S-waves not traverse the Earth's Outer Core?
qh: भूकंपीय एस-तरंगें पृथ्वी के 'बाहरी कोर' से होकर क्यों नहीं गुजर पाती हैं?
o: The outer core is a frozen, ultra-rigid solid
The outer core consists of compressed gas
The outer core is in a molten liquid state, possessing zero shear modulus
The outer core's magnetic field repels all body waves
e: Bahri core (outer core) taral (liquid) state mein hai, matlab usme shear modulus (kanon ka ek doosre ko pakad kar khisakne ka gun) shunya hota hai. S-wave ek shear wave hai jise chalne ke liye kanon (particles) ka ek doosre se chipka hona zaroori hai; taral mein particles khul (loose) hote hain, isliye S-wave wahin ruk jaati hai. Isi karan 103 degree se 143 degree tak ka S-wave shadow zone banta hai jahan S-wave pahunchti hi nahi. Bahri core jama hua, gas ya chumbakiya padarth kuchh bhi ho, S-wave nahi jaa sakti. Exam point: S-wave shadow zone = bahri core ka liquid hone ka pakka pramaan.

qe: Which physical force generates the observed equatorial bulge of the Earth's geoid?
qh: पृथ्वी के भूमध्यरेखीय उभार को उत्पन्न करने वाला प्राथमिक भौतिक बल कौन सा है?
o: Centrifugal force produced by planetary axial rotation
e: Prithvi apne axis par pashchim se poorv ki taraf ghoomti hai. Ghoomne wali kisi bhi vastu ke har kan par apakendriya bal (centrifugal force) kaam karta hai jo use bahar ki taraf dhakElta hai, aur ye bal utna hi tez hota hai jitna kan axis se door ho. Equator ke kan axis se sabse zyada door hote hain, isliye wahan ye bal sabse zyada hota hai aur vahan ki chattaan bahar ubhar kar bulge bana deti hai; dhruv nazdik hone ke karan chapta (flattened) reh jaate hain. Lunar tidal pull alag cheez hai (wo samundar ki lehrein banata hai). Exam point: geoid ka equatorial bulge = prithvi ki rotation se paida hua centrifugal force.

qe: What endogenic mechanism accounts for the generation of Earth's geomagnetic field?
qh: पृथ्वी के भू-चुंबकीय क्षेत्र की उत्पत्ति के लिए कौन सी आंतरिक प्रक्रिया उत्तरदायी है?
o: Permanent magnetism stored in the solid crust
Solar wind induction in the ocean
Geodynamo action driven by convective circulation of molten iron-nickel in the outer liquid core
e: Prithvi ka chumbakiya kshetra (geomagnetic field) jo compass ki sui ko chalata hai aur solar wind se prithvi ko bachata hai, wo bahri core ke convection se banta hai - ise geodynamo kehte hain. Bahri core taral loha-nickel (iron-nickel) se bana hai; garmi aur dabaav ke antar se yahan thermal convection chalte hain, aur prithvi ke ghoomne se wo golghumaawa (coriolis effect) mein aate hain. Isi se ek motor jaisa action banta hai jo lohe ke convection se ek sthir chumbakiya kshetra paida karta hai. Sthayir (permanent) magnetism chattaan mein itna badi field nahi bana sakta. Exam point: geodynamo = bahri core ka taral loha-nickel + convection + rotation = magnetosphere ka janm.

qe: What is the standard hardness rating of mineral 'Quartz' on the Mohs scale?
qh: मोह पैमाने पर 'क्वार्ट्ज' का मानक कठोरता मान क्या है?
e: Mohs scale par Quartz ki hardness 7 hoti hai, isliye ye talc se diamond tak ki 10-value list mein saatve sthaan par aata hai. Quartz (SiO2) silica ka sabse aam prakrutik roop hai - iske prakar rock crystal, amethyst, chert aur sand ke kan ke roop mein milte hain. Ye steel ya knife se bhi thoda sakht hai, lekin topaz (8), corundum (9) aur diamond (10) se mulaayam hai; isi karan granite jaise patthar mein quartz ki chhuri se khurach ke use pehchaana jaata hai. Exam point: 7 = Quartz, 8 = Topaz, 9 = Corundum, 10 = Diamond; hardness 5 se upar wale khanij steel se khurach sakte hain.

qe: At the 'Dew Point' temperature, why does the Relative Humidity of an air mass reach 100%?
qh: 'ओसांक' (Dew Point) तापमान पर वायु की सापेक्ष आर्द्रता 100% क्यों हो जाती है?
o: All air molecules evaporate into outer space
The actual moisture content equals the maximum water vapor capacity the air can hold at that temperature
Atmospheric air pressure drops to zero
Ice crystals absorb all ambient nitrogen
e: Dew Point wo tapman hai jahan hawa mein maujood jallvaashp (water vapour) ki matra apni kshamta ke barabar ho jaati hai - matlab hawa ab us tapman par isse zyada nami nahi rakh sakti. Isi sthiti mein santripta (actual vapour / saturation vapour) 100% ho jaati hai aur thodi-bhi thandak se bhaap paani ki boond (condensation) banane lagti hai, jisse oos, kohra ya baadal bantay hai. Vayu ka dabaav shunya hona ya ice crystal ka nitrogen sokhna nonsensical hain. Exam point: dew point par RH = 100%; thanda hona (jab tak dew point se neeche na jaye) condensation ka pehla shart hai.

qe: What physical process generates 'Thunder' during severe thunderstorm activity?
qh: तड़ित-झंझा के दौरान बादलों की 'गर्जना' (Thunder) किस भौतिक प्रक्रिया से उत्पन्न होती है?
o: Rapid explosive expansion of air heated abruptly to extreme temperatures along a lightning channel
Collision of descending hailstones with the ground
Sound of rain impact on cloud tops
Frictional rub between cirrus ice clouds
e: Bijli (lightning) ke channel se jab bijli girti hai to us patli raah (channel) ka tapman kuchh seconds ke liye 30,000 degree C tak pahunch jaata hai, jo sooraj ki satah se bhi 5 guna zyada garm hai. Itni garmi se hawa ekdum tez failti hai (explosive expansion) aur usse ek shock wave (dakka) paida hota hai jo hamare kaanon tak pahunch kar garaj (thunder) ki aawaz banata hai. Barish ke boondon ka cloud top se takrana ya hailstones ka girna iska kaaran nahi. Exam point: thunder = lightning ke lightning channel ke achanak faElne (expansion) se bana shock wave; bijli aur garaj saath hote hain.

qe: What causes a 'Frontal Temperature Inversion' in the lower troposphere?
qh: निचले क्षोभमंडल में 'वाताग्री तापमान व्युत्क्रमण' (Frontal Inversion) का क्या कारण है?
o: Sinking dry air within a subtropical high
A warm, less dense air mass being forced to ride upward over an underlying colder, denser air wedge
Direct absorption of UV by tropospheric ozone
e: Frontal temperature inversion tab hoti hai jab kisi ilaake mein thandi bhaari hawa nichli satah par dabi ho aur uske upar garm halki hawa aa kar uske upar chadh jaye (warm over cold) - is sthiti ko 'front' kehte hain. Thandi parat ke upar garm parat hone se tapman saat m (height) ke saath badh jaata hai, yani inversion ban jaata hai. Isse dhundh, kohra, dhuan aur pollution neeche jam jaate hain kyunki hawa upar-neeche mix nahi ho pati. Raat ki bhoomi-radiative thandak ya upar se dhansi sookhi hawa (subsidence) alag prakar ki inversion hain. Exam point: frontal inversion = thandi hawa ke upar garm hawa (warm front ka lakshan) - pollution aur smog ke liye zimmedar.

qe: Which geomorphic agent creates crescent-shaped sand dunes known as 'Barchans'?
qh: अर्धचंद्राकार रेत के टीले 'बरखान' (Barchans) किस भू-आकृतिक कारक द्वारा बनाए जाते हैं?
o: Aeolian wind action in arid regions
e: Barchan wo chandrama ke aakar (crescent-shaped) wala registan ka tila hai jise sookhi hawa (aeolian wind) banati hai. Iski do bhujaayein (horns) hawa ki disha ke saath aage ki taraf badhti hain, aur tez dhalan (steep leeward side) neeche ki taraf hota hai; barchan dheere-dheere hawa ki disha mein aage sarkta rehta hai. Isliye barchan hawa ki disha ka sabse pakka ishara hai. Nadi se bane tila, samundri lehrein ya glacier se aise tila nahi bante. Exam point: barchan = aeolian (hawa se bane) crescent tila; registan mein hawa ki disha nirdharit karne ka tool.

qe: What is the primary difference between a 'Landform' and a 'Landscape'?
qh: 'भू-आकृति' (Landform) और 'भू-दृश्य' (Landscape) के बीच क्या अंतर है?
o: A landform is an individual geomorphic feature, whereas a landscape is an integrated assemblage of related landforms
Landforms occur only on oceanic floors, while landscapes are terrestrial
There is no scientific difference between the two terms
Landscapes are exclusively man-made agricultural structures
e: Landform ek alag-bhinn (individual) bhoomi-aakaar hai - jaise ek pahadi, ek ghati, ek tila ya ek delta. Landscape un sab related aakaaron ka mila hua bada kshetriya sanyojan (assemblage) hota hai - jaise poora Thar registan, poora Himalayan kshetra ya poora Ganga ka maidan. Yani landscape kai landforms ko milakar bana ek bhez (system) hai. Dono cheezon mein antar hai, landform sirf samundar tal par nahi hote, aur landscape koi manav-nirmit khet nahi hai. Exam point: landform = single feature (ekaai), landscape = feature ka samuh (poortak kshetra).

qe: What is the primary driving force behind all Mass Movement (Mass Wasting) events?
qh: सभी प्रकार के 'वृहत संचलन' (Mass Movement) के पीछे प्राथमिक प्रेरक बल कौन सा है?
o: Gravitational pull acting on slope materials
e: Mass movement (bhumi-kshay / mass wasting) mein chattaan aur mitti ka bada bhag (bulk) gurutvakarshan (gravity) ke karan dhalan par niche sarakta hai - hawa, paani ya glacier jaise kisi bahari agent ki zaroorat nahi hoti. Isliye gravity hi is prakiya ki asli shakti hai: dhalan ka kon (angle) jitna tez ho aur uska support (vegetation, cohesion) jitna kamjor ho, utna hi bada khatra. Solar insolation, hawa ya dabaav karak ho sakte hain par mukhya chalayak (driver) gravity hi hai. Exam point: mass movement ka pehla kaaran = gravity + slope angle + paani; isi se rockslide, creep, slump aur avalnche bante hain.

qe: Is previous in-situ rock 'Weathering' an absolute prerequisite for Mass Movement to occur?
qh: क्या वृहत संचलन होने के लिए चट्टानों का पूर्व 'अपक्षय' (Weathering) एक अनिवार्य शर्त है?
o: No, mass movements can occur on unweathered bedrock slopes if structural failure or shear stress overcomes resistance
Only in hyper-arid subtropical sand dunes
Yes, mass movements cannot occur on solid rocks under any condition
e: Nahi, mass movement ke liye pehle weathering ka hona zaroori nahi hai. Agar dhalan ka kon bahut tez ho, chattaan mein joint (puriya) ho, paani ka dabaav badh jaye ya bhukamp ka jhatka lagE, to thos (solid) chattaan ka bada tukda bhi fault ya shear stress ke karan tut kar niche gir sakta hai. Jaisa pahadon par rockslide ya bhaari barish ke baad taja (fresh) chattaan ka girna. Haan, unchaai wali weathering se chattaan kamzor hoti hai aur movement ka khatra badhta hai - par ye shart (prerequisite) nahi hai. Exam point: weathering movement ka bodhak (supporting) kaaran hai, zaroori shart nahi; shear stress ka galat hona asli kaaran hai.

qe: What describes 'Soil Creep' in slope degradation?
qh: ढाल पर 'मृदा सर्पण' (Soil Creep) की क्या विशेषता होती है?
o: Catastrophic tumbling of rock blocks down a vertical cliff
Extremely slow, continuous, imperceptible downward movement of soil and regolith under gravity
e: Soil creep wo bahut dheema, lagbhag dikhne na dene wala (imperceptible) khinchav hai jisme mitti aur regolith gurutvakarshan ke karan saalon mein top par thoda-thoda niche sarkta hai. Iska pramaan hamen tirche (tilted) padne wale bijali ke khambe, dhaar (fence) ki khatiya aur deewaron ke jhukav se milta hai. Barf pighalna-thanda hona (freeze-thaw), wetting-drying aur jeev-jantu ke hilne se ye kriya tez hoti hai. Achanak girne wala tochan (catastrophic fall), flash flood ya liquefaction isse alag ghatnayein hain. Exam point: soil creep = sabse dheema mass movement (ek saal mein kuchh mm se cm), isliye ise 'dheema dhalan' kehte hain - par ye sabse zyada kshetra ko dhaak leta hai.

qe: What is 'Solifluction' and in which climatic environment is it most prevalent?
qh: 'सॉलीफ्लक्शन' (मृदा-प्रवाह) क्या है और यह किस जलवायु में सर्वाधिक होता है?
o: Rapid sand-dune collapse in hot desert margins
Dry gravel avalanches on volcanic cones
Slow, lobe-like downslope movement of water-saturated soil over an impermeable permafrost layer in periglacial regions
e: Solifluction ek dheema, lobe (chamach) jaisa niche sarkav hai jisme pani se bhigi (water-saturated) mitti kisi impermeable (paani na jaane wali) parat ke upar se behti-sarakti jaati hai. Ye un ilaake mein aam hai jahan permafrost (sthayi jamI zameen) ho - matlab tundra aur periglacial region (Arctic, high Himalaya, Alps). Garmi ke mausam mein upari mitti pighalti hai lekin permafrost paani ko neeche jane nahi deta, isliye upar wali mitti ki parat gayi phisal jaati hai. Isi se dhaar (ridge) aur lobe wale ghere bante hain. Exam point: solifluction = permafrost + saturated soil = periglacial (Alaska, Siberia, Tundra) ka classic mass movement.

qe: Which type of mass wasting involves rotational sliding of a rock mass along a concave-upward curved slip surface?
qh: किस प्रकार के भूस्खलन में शैल या मलबे का संचलन एक अवतल वक्र तल के सहारे पीछे की ओर घूर्णन के साथ होता है?
e: Rotational slump ek aisa mass wasting hai jisme chattaan ya mitti ka ek bada bhag dhansi (concave-upward) curved slip surface par ghoom (rotate) kar niche sarkta hai - jaise kursi se aage fisalna. Iska upari hissa lagbhag seedha rehta hai lekin neeche wala hissa aage ki taraf nikal (bulge) aata hai aur dhaal par seediyan jaisi (step-like) dhaar ban jaati hain. Iska slip surface andar se bhiya ke aakar (concave) hota hai, isliye ye translation slide se alag hai (jo samtal par seedha sarkta hai). Exam point: rotational slump = curved slip plane + rotation; iske nishaan - ghati ke dhalano par seedhi-numa dhaar.

qe: What is the average 'Normal Lapse Rate' of temperature decline in the free troposphere?
qh: क्षोभमंडल में ऊँचाई के साथ तापमान में कमी की 'सामान्य ह्रास दर' (Normal Lapse Rate) कितनी होती है?
o: Decrease of approximately 6.5°C per 1,000 meters (1 km) of ascent
e: Troposphere mein har 1000 m unchai par tapman lagbhag 6.5 degree C ghatta hai - isi ko normal lapse rate kehte hain. Ye ghatav isliye hota hai ki troposphere zameen ki satah se garm hoti hai: zameen infrared kiranein chhodti hai jo neeche wali hawa sokh leti hai, aur upar jaate-jaate hawa failti (expand) hai jisse uska tapman girta hai. Pahadon par thand isi karan hoti hai aur musafir ko har uchai par garmi kapde ki zaroorat hoti hai. 1 degree C per km, 10 degree C per km ya constant temperature sab galat hain. Exam point: normal lapse rate = 6.5 degree C per 1000 m; iske ulat (inversion) mein tapman badhta hai.

qe: Why is the tropopause located at a significantly higher altitude over the Equator (~18 km) than over the Poles (~8 km)?
qh: भूमध्य रेखा पर क्षोभमंडल की सीमा (~18 किमी) ध्रुवों (~8 किमी) की तुलना में अधिक ऊँची क्यों होती है?
o: Excess gravitational pull concentrated at the equator
Dense cloud cover over the poles
Intense solar heating at the equator driving powerful convective updrafts that lift the tropopause ceiling
e: Tropopause ki uchai equator par lagbhag 18 km aur dhruvon par lagbhag 8 km hoti hai. Iski wajah ye hai ki equator par suraj poore saal seedha chandata hai, isliye wahan garam hawa tez convective dhara bana kar bahut upar tak uthti hai aur tropopause ki chhat ko 18 km tak dhakEl deti hai. Dhruvon par kam garmi milti hai, hawa thandi aur bhaari hoti hai isliye uski parat (troposphere) patli reh jaati hai. Gravitational pull ya Coriolis deflection iska kaaran nahi hain. Exam point: tropopause - equator par sabse unchi (18 km), poles par sabse neechi (8 km); iske upar stratosphere shuru hota hai.

qe: Which layer of the atmosphere represents the coldest thermal regime, reaching down to -100°C?
qh: वायुमंडल की कौन सी परत सबसे ठंडी होती है, जहाँ तापमान -100°C तक गिर जाता है?
e: Mesosphere (~50-85 km) vayu mandal ki sabse thandi parat hai, jahan tapman -100 degree C tak gir jaata hai (polon par sabse zyada). Yahan ozone nahi hota jo garmi de sake, aur CO2 infrared vikiran ke roop mein poori garmi chhod deta hai, isliye tapman lagatar girta hai. Isi kabhi-kabhi ise 'ignorosphere' bhi kehte hain kyunki log ise padhai mein bhool jaate hain. Isi parat mein upar se aane wali ulkaayein (meteors) jal jaati hain. Thermosphere bahut garm hai, stratosphere thodi garm, aur upper troposphere sirf -50 degree C tak jaata hai. Exam point: mesosphere = sabse thandi parat + meteor jalne ki jagah + noctilucent clouds ka ghar.

qe: How does the 'Ionosphere' enable long-distance high-frequency radio telecommunication on Earth?
qh: 'आयनमंडल' लंबी दूरी के उच्च-आवृत्ति रेडियो संचार को कैसे सुलभ बनाता है?
o: By reflecting skywave radio signals back to Earth via its ionized plasma layers
By acting as a gravitational satellite conduit
e: Ionosphere thermosphere ke andar 60 km se upar ki ionit (ionized) parat hai, jismein suraj ki UV-X ray kiranein gas ke anuon se electron alag kar deti hain (ions banate hain). Ye ionit (charged) kanak radio ki khamju (skywave) ko reflect (wapas mod) kar dete hain, jiski wajah se FM/AM ki lambi doori tak radio sancharna sambhav hota hai - khash taur par raat ko. Bina is reflect kiye ground radio station ki aawaz kuchh sau km se aage nahi jaati. Isi parat ko 'radio mirror' kehte hain. Exam point: ionosphere = ions + radio reflection + aurora; long-distance HF radio communication isi wajah se hoti hai.

qe: What are 'Noctilucent Clouds' and in which atmospheric layer do they form?
qh: 'नॉकटीलुसेंट बादल' (Noctilucent Clouds) क्या हैं और ये वायुमंडल की किस परत में बनते हैं?
o: Ozone-destroying nitric clouds in the Stratosphere
Ionized auroral glows in the Exosphere
Tenuous ice-crystal clouds illuminated by twilight, forming in the high Mesosphere near polar regions
e: Noctilucent clouds (raat mein chamakne wale baadal) sabse unchi baadal hote hain jo lagbhag 80-85 km ki unchai par mesosphere ke shIrsh (top) mein banate hain, khaas taur par garmiyon mein dhruviya (polar) kshetra mein. Ye paani ki barf ke bahut chhote kirano se bane hote hain aur suraj ke aastha (twilight) mein us roshni se chamakte hain jab niche zameen aur niche wale baadal andhere mein ho jaate hain. Ozone-destroying nitric cloud, aurora ya cumulonimbus nahi. Exam point: noctilucent clouds = mesosphere (80-85 km) mein barf ke kiran + twilight mein chamak, khaas taur par polar garmi mein.

qe: The internationally recognized 'Kármán Line', denoting the boundary of outer space, is located at an altitude of:
qh: अंतरिक्ष की अंतरराष्ट्रीय सीमा मानी जाने वाली 'कर्मण रेखा' (Kármán Line) कितनी ऊँचाई पर स्थित है?
e: Karman Line ko antariksh ki seema maana jaata hai aur ye samundar ki satah se 100 km ki unchai par hai. Isi rekha ke peechhe (upar) 'outer space' maana jaata hai kyunki wahan hawa itni patli ho jaati hai ki aeroplane ko lift (uthaan) dene ke liye zarur bhaar nahi bachta aur kisi sanstha ko ghumne ke liye rocket-propulsion aur orbital velocity chahiye. Iska naam Theodore von Karman ke naam par rakha gaya hai; India ki sub-orbital flights aur satellite launch ki seema bhi lagbhag yahi hai. 20, 50 ya 500 km galat hain. Exam point: Karman Line = 100 km = space ki seema (sahi-international standard).

qe: Why do incoming meteors burn up upon entering the Earth's Mesosphere?
qh: अंतरिक्ष से आने वाले उल्कापिंड वायुमंडल की किस परत में घर्षण के कारण जलकर नष्ट हो जाते हैं?
e: Ulka (meteor) jab antariksh se bahut tez raftar (11-72 km/s) se prithvi ke vayu mandal mein daakhil hoti hai, to hawa ke anuon ke saath uski gharshan (friction) aur aage ke badhe dabaav se uski satah bahut garm ho jaati hai. Ye garam parat 50 se 85 km ke beech mesosphere mein hoti hai, jahan adhikansh ulkaayein jal kar raakh ho jaati hain aur 'shooting star' dikhti hain. Isi mesosphere ki suraksha dhaal prithvi ko bade Takrav (impact) se bachati hai. Thermosphere bahut upar hai, exosphere sabse bahar, aur stratosphere mein itni hawa nahi hoti. Exam point: meteors (ulkaayein) mesosphere mein jal jaati hain; bache hue tukde zameen par pahunchen to unhe meteorite kehte hain.

qe: What causes the temperature to increase with height throughout the Stratosphere?
qh: समताप मंडल में ऊँचाई बढ़ने के साथ तापमान में वृद्धि क्यों होती है?
o: Heat convection from the Earth's surface
Absorption of solar ultraviolet radiation by ozone molecules
e: Stratosphere (~20-50 km) mein ozone ki ek parat hoti hai jo suraj ki UV kiranein sokh leti hai. Ye absorption energy ko garmi mein badal deti hai, isliye stratosphere ki hawa tapman oopar ki taraf badhta hai - matlab temperature inversion ban jaata hai aur parat sthir ho jaati hai. Isi sthirta ke karan baadal nahi bante, hawa mix nahi hota aur jet aircraft yahin udte hain. Convection zameen se juda hai (troposphere ka kaam hai), helium compress hona ya CO2 badhna iska kaaran nahi. Exam point: stratosphere ka tapman oopar jaane par badhta hai kyunki ozone UV sokhta hai - ise 'ozonosphere' bhi kehte hain.

qe: What happens to the density of Earth's atmosphere as altitude increases toward space?
qh: धरातल से अंतरिक्ष की ओर जाने पर वायुमंडल के 'घनत्व' पर क्या प्रभाव पड़ता है?
o: Density decreases exponentially as gravity weakens and molecules disperse
Density drops to zero immediately above the troposphere
Density increases due to high solar radiation
Density remains unchanged up to 100 km
e: Prithvi ki hawa (atmosphere) ka ghanatva (density) unchai badhne par tezi se ghatta jaata hai kyunki hawa ke anu (molecules) gravitation ke karan zameen ke nazdik jakde rehte hain aur upar jaane par unka bhaar (weight) kam ho jaata hai. Isliye 5.5 km par hawa ka aadha hissa neeche reh jaata hai aur 100 km par lagbhag 99% hawa khatam ho jaati hai; wahan vacuum (shunya) jaisi sthiti hoti hai. Isi karan pahadon par saans lene mein dikkat aur tyre/train ka altitude-based dabaav hota hai. Ghanatva kabhi badhta nahi, na hi troposphere ke baad zero ho jaata hai. Exam point: altitude badhne par density aur dabaav dono ghatte hain.

qe: According to Planck's Radiation Law, a hotter radiating body emits radiation at:
qh: 'प्लांक के विकिरण नियम' (Planck's Law) के अनुसार, एक अत्यधिक गर्म पिंड किस प्रकार का विकिरण उत्सर्जित करता है?
o: Predominantly shorter wavelengths with higher energy frequency
e: Planck ke niyam ke anusar koi bhi garm padarth apne tapman ke hisaab se roshni (radiation) chhodta hai, aur tapman badhne par sabse zyada roshni chhoti tarang-dhairya (shorter wavelength) par nikalta hai. Isi karan loha garam karne par pehle laal, phir peela aur phir safed-nila dikhta hai. Isliye suraj (6000 K) se lagbhag 0.5 micron par visible roshni aati hai lekin thandi prithvi (288 K) se lambi infrared kiranein (10 micron ke aas-paas) nikalte hain. Iske vipreet Planck ke niyam se lambi tarang ka pata nahi chalta. Exam point: Wein ka niyam - garam object = short wave, thanda object = long wave; yahi greenhouse effect ka aadhar hai.

qe: What proportion of total incoming solar radiation is immediately reflected back to space as planetary albedo?
qh: पृथ्वी के कुल ऊष्मा बजट में कितना प्रतिशत सौर विकिरण बिना अवशोषित हुए 'एल्बिडो' के रूप में वापस अंतरिक्ष में लौट जाता है?
e: Duniya mein aane wali suraj ki kirane ka lagbhag 30-35 hissa (out of 100 units) badal, dhool, barf aur samundar ki satah se wapas antariksh mein chala jaata hai; isi pratibimb (fraction) ko albedo kehte hain. Baaki 65-70 unit vayu, bhoomi aur samundar sokh lete hain aur aage usmein re-radiation ka chakra chalta hai. 14% wahan se aata hai jo vayumandal sokh leta hai, 51 unit bhoomi ki satah tak pahunchta hai, aur 65% ghalat hai. Exam point: planetary albedo = 30-35% (badal aur barf sabse zyada reflect karte hain).

qe: Out of 100 units of solar insolation arriving at top-of-atmosphere, how many are absorbed directly by Earth's land and ocean surface?
qh: सौर विकिरण की 100 इकाइयों में से कितनी इकाइयाँ सीधे पृथ्वी की सतह (भूमि और महासागर) द्वारा अवशोषित की जाती हैं?
e: 100 unit suraj ki kirane mein se lagbhag 51 unit bhoomi aur samundar ki satah tak pahunch kar sokhe jaate hain; baaki 35 unit albedo se wapas aur 14 unit vayumandal tatha baadal sokh lete hain. Isliye bhoomi aur samundar ka tapman badhta hai aur wahi se infrared (long wave) vikiran nikalta hai jo vayumandal ko garam rakhta hai. Ye 51 unit hi solar energy ka asli engineering budget hai jisse mausam aur jalvaayu chalta hai. Exam point: 100 units = 35 (reflected) + 14 (atmosphere absorbed) + 51 (earth surface absorbed).

qe: What heat transfer mechanism transports heat through the horizontal movement of an air mass (e.g., Loo)?
qh: वायु के क्षैतिज संचलन द्वारा ऊष्मा के स्थानांतरण की प्रक्रिया (जैसे लू का चलना) क्या कहलाती है?
e: Advection wo tarika hai jisme garmi ek jagah se doosri jagah hawa ke samuh ke kshetij (horizontal) chalne se pahunchti hai - jaise garmi mein Rajasthan ki taraf se chalne wali garam sookhi Loo hawa poorvi bharat tak garam hawa le jaati hai. Convection mein garmi lambavat (vertical) disha mein uthti hai, Conduction mein garmi ek hi sthir padarth ke andar atom-atom se aage badhti hai. Sublimation thos se seedha gas banne ki kriya hai. Exam point: advection = horizontal heat transfer + hawa ka samuh (jaise Loo, chinook).

qe: Why are greenhouse gases like Carbon Dioxide transparent to solar insolation but opaque to terrestrial radiation?
qh: कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड जैसी ग्रीनहाउस गैसें सौर विकिरण के लिए पारदर्शी लेकिन स्थलीय विकिरण के लिए अपारदर्शी क्यों होती हैं?
o: They absorb only visible blue photons
They are blocked by atmospheric dust
Their molecular structure vibrates at resonant frequencies that match long-wave infrared radiation
e: Greenhouse gases jaise Carbon Dioxide (CO2), methane aur jallvaashp ka anuman (molecule) aisa bana hota hai ki wo chhoti tarang-dhairya wali suraj ki roshni ko saaf-saaf guzarne deta hai, lekin bhoomi ki lambi infrared wahas se milte hi apni antar Anu-gati (vibration) ke anusar uska sankalan kar leta hai aur usse re-radiate kar deta hai. Isi tarah ek hissa garmi bhoomi par wapas aa jaati hai aur tapman badh jaata hai. Structural vibration ka yehi resonant frequency ka khEl hai. Isliye vayu mein CO2 badhna greenhouse effect ko badhaata hai. Exam point: CO2 chhoti wave par saaf, lambi infrared par rok - yahi greenhouse effect ki chabi hai.

qe: A complete solar sunspot activity cycle lasts for an average period of approximately:
qh: सूर्य की सतह पर सौर कलंक (Sunspot) गतिविधि का एक चक्र औसतन कितने वर्षों का होता है?
e: Suraj ke satah par 'sunspot' (suraj ke daag) ka gintii har lagbhag 11 saal mein sabse zyada (maximum) aur sabse kam (minimum) hoti hai - isi ko solar cycle ya 11-saal ka Sunspot cycle kehte hain. Sunspot woh thanda aur bahut zyada chumbakiya kshetra wala hissa hota hai jahan se solar flare aur coronal mass ejection nikalti hain, jo prithvi ke chumbakiya kshetra mein toofan (geomagnetic storm) laa kar radio aur satellite ko disturb karti hain. Poori chumbakiya polarity (north-south ulta) ki chakra 22 saal ki hoti hai. Exam point: sunspot cycle = 11 saal (aur chumbakiya cycle = 22 saal).

qe: What is the 'Atmospheric Window' in terrestrial radiation thermodynamics?
qh: स्थलीय विकिरण ऊष्मागतिकी में 'वायुमंडलीय खिड़की' (Atmospheric Window) किसे कहते हैं?
o: A seasonal hole in the Antarctic ozone layer
An open break in overcast stratus clouds
A band of infrared wavelengths (approx. 8 to 11 micrometers) that passes unabsorbed by greenhouse gases out into space
e: 'Atmospheric window' wo tarang-dhairya band (lagbhag 8 se 11 micrometer) hai jismein bhoomi se nikalne wali infrared kiranein greenhouse gases dwara sokhi nahi jaati aur seedha antariksh mein chali jaati hain. Ye khidki prithvi ko thanda hone deti hai kyunki bhoomi ki lagbhag 70-80 unit garmi isi khidki se bahar nikal jaati hai. Lekin isi window ke andar CFC, methane aur ozone jaise naye gases dakhil hote hain to khidki thodi band ho jaati hai, kam garmi bahar jaati hai aur global warming badhta hai. Ozone hole, baadal ka ched ya cyclone ki aankh isse alag cheezein hain. Exam point: atmospheric window = 8-11 micrometer ka khula band; yahin se bhoomi ki garmi antariksh mein bhaagti hai.

qe: Why is the heat capacity (Specific Heat) of oceanic water higher than that of terrestrial landmasses?
qh: स्थलीय भू-भाग की तुलना में समुद्री जल की 'विशिष्ट ऊष्मा' अधिक होने का क्या प्रभाव पड़ता है?
o: Continents remain perennially colder than ocean floors
Water boils instantly under equatorial sunlight
Water heats up and cools down much more slowly than land, moderating maritime climates
Water reflects 100% of all solar insolation
e: Paani ka vishesh tap (specific heat) 4.18 J/g degree C hota hai, jabki zameen (chattaan) ka sirf lagbhag 0.8 J/g degree C hai - matlab paani ko ek hi matra garm karne ke liye 5 guna zyada energy chahiye. Isliye samundar dheere-dheere garm hota hai aur dheere-dheere thanda hota hai, aur apne aas-paas ke ilaake ke mausam ko santulit (moderate) rakhta hai (maritime climate). Zameen turant garam aur turant thandi ho jaati hai, jisse mahadveepiya jalvaayu (continental climate) banta hai jahan din-raat aur garmi-sardi ka antar bahut bada hota hai. Exam point: samundar ka high specific heat = maritime climate ka sanchentak (moderator).

qe: Standard mean atmospheric air pressure at sea level is calibrated at approximately:
qh: समुद्र तल पर मानक औसत वायुमंडलीय दाब लगभग कितना मापा जाता है?
e: Samundar ki satah (sea level) par vayu ka samanya dabaav lagbhag 1013.25 millibar ya hectopascal hota hai, jo 76 cm (760 mm) mercury ke barabar hai. Isse zyada dabaav shAnt (high) kateebandh aur kam dabaav garam low belt banati hai. 500 mb ka dabaav lagbhag 5.5 km unchai par hota hai, isliye wo sea level ka nahi hai, aur 76 mb sirf mercury ke unchaai ka anka hai. Exam point: sea level ka standard dabaav = 1013.25 mb (hPa) = 76 cm Hg; har 10 m par 1 mb badlav.

qe: What is a 'Thermograph' designed to measure in a weather station?
qh: मौसम विज्ञान वेधशाला में 'थर्मोग्राफ' का उपयोग क्या मापने के लिए किया जाता है?
o: Continuous graphical recording of temperature over time on a rotating drum
e: Thermograph ek recording yantra hai jismein ek bima (bimetal) ya bhare hue sensor dhup (temperature) ke badlav ke hisaab se kalam (pen) ko hilata hai jo ghoomte hue drum par ek lagatar vakra (curve) bana deta hai - isse 24 ghante ya ek hafte ka tapman record mil jaata hai. Barograph isi tarah dabaav record karta hai, hygrograph naamta. Ozone aur hawa ki gati ke liye alag yantra hote hain. Exam point: thermograph = temperature ka continuous graafi (recording), thermometer = pal bhar ka padhna, thermograph ka chart thermogram kehlata hai.

qe: What meteorological condition is characterized by a line connecting points of equal atmospheric barometric pressure?
qh: मौसम मानचित्र पर समान वायुमंडलीय दाब वाले स्थानों को जोड़ने वाली काल्पनिक रेखा क्या कहलाती है?
e: Isobar wo rekha hai jo naksha par un sabhi sthaanon ko jodti hai jahan vayu ka dabaav barabar ho. Isobar keval ka dabaav batate hain; jahan ye nazdik-nazdik hoti hain wahan dabaav ka girav (gradient) tez hota hai aur hawa tez chalti hai. Isotherm tapman ki, isohyet barsaat ki aur isoneph badal ki matra (cloud cover) ki rekha hai. Mausam ke naksha mein in sabhi rekhaon ke mel se hi cyclone ka pata chalta hai. Exam point: iso = barabar; bar = dabaav; isliye isobar = saman dabaav ki rekha.

qe: What defines the direction and strength of the 'Pressure Gradient Force' (PGF)?
qh: 'वायुदाब प्रवणता बल' (PGF) की दिशा और तीव्रता किस पर निर्भर करती है?
o: It acts at right angles to isobars, directed from high pressure to low pressure; steeper where isobars are closely spaced
It acts parallel to isobars toward high pressure
It depends solely on the altitude of the moon
It operates exclusively from east to west globally
e: Pressure Gradient Force (PGF) ka kaam hawa ko udvastak (high pressure) se mandak (low pressure) ki taraf dhakElna hai. Ye hamesha isobar ke lambavat (right angle) chalti hai, aur jahan isobar nazdik hoti hain wahan ye zyada tez hoti hai. Iski tivrata (magnitude) dabaav ke antar aur do sthaanon ki doori ke anusar hoti hai. Iske bina hawa chalti hi nahi, lekin iske saath Coriolis force, friction aur centrifugal force milkar hawa ki asli disha tay karte hain. Exam point: PGF = high se low ki taraf, isobaron ke lambavat; hawa ki gati ka asli chalayak (driver).

qe: Why are winds deflected to their right in the Northern Hemisphere and to their left in the Southern Hemisphere?
qh: उत्तरी गोलार्ध में हवाएं अपनी दाईं ओर तथा दक्षिणी गोलार्ध में बाईं ओर क्यों मुड़ जाती हैं?
o: Coriolis Force induced by Earth's axial rotation (Ferrel's Law)
Direct magnetic pull of the poles
e: Coriolis force prithvi ke apne axis par ghoomne se banta hai. Ghoomti hui prithvi par keval hawa ka path seedha nahi rehta - Northern Hemisphere mein ye apne path se right (dahine) mud jaati hai aur Southern Hemisphere mein left (bayen) mud jaati hai. Ise Ferrel's Law kehte hain. Iski tivrata equator par shunya aur dhruvon par sabse zyada hoti hai. Isi karan low pressure ke chakra (cyclone) northern mein anti-clockwise aur southern mein clockwise ghoomte hain. Exam point: Coriolis = prithvi ka rotation + Ferrel's Law; northern right, southern left.

qe: The magnitude of the Coriolis Force is mathematically zero at the ______ and reaches its maximum at the ______.
qh: कोरिओलिस बल का मान कहाँ शून्य और कहाँ अधिकतम होता है?
e: Coriolis force ka maan (magnitude) 2 v w sin(latitude) ke barabar hota hai, jismein sin(latitude) ka value equator par 0 degree ka sin = 0 hota hai. Isliye equator par Coriolis force shunya ho jaati hai aur wahan hawa seedha chalti hai - isi karan equator ke paas cyclone nahi bante. Lat the (bharatvritt) badhne ke saath sin(latitude) ka value badhta hai aur 90 degree (dhruv) par 1 ho jaata hai, matlab wahan Coriolis force sabse zyada hoti hai. Sea level, tropopause ya tropics iski asli rekha nahi hain. Exam point: Coriolis max at poles, zero at equator - isliye wahan cyclone nahi banate.

qe: In the Northern Hemisphere, which airflow direction characterizes a cyclonic Low-Pressure system?
qh: उत्तरी गोलार्ध में चक्रवाती निम्न दाब प्रणाली के चारों ओर हवाएं किस दिशा में घूमती हैं?
e: Northern Hemisphere mein mandak dabaav (low pressure) ke chakra (cyclone) mein hawa anti-clockwise (vaamavart) ghoomti hai aur bahar se andar ki taraf khinchti (converge) hai. Aisa do balon ke milkar hone se hota hai - pressure gradient force hawa ko andar khincha hai aur Coriolis force use right mud deta hai, jisse chakkar banta hai. Southern Hemisphere mein ye ghadi ki sui ki disha (clockwise) mein hota hai. Clockwise aur divergent outward flow high pressure (anticyclone) ka lakshan hai. Exam point: Northern low = anti-clockwise + inward; Northern high = clockwise + outward.

qe: Why are the roaring mid-latitude Westerlies (Roaring Forties, Furious Fifties) significantly stronger in the Southern Hemisphere?
qh: दक्षिणी गोलार्ध में पछुवा पवनें (गरजता चालीसा, प्रचंड पचासा) इतनी शक्तिशाली क्यों होती हैं?
o: Extreme mountain barrier deflections in Antarctica
Vast expanses of continuous open ocean with minimal continental landmass friction to impede airflow
Higher global air pressure over the South Pole
e: Coriolis force aur friction ka asar southern hemisphere mein zyada dikhta hai. Southern Ocean (yatrhi 40 se 60 degree dakshin) mein zameen ka koi tukda nahi hai - sirf lagatar khula samundar hai, isliye hawa ko roknN wala friction bahut kam milta hai aur wahan westerlies 'Roaring Forties', 'Furious Fifties' aur 'Screaming Sixties' ke roop mein pura zor pakadti hain. Northern hemisphere mein continents, pahad aur jungle is gati ko tod dete hain. Antarctica ki doori ya solar flares iska kaaran nahi. Exam point: Southern westerlies tez = khula samundar + kam friction.

qe: What characterizes an upper-tropospheric 'Geostrophic Wind'?
qh: ऊपरी क्षोभमंडल में बहने वाली 'भू-विक्षेपी पवन' (Geostrophic Wind) की क्या विशेषता है?
o: It rotates in vertical thermal convective chimneys
It is an explosive, localized sea breeze
It blows parallel to straight isobars when the Pressure Gradient Force is exactly balanced by the Coriolis Force in the absence of friction
It blows perpendicular to isobars toward low pressure
e: Geostrophic wind wo aadarash (ideal) hawa hai jo seedhi (straight) isobaron ke samantar chalti hai, jab pressure gradient force aur Coriolis force poori tarah santulit ho jaate hain aur friction bilkul nahi hota. Aisi sthit sar khaas taur par upper troposphere (lagbhag 1000 m+ unchai) par banti hai, isliye wahan ka mausam pattern isi geostrophic flow se samjhaya jaata hai. Satah ke nazdik friction ke karan hawa isobaron ko thoda kaat kar low ki taraf chalti hai. Exam point: geostrophic = PGF = Coriolis + zero friction = isobaron ke samantar, upper air mein.

qe: What oceanic and meteorological mechanism drives a daytime coastal 'Sea Breeze'?
qh: दिन के समय तटीय क्षेत्रों में 'समुद्री समीर' (Sea Breeze) चलने का क्या कारण है?
o: Sea water becomes boiling hot, pushing steam onto land
Land heats faster than the sea, creating local thermal Low Pressure over land; cooler, high-pressure marine air blows onshore
Moon's gravitational pull forces water and air onto shores
Offshore katabatic winds descending from mountain peaks
e: Sea breeze din ke samay banti hai kyunki zameen samundar ke muqable tez garm hoti hai - usmein specific heat kam hota hai. Garam zameen ke upar hawa failti hai aur local low pressure (thermal low) ban jaata hai; samundar ke upar dabaav thoda zyada rehta hai. Isliye samundar ki thandi hawa zameen ki taraf chalti hai - ise sea breeze kehte hain, jo dopahar mein sabse tez hoti hai. Raat ko ulta hota hai aur land breeze banti hai. Isi thermal contrast se monsoon ka bhi model samjhaya jaata hai. Exam point: din = sea breeze (samundar se zameen), raat = land breeze (zameen se samundar).

qe: What describes a tectonic 'Graben' within a continental rift valley?
qh: विवर्तनिक भ्रंश घाटी में 'ग्रैबेन' (Graben) किसे कहा जाता है?
o: A down-dropped crustal block depressed between two parallel normal faults under tensional stress
e: Graben wo dhansa hua bhoomi ka tukda hai jo do samantar normal faults ke beech mein neeche dabak (down-dropped) jaata hai. Ye tension (khinchav) ke karan banta hai kyunki zameen khinchti hai to beech ka hissa bhangi (fault) ke saath neeche sarak jaata hai. Rift valley (jaise East African Rift, Narmada-Tapi valley, Rhine valley) isi graben ka bada roop hai. Upar ubha hua tukda horst kehlata hai. Exam point: normal fault = tension = graben (neeche) + horst (upar); Narmada-Tapi ki rift valley graben ka udaharan.

qe: In structural geology, an asymmetrical fold whose axial plane tilts so severely that its limbs become nearly horizontal is termed a:
qh: भूविज्ञान में ऐसा वलन जिसका अक्षीय तल इतना झुक जाता है कि उसकी दोनों भुजाएं लगभग क्षैतिज हो जाती हैं, कहलाता है:
e: Recumbent fold wo fold hai jiska axial plane itna jhuka hota hai ki uska ek limb lagbhag samtal (horizontal) ho jaata hai - matlab fold leta (recumbent) pad gaya. Ye bahut tez dabaav (compression) aur gehre orogenic takrav (jaise Alps aur Himalaya) mein banta hai, khaas kar jab ek parat doosri par chadh jaave. Monocline ek taraf ki halki jhuk hai, symmetrical fold dono taraf barabar, chevron sharp V-shaped fold hai. Exam point: recumbent fold = leti hui fold + nappe (overthrust) ka janm - Alps mein dikhta hai.

qe: What happens when horizontal thrusting tears the limb of a recumbent fold and overrides distant rock strata?
qh: जब अत्यधिक संपीडन के कारण शयान वलन की भुजा टूटकर कई किलोमीटर दूर जाकर अन्य चट्टानों पर चढ़ जाती है, तो उसे क्या कहते हैं?
e: Nappe ek aisa bada overthrust sheet hai jo horizontal thrusting ke samay fold ke limb ko tod kar aur usse kaafi door tak khisak kar (displaced) doosri chattaan ki paraton par chadh jaata hai. Yani Nappe ek hi vishaal tukda hai jo apne asli sthaan se kai kilaumitar door pad jata hai - ise Alps aur Himalaya ke tectonic mein dekha jaata hai. Horst ek ubha hua fault block, graben neeche dhansa hua block, aur sill ek concordant magma sheet hota hai. Exam point: nappe = overthrust sheet = recumbent fold ka agla kadam jo khamandali takrav mein banta hai.

qe: Which of the following is NOT one of the five primary environmental factors governing 'Soil Formation' (Dokuchaev/Jenny model)?
qh: मृदा निर्माण (Soil Formation) को नियंत्रित करने वाले 5 मुख्य प्राकृतिक कारकों में कौन शामिल नहीं है?
o: Climate and Biological activity over Time
e: Soil formation ke paanch (Dokuchaev/Jenny model) karak hote hain - Parent rock (matra chattaan), Climate, Organisms (jeev-jantu aur paudhe), Relief/Topography aur Time - inke pahle aksharon se CLORPT banta hai. Samudri tal ke chumbakiya anomalies (seafloor magnetic anomalies) tectonics ke pramaan hain, mitti banne ke karak nahi. Ye paanch karak milkar hi mitti ki motai, rang, bunkai aur upjaau-ta tay karte hain. Exam point: C-L-O-R-P-T = Climate, Organisms, Relief, Parent rock, Time - mitti banne ke 5 karak.

qe: Why are topsoils on steep mountain slopes generally thin and poorly developed compared to those on valley floors?
qh: घाटी के मैदानों की तुलना में तीव्र पहाड़ी ढलानों पर मिट्टी की परत पतली और कम विकसित क्यों होती है?
o: Total absence of biological weathering on slopes
Perpetual drought conditions on windward slopes
Accelerated surface runoff and gravity-driven erosion outpace the rate of soil accumulation
Complete absence of parent rock on mountains
e: Tez dhalan (slope) wale pahadi ilaake mein barsaat ka paani turant aage badh jaata hai (surface runoff), isliye jamne ka samay bahut kam milta hai aur zameen ke kanak (particles) pravah ke saath bah jaate hain. Saath hi gurutvakarshan ke karan hi soil creep jaise dheeme sarkav bhi hoti rehti hai. Isliye mitti ki nayi parat banne ki rafthar erosion se kam pad jaati hai aur topsoil patli aur kamjor rehti hai. Valley floor par paani jama hota hai, gaad jama hoti rehti hai, isliye wahan moti aur upjaau mitti banti hai. Exam point: steep slope = tez runoff + gravity creep = thin soil; valley = thick alluvial soil.

qe: In a mature soil profile, which layer is known as the 'Zone of Eluviation' (Leaching)?
qh: परिपक्व मृदा परिच्छेदिका (Soil Profile) में किस संस्तर को 'अपवहन संस्तर' (Zone of Eluviation) कहा जाता है?
e: Horizon A topsoil hai jo sabse upari parat hota hai aur ismein organic humus aur khanij dono milte hain, lekin yahan se barik khanij aur humus paani ke saath neeche dhul (leach) jaate hain - isi karan ise 'zone of eluviation' ya leaching ka kshetra kehte hain. Dhulne ke baad ye malbah Horizon B (subsoil ya zone of illuviation) mein jama hota hai. Horizon R aprakrut bedrock hai aur Horizon C uske tutne wala bhura (weathered) patthar. Exam point: A horizon = eluviation (khanij nikalna), B horizon = illuviation (khanij jama hona).

qe: What fluvial erosional feature forms circular depressions in rocky riverbeds via pebble-swirling abrasion?
qh: नदी के पथरीले तल में भंवर के साथ घूमते पत्थरों के घर्षण द्वारा बनने वाले गोल गड्ढों को क्या कहते हैं?
e: Potholes wo chhote-chhote giradar gaddhe hote hain jo nadi ke patthariya tal mein bante hain. Tez paani ke chakkar mein pathar ke gOl (pebbles) ghOomte rehte hain aur gharshan (abrasion) se patthar ki satah khudti jaati hai; is tarah chakra (grinding) se giradaar khadda banta hai. Yamuna-Ganga ke patthariya ilaake aur Chambal ke aise potholes mein aam milte hain. Natural levee nadi ke kinare ki dhaar hai, terraces purani ghatiyon ke avshesh, ox-bow jheel meander katne se banti hai. Exam point: potholes = nadi ke patthariya bed mein pathar-gharshan se bane giradaar gaddhe.

qe: What distinguishes an 'Incised Meander' (Entrenched Meander) from a standard alluvial floodplain meander?
qh: 'इंसाइज्ड मिएंडर' (गंभीरिकृत विसर्प) सामान्य मैदानी विसर्प से किस प्रकार भिन्न होता है?
o: It exists only in sand dunes
It runs in an absolutely straight channel
It is a meandering channel deeply carved into hard bedrock due to rapid tectonic uplift or base-level drop
e: Incised meander (ya entrenched meander) wo nadi ka mooh (meander) hai jo nadi ne chatti (hard bedrock) mein gehre kattav ke saath kata hota hai - matlab nadi ki mod-dhaar chattaan ke andar dhansi hui dikhti hai, jaise koi gehri naali. Aisa tab hota hai jab zameen tez uncha uthti hai (tectonic uplift) ya samundar/satah ka star girta hai (base-level drop): nadi niche kAtna tez kar deti hai lekin apni purani modein badal nahi paati. Alluvial maidan ke meander taral gaad (sediment) mein bante hain, isliye dono ka antar saaf hai. Exam point: incised meander = uplift ya base-level drop ka pakka nishaan; Chambal ke gehre gorges aur Yamuna ke pahadi modon ke udaharan yaad rakho.

qe: What do abandoned 'River Terraces' (Fluvial Terraces) bordering an active valley represent?
qh: नदी घाटी के दोनों ओर सीढ़ीदार रूप में पाई जाने वाली 'नदी वेदिकाएं' (River Terraces) क्या दर्शाती हैं?
o: Remnants of abandoned former valley floodplains left perched as the river cut downwards into its channel
e: River terraces nadi ki purani ghati ke wo tukde hain jo baad mein nadi ke gehre kattav (down-cutting) ke karan unche (perched) rah gaye - purana floodplain ka kinara kati (cut) ke roop mein sthir pad gaya. Ye terraces nadi ki uchai (tectonic uplift) ya jalvaayu badlav (glacial-interglacial) ka sabse ahem pramaan hain, kyunki inki unchai se pata chalta hai ki nadi kitni neeche kati. Lava bed, fault escarpment ya manav-nirmit seedhiyan isse alag hain. Exam point: river terrace = purane floodplain ke perched avshesh; nadi ki ghati 3 tarah se badalti hai - valley deepening (gehra hona), valley widening (chauda hona) aur valley lengthening (lamba hona).

qe: In subterranean limestone caves, calcium carbonate deposits that grow vertically upward from the cave floor are called:
qh: चूना पत्थर की गुफाओं के फर्श से ऊपर की ओर स्तम्भ के रूप में विकसित होने वाले कैल्शियम कार्बोनेट निक्षेप क्या कहलाते हैं?
e: Stalagmite wo chuna (calcium carbonate) se bana stambh hai jo karst gaar (cave) ke farash (floor) se upar ki taraf badhta hai. Jab chhat se tapakta paani boond-bood hokar niche girta hai, to paani mein ghuli hui calcium bicarbonate hawa ke contact mein aakar calcium carbonate ke roop mein boond chhod deti hai; wo boond jahan girti hai wahi jama hoti rehti hai, aur dheere-dheere niche se upar tak stambh ban jaata hai. Chhat se latak kar niche badhne wala chuna stalactite kehlata hai. Lapies limestone ke ghulne se bani satah ki naaliyan hain aur sinkhole ek dhansi hui gaar. Exam point: Stalagmite = farash (floor) se upar ki taraf (M mein 'g' = ground), Stalactite = chhat se niche ki taraf.

qe: What complete subterranean structure forms when an overhead Stalactite meets a rising Stalagmite in a karst cave?
qh: कास्ट गुफा में जब छत से लटकता स्टैलेक्टाइट और फर्श से उठता स्टैलेग्माइट आपस में मिल जाते हैं, तो क्या बनता है?
e: Jab karst gaar mein chhat se latakta hua stalactite aur farash se badhta hua stalagmite dono ek doosre se mil jaate hain, to ek pura stambh (column ya pillar) ban jaata hai. Iske liye saikdon saal lagte hain kyunki har boond sirf ek patli parat calcium carbonate jama karti hai, jise dripstone kehte hain. Aise stambh Borra caves (Andhra Pradesh), Belum caves, Meghalaya ki Krem gaaron aur Bhimbetka ki gaaron mein dikhte hain. Uvala aur polje karst ke bade dhansi (depression) roop hain, doline chhota giradaar khadda hai. Exam point: stalactite + stalagmite = column (pillar); chuna patthar ke paani mein ghulne aur drip hone se hi ye aakaar bante hain.

qe: What happens to the cross-sectional shape and gradient of a river in its 'Old Age' (Penultimate Stage)?
qh: नदी की 'वृद्धावस्था' (Old Stage) में उसके ढाल और प्रवाह वेग में क्या परिवर्तन होता है?
o: Gradient becomes extremely steep, producing rapids
Gradient becomes nearly flat, flow velocity drops, lateral erosion dominates, and deposition builds broad floodplains and deltas
e: Kisi nadi ki 3 avasthayein hoti hain - youth (jawani), mature aur old age (vriddhavastha). Old age mein zameen lagbhag samtal ho jaati hai, isliye dhaar (gradient) bahut kam ho jaati hai aur paani ki raftar (velocity) gir jaati hai. Ab nadi niche katne ke bajaye kinaron ko kaat-ti hai (lateral erosion) aur apna bhara hua gaad (sediment) kinaron par, maidan mein aur muhane par jama karti hai - isi se chaudi floodplain, natural levee, meander, ox-bow jheel aur delta bante hain. Youth mein gehra kattav (V-shaped gorge) hota hai. Exam point: nadi ke 3 charan - youth (V ghati, tez), mature (meander), old age (floodplain + delta).

qe: Which seismic waves cause side-to-side (snake-like) horizontal movement?
qh: कौन सी भूकंपीय तरंगें क्षैतिज रूप से अगल-बगल (सांप की तरह) संचलन करती हैं?
e: Love wave ek surface wave hai jisme particles nadi ke paani ki tarang ki tarah ek doosre ke samantar (perpendicular to direction of propagation) horizon-tal (left-right) hilte hain - isliye ise 'snake-like' ya transverse movement kehte hain. Ye zameen ke upari paraton ke andar phans kar tez chal sakti hai aur imaraton ki buniyad (foundation) ke liye sabse khatarnak maani jaati hai. Rayleigh wave mein rolling (ret) jaisa movement hota hai, S-wave body wave hai (andar chalti hai), aur P-wave longitudinal dhakka hai. Exam point: Love wave = horizontal transverse shaking; Raymond = rolling; yahi dono surface waves sabse zyada nuksan karti hain.

qe: The term 'Basaltic' implies a rock with ______ silica content.
qh: 'बेसाल्टिक' शब्द का अर्थ है ______ सिलिका सामग्री वाला शैल।
e: Basaltic chattaan mein Silica (SiO2) ki matra sirf 45-52% hoti hai, isliye use mafic bhi kehte hain (Magnesium + Ferric). Silica kam hone se magma patla (low viscosity) hota hai, isliye lava shaant bah kar failta hai aur Deccan Trap jaise bade lava plateau banate hain. Ismein loha-magnesium (iron-magnesium) zyada aur rang gehra (dark grey-black) hota hai. Iske vipreet granitic (felsic) chattaan mein silica 65% se zyada hoti hai. Exam point: Basaltic = low silica (45-52%) + dark + patla lava; Granitic = high silica + halka rang + garha magma.

qe: A 'Mantle' plume or hotspot can lead to which type of landform?
qh: मेंटल प्लूम या हॉटस्पॉट किस प्रकार की भू-आकृति का कारण बन सकता है?
e: Mantle ke gehre hisse se jab ek garm stambh (mantle plume) thousands of km chalta hua upar aata hai, to uske upar wale plate par jalan (magmatism) shuru hoti hai. Agar ye samundar ke neeche ho to Hawaii aur Iceland jaisa volcanic island banta hai; agar khamandali plate ke neeche ho to Yellowstone jaise 'hotspot' aur Deccan Trap jaisa vishaal flood basalt province banta hai. Note ki ye hotspot plate boundary par nahi, plate ke beech (intraplate) mein bhi hota hai. Rift valley, glacial valley aur trench alag prakriyayein hain. Exam point: mantle plume/hotspot = volcanic island chain + flood basalt province ka kaaran.

qe: What happens to the 'Volume' of ice compared to water?
qh: पानी की तुलना में 'बर्फ' के 'आयतन' का क्या होता है?
e: Paani ke jamne (freeze) par uska aayatan (volume) badh jaata hai - lagbhag 9% zyada, kyunki paani ke anu (molecules) barf ki khuli jaali (hexagonal lattice) mein kas kar jude rehte hain jismein khali jagah bachi rehti hai. Isliye barf ka ghanatva (density) 0.917 g/cm3 hota hai, matlab barf paani par tairti hai. Yahi gunvatta (property) bhoomi ke liye varadan hai: jheel top se jamti hai, paani niche taral rehta hai, isliye jaliya (aquatic) jeev bach jaate hain. Exam point: barf = paani se 9% zyada volume + kam ghanatva, isliye tairti hai; isi se freeze-thaw weathering hoti hai.

qe: A 'Batholith' is specifically which type of igneous body?
qh: 'बैथोलिथ' विशेष रूप से किस प्रकार का आग्नेय पिंड है?
