e: Batholith ek bahut bada (hundreds of square km) intrusive igneous rock mass hai jo gehre (deep-seated) magma chamber ke thande hokar jama hone se banta hai. Ye 'discordant' hota hai yaani aas-paas ki paraton ko kaat kar aage badhta hai, aur iska koi tal (bottom) nahi milta (bottomless). Ye granite jaise coarse-grained patthar ka banta hai aur iske upar ki parat ghul (erosion) jaane par ye satah par nikal aata hai - jaise Sierra Nevada aur Chota Nagpur ka granite. Vertical wall dike, horizontal sheet sill, aur chhota sataheen pat bhi isse alag hai. Exam point: batholith = giant deep-seated magma chamber + discordant + bottomless.

qe: Which mineral property refers to the color of its powder?
qh: कौन सा खनिज गुण इसके चूर्ण के रंग को संदर्भित करता है?
e: Streak kisi khanij (mineral) ko safed non-glazed tile par ragadne se bane churn (powder) ka rang hota hai. Ye khanij ki pehchan ka sabse bharosemand (reliable) tareeka hai kyunki bahri satah ka rang weathering, dhool ya namak se badal jaata hai lekin uski andar ki lakdi (powder) ka rang wahi rehta hai - jaise Hematite bahar se bhoora-kala dikhta hai par uska streak laal hota hai. Lustre chamak, cleavage phatne ki disha, aur hardness khurachne ki khinchat batati hai. Exam point: streak = powder ka rang; khanij pehchan ka sabse pakka test (tile test).

qe: The 'Divergent' movement of plates on a continent usually forms a:
qh: महाद्वीप पर प्लेटों की 'अपसारी' गति आमतौर पर बनाती है:
e: Divergent plate boundary par do plate ek doosre se door jaate hain. Jab ye phatna (rifting) khamandi (continent) ke andar hota hai, to plate khinchne se zameen beech se dhans jaati hai aur do normal faults ke beech ek lamba gehri ghati jaisa ilaaka banta hai - ise rift valley kehte hain, jaise East African Rift, Rhine valley aur Narmada valley. Ye Graben ka bada roop hota hai aur aage chal kar yahin naya samudra ban sakta hai. Fold mountain takrav se banta hai, delta nadi se, aur trench subduction se. Exam point: divergent + continental crust = rift valley; divergent + oceanic crust = mid-oceanic ridge.

qe: What is the common 'Hardness' value for 'Quartz'?
qh: 'क्वार्ट्ज' के लिए सामान्य 'कठोरता' मान क्या है?
e: Quartz (SiO2) ki Mohs scale par hardness 7 hoti hai. Ye duniya ke sabse aam khanijon mein se ek hai - ret (sand) ke kan, granite, aur bahut si chattaano mein milta hai. Iski khaas baat ye hai ki ye rAsayanik (chemical) roop se bahut sthayi hai, isliye weathering se nasht nahi hota aur ret ke roop mein bacha rehta hai. Steel ka knife lagbhag 5.5 tak khurach sakta hai, isliye quartz usse kahin zyada sakht hai; lekin diamond (10) ise aasani se khurach deta hai. Exam point: quartz = 7 (knife steel se sakht, topaz se mulaayam); sone (gold) aur sikka dhoondhne ke liye quartz reef ahem hai.

qe: Which type of 'Process' turns any rock into 'Igneous' again?
qh: कौन सी 'प्रक्रिया' किसी भी शैल को फिर से 'आग्नेय' बना देती है?
e: Koi bhi chattaan (rock) igneous tab banati hai jab wo poori tarah pighal (melt) kar magma banti hai aur phir thandi hokar crystallize ho jaati hai. Isliye melting + solidification dono kadam zaroori hain - sirf garam hona kaafi nahi. Metamorphism mein chattaan taral (liquid) nahi banti, sirf dabaav-garmi se jamaav badalti hai; weathering se chattaan toot-ti hai; aur lithification sediment ko sedimentary banata hai. Exam point: rock cycle ka niyam - igneous = melt (magma) + thanda; sedimentary = deposition + cementation; metamorphic = heat + pressure.

qe: The term 'Felsic' is used for rocks rich in:
qh: 'फेल्सिक' शब्द किन खनिजों से भरपूर चट्टानों के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है:
e: Felsic naam Feldspar aur Silica se bana hai. Aisi chatta mein Silica (SiO2) ki matra 65% se zyada hoti hai tatha Feldspar, quartz aur mica ki prabhutva hoti hai. Iska rang halka (light-coloured) hota hai, ghanatva kam hota hai aur magma garha (viscous) hota hai - isliye iska visphot (explosive eruption) khatarnak hota hai. Granite aur rhyolite iske udaharan hain. Mafic rocks mein Magnesium aur Iron zyada hota hai aur wo gehra rang wale hote hain. Exam point: Felsic = Feldspar + Silica = halka + high silica = Granite; Mafic = dark + magnesium-iron = Basalt.

qe: A 'Dike' is a ______ magmatic intrusion.
qh: 'डाइक' एक ______ मैग्मीय अंतर्भेद है।
e: Dike (dyke) ek magmatic intrusion hai jo ek patli, ekdum lambavat (vertical ya steep) deewar ki tarah hoti hai aur jo pehle se maujood paraton (bedding planes) ko kaat kar upar jaati hai - isliye ise 'discordant' kehte hain. Jab ye satah ke upar nikal aati hai to khai (trench) jaisi uncha deewar dikhti hai. Circular ya horizontal kuchh bhi nahi - sill horizontal aur concordant hoti hai, lopolith tashiya jaisa, aur laccolith dome jaisa hota hai. Exam point: dike = vertical + discordant (strata ko kaatne wali) intrusion; sill = horizontal + concordant (strata ke samantar).

qe: What determines the 'Texture' of a soil?
qh: मिट्टी के 'टेक्सचर' (Texture) को क्या निर्धारित करता है?
o: Particle size and proportions of sand/silt/clay
e: Kisi mitti ki texture (banAvat) uske kanon (particles) ke aakaar aur unke proportion (sand, silt aur clay) se tay hoti hai. Ret (sand) bade kan, silt madhyam aur clay sabse chhote-kan wali hoti hai; clay ki matra zyada hone par mitti paani rok leti hai (water-holding) aur kam hawa jaane deti hai, jabki sandy mitti paani jaldi sokh leti hai. Isi liye kisan sandy, loamy aur clayey mitti ki parakh karte hain aur loam (sand+silt+clay ka mel) sabse upjaau maana jaata hai. Hawa ki raftar ya suraj ki roshni texture se sambandhit nahi. Exam point: soil texture = kanon ka aakaar + unka anupat (sand/silt/clay), isse mitti ka paani rokne ka gun tay hota hai.

qe: Which 'Horizon' of soil is the 'Bedrock' itself?
qh: मिट्टी का कौन सा 'स्तर' स्वयं 'बेडरॉक' (ठोस चट्टान) है?
e: Soil profile ki sabse nichli parat aprakrut (unweathered) matra chattaan (parent rock) ki hoti hai, jise 'R horizon' kehte hain aur iske upar wala bhura (weathered) patthar 'C horizon' hota hai. Horizon A topsoil hai (humus + khanij, yahan se leaching hoti hai), Horizon B subsoil hai jahan leached khanij jama hote hain (illuviation), aur Horizon E ek bura (eluviation) wali halki parat hai. To 'bedrock' ka matlab asli matra chattaan hi hoti hai, na ki A ya C. Exam point: soil profile ka order upar se niche - O, A, E, B, C, R (R = parent rock/bedrock).

qe: Which seismic wave is also called 'Transverse'?
qh: कौन सी भूकंपीय तरंग 'अनुप्रस्थ' (Transverse) भी कहलाती है?
e: S-wave ko 'transverse' ya shear wave isliye kehte hain kyunki isme zameen ke kan (particles) wave ki disha ke lambavat (right angle) hilte hain - jaise rassi ko hilane par uspar banne wali lehar. P-wave longitudinal hoti hai (kan aage-piche hote hain), L-wave aur R-wave surface waves hain. S-wave sirf thos mein chalti hai aur taral (liquid) mein nahi, isliye ye outer core mein nahi jaati - yehi biggest pramaan hai ki bahri core taral hai. Exam point: P = primary + longitudinal + fastest; S = secondary + transverse/shear + solid-only.

qe: What is a 'Piedmont Glacier'?
qh: 'पीडमोंट ग्लेशियर' (Piedmont Glacier) क्या है?
o: A glacier found only at the South Pole
A glacier found on the peaks of mountains
A flat surface of ice formed by the convergence of several glaciers at the base of a mountain
e: Piedmont glacier wo hai jo kai pahadi (alpine) glaciers ke ek jagah milne se pahad ke base par ek samtal (flat) barf ki chadar bana deta hai, jaise Alaska ka Malaspina glacier. Ye pahad se utar kar maidan mein fail jaata hai (pied = panw, mont = pahad). Cirque glacier sirf pahad ke sirsh par hota hai, valley glacier ghati ke andar chalta hai, aur ice sheet vishaal chadar hoti hai. Antarctica ka glacier sabse bada ice sheet hai. Exam point: piedmont = kai glaciers ka mel + pahad ke base par flat sheet; word ka matlab 'pahad ke panw par'.

qe: The process where ice drags and pulls out blocks of rocks from an uneven surface is called:
qh: वह प्रक्रिया जिसमें बर्फ असमान सतह से चट्टानों के टुकड़ों को घसीटती और उखाड़ती है, कहलाती है:
e: Glacier apni tal (base) par chhote-chhote pathron ko barf ke andar jakad kar khinchti hai; jab ye pathar kisi ubhri (uneven) chattaan se takrate hain to barf unhe jakad kar ukhaad (pull out) leti hai - isi ko plucking (quarrying) kehte hain. Ye barf ka achanak jama ho kar khinchna, pighalna aur jamna (freeze-thaw) ka kaam hai. Abrasion uske ulta hai - glacier ke andar phanse pathar tal ko ragad (scratch) kar ghisa dete hain. Hydration rasayanik weathering aur deflation hawa ka kaam hai. Exam point: plucking (ukhad) + abrasion (ragad) = glacial erosion ke do hathiyar; isse U-shaped valley banti hai.

qe: Which armchair-shaped depression is formed by glacial erosion at the head of a glacial valley?
qh: हिमनद घाटी के शीर्ष पर हिमनद अपरदन द्वारा निर्मित कुर्सी के आकार का गर्त कौन सा है?
e: Cirque (corrie ya cwm) ek armchair (kursi) jaisa giradaar khadda hai jo glacier ke sirsh (head) par barf ke pighalne-jamne (freeze-thaw) aur plucking se khudta rehta hai. Iske teen taraf khadi deewarein (headwall) hoti hain aur tal par barf jama rehti hai; jab ye khadda aage chal kar barf se bhar jaata hai to Tarn lake banta hai - isliye cirque hi tarn ka ghar hai. Horn choti-dhar wala shikhar hai, arete do cirque ke beech ki sharp dhaar, aur fiord samundar mein dubi gehri ghati hai. Exam point: cirque = glacial erosion ka kursi jaisa khadda + tarn lake ka sthaan; sabse uncha cirque = 'cirque glacier' ka udgam.

qe: A 'Tarn Lake' is specifically associated with which glacial feature?
qh: 'टार्न झील' (Tarn Lake) विशेष रूप से किस हिमनद विशेषता से जुड़ी है?
e: Tarn lake wo chhoti jheel hoti hai jo ek cirque (glacial kursi jaisa khadda) ke andar paani bharne se banti hai, khaas taur par jab barf pighal kar khadda bhar jaata hai ya moraine uske muhane ko band kar deta hai. Tarn barf pighalne ka paani se bhara sabse saaf aur thanda paani wala jheel hota hai; Himalaya mein Gangotri, Satopanth aur Hemkund jaise tarn milte hain. Drumlin barf ke niche jama gaad se bani ubhri pahaadi, moraine gaad ki dhaar, aur esker barf ke neeche nadi ki gaad se bani dhaar hoti hai. Exam point: tarn = cirque mein bani jheel (pahadi jheel); moraine + tarn dono glaciation ke nishaan hain.

qe: The sharp, pointed peak formed when three or more glaciers erode the same mountain is called a:
qh: जब तीन या अधिक हिमनद एक ही पर्वत का अपरदन करते हैं, तो बनने वाली नुकीली चोटी को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Horn ek tez nokdaar (sharp pointed) shikhar hota hai jo tab banta hai jab teen ya usse zyada glacier (cirque) ek hi pahad ke charon taraf se erosion karte hain. Har cirque apna kursi jaisa khadda aur deewar banata hai; jawab mein beech ka patla ti-kona tukda bach jaata hai jo nok jaisa dikhta hai - ise 'pyramidal peak' bhi kehte hain. Matterhorn (Alps), K2 aur Bhutan ka Jitchu Drake iske mashhoor udaharan hain. Arete do cirque ke beech ki dhaar hai (nok nahi), col do arete ke beech ka nicha darra hai. Exam point: horn = 3+ cirque ka erosion + ti-kona pyraamid shikhar.

qe: What is an 'Arete' in glacial topography?
qh: हिमनद स्थलाकृति में 'अरीट' (Arete) क्या है?
o: A sharp, saw-toothed ridge separating two adjacent cirques
e: Arete ek tez, aari-daant (saw-toothed) jaisi patli dhaar (ridge) hoti hai jo do aas-passi cirque ke beech bachi reh jaati hai - kyunki dono taraf se glacier barf hatate rehte hain aur beech ki patli deewar bach jaati hai. Ye pahadi trekkers ke liye babbar (knife-edge) route hota hai. Cirque kursi jaisa khadda hai, col wo nicha darra hai jahan do arete milte hain, aur gorge nadi ka gehra kattav hai. Exam point: arete = do cirque ke beech ki sharp dhaar; col = do arete ke beech ka pass (crossing point).

qe: Glacial valleys are typically ______ shaped, unlike river valleys which are V-shaped.
qh: नदी घाटियों के विपरीत, जो वी-आकार की होती हैं, हिमनद घाटियाँ आमतौर पर ______ आकार की होती हैं।
e: Nadi ki ghati (river valley) tez paani ke kattav (erosion) se 'V' aakar ki hoti hai kyunki erosion zyada tar niche ki taraf hota hai. Lekin glacier apni giant barf ke karan neeche ke saath-saath kinaron ko bhi ghista (abrade) hai, isliye uska tal chaudi aur tal (base) flat-hoti hai aur ghati 'U' aakar ki ban jaati hai. U-shaped valley ko glacial trough kehte hain; samundar ke paani bhar jaane par ye fiord ban jaati hai. Hawa, insaan ya nadi se U-valley nahi banti. Exam point: V-shaped = nadi (vaigyanik river erosion), U-shaped = glacier (glacial trough) - dono ka antar sawaal mein aata hai.

qe: The 'Col' is a rounded low point or pass between two ______.
qh: 'कोल' (Col) दो ______ के बीच का एक गोलाकार निचला बिंदु या दर्रा है।
e: Col ek giradaar nicha sthaan ya darra (pass) hota hai jo do arete (sharp glacial ridges) ke beech banta hai. Aisa tab hota hai jab pahad ki dhaar ko do taraf ke cirques kat-te hain aur beech ka hissa niche ho jaata hai; yahi se trekkers ek ghati se doosri ghati mein jaate hain. Sand dunes registan mein, deltas nadi ke muhane par aur lagoons bar (spit) ke peechhe bante hain - inmein se koi col nahi hai. Exam point: col = do arete ke beech ka nicha darra (glacial pass); arete = patli sharp dhaar; horn = nokdaar shikhar.

qe: A 'Fiord' is a deep glacial trough that has been filled with:
qh: 'फियोर्ड' (Fiord) एक गहरी हिमनद घाटी है जो किससे भर गई है?
e: Fiord ek gehri, khadi deewar wali U-shaped glacial trough hai jismein glacier pighalne ke baad samundar (sea water) bhar gaya. Aise ilaake pahadon ke kinare hain jahan barf ki ghati samundar tak pahunchti hai - Norway, Alaska, Chile, New Zealand aur Greenland ke fiords mashhoor hain. Fiord ka paani bahut gehra hota hai (kabhi 1000 m se zyada) aur uski banavat mein glacier ka gehra kattav, sea level change aur submergence (doobna) sabhi shamil hain. Glacier ke nahi hone ke karan sand ya jwalamukhi raakh ka koi sambandh nahi. Exam point: fiord = glacial trough + samundar ka paani + khadi deewarein (Norway ka 'fjord country' naam isi se).

qe: The un-sorted and un-stratified debris deposited directly by a melting glacier is called:
qh: पिघलते हिमनद द्वारा सीधे जमा किया गया अवर्गीकृत मलबा क्या कहलाता है?
e: Glacier jab pighalti hai to apna saath laaya hua saara mala (debris) wahin chhod deti hai - ise till ya boulder clay kehte hain. Iski khaas baat ye hai ki ye channa (sorting) hua nahi hota aur paraton (stratification) mein jama nahi hota kyunki barf gaad ko chunti nahi. Isliye till mein bade boulder aur barik clay saath-saath milte hain, jo nadi ke jamaav se bilkul alag pehchan hai (nadi ka gaad chana hua aur paraton mein hota hai). Outwash nadi ke paani se aaya chana hua gaad hai, loess hawa se aaya silt, delta nadi ke muhane ka jamaav. Exam point: glacial till = unsorted + unstratified + direct deposit by ice.

qe: Which depositional feature is a long ridge of debris found along the sides or end of a glacier?
qh: हिमनद के किनारों या अंत में पाया जाने वाला मलबे का लंबा निक्षेप कौन सा है?
e: Moraine wo gaad (debris) ki dhaar hoti hai jo glacier apne saath laati hai aur pighalne par ya kinaron par chhod jaati hai. Lateral moraine glacier ke dono kinaron par, medial moraine do glacier milne par beech mein, ground moraine tal par, aur terminal moraine glacier ke snout (ant) par banti hai. Isse pata chalta hai ki glacier kitni door tak pahunchi thi aur kitni baar badhi-ghati (recessional moraine). Cirque kursi jaisa khadda, esker tal ke neeche nadi ki gaad ki dhaar, aur plunge pool jal-prapat ke niche ka gaddha hota hai. Exam point: moraine = glacier ka chhoda hua gaad; snout par terminal, kinare par lateral, beech mein medial.

qe: An 'Esker' is formed by the deposition of material in a ______ under the ice.
qh: 'एस्कर' (Esker) बर्फ के नीचे एक ______ में सामग्री के निक्षेपण से बनता है।
e: Esker ek lambi, tedhi-medhi (sinuous) aur tang (narrow) dhaar hoti hai jo barf ki chadar ke neeche bahti nadi ki gaad (sand aur gravel) se banti hai. Jab glacier pighal jaati hai to ye purani nadi ki dhaar reverse mein zameen par ubhar kar dikhti hai - jaise ek rel ki line pahadi par. Iska gaad chana hua (sorted) hota hai kyunki paani ne bahaya hai. Moraine unsorted gaad, drumlin oval pahaadi, aur cirque khadda hai. Exam point: esker = barf ke neeche ki nadi ki gaad ki dhaar (sinuous ridge) - glacier ke neeche paani ke behne ka pramaan.

qe: Smooth oval-shaped ridges resembling 'half-cut eggs' are called:
qh: 'आधे कटे अंडे' के समान दिखने वाली चिकनी अंडाकार कटक क्या कहलाती हैं?
e: Drumlin ek ande (egg) jaisi giradaar, chikni aur oval pahaadi hoti hai jo barf ke neeche jama hue till (gaad) se banti hai. Iska ek taraf 'stoss' (garam anuvart, steep nahi) dhalan hota hai jo glacier ki aane ki disha batata hai aur doosri taraf 'tail' (lamba halka dhalan) hoti hai - isliye drumlin se glacier ki disha pata chalti hai (stoss se tail ki taraf). Ye akela ya jhund (swarm) mein milti hai, jaise 'basket of eggs' topography. Sinkhole limestone ka khadda, esker nadi ki dhaar, moraine unsorted dhaar. Exam point: drumlin = oval egg-shaped till pahaadi; stoss aur tail se glacier ki disha nirdharit hoti hai.

qe: In deserts, the process of lifting and removal of loose dust and sand by wind is called:
qh: मरुस्थलों में पवन द्वारा ढीली धूल और रेत को उठाने और हटाने की प्रक्रिया कहलाती है:
e: Deflation (apavahan) wo kriya hai jisme hawa registan ki dheeli (loose) dhool, ret aur barik khanij ko utha kar door le jaati hai - matlab wo gaad ka uthaana aur hatana hai. Ye chhanna (sorting) karti hai kyunki hawa sirf barik kan utha sakti hai, bade pathar bache reh jaate hain. Abrasion uske ulta hai - hawa ke saath chal rahe ret ke kan chattaano ko ragad kar ghisa dete hain. Hydration rasayanik weathering aur saltation hawa mein ret ke kan ka uchhal-uchhal kar chalna hai. Exam point: deflation = uthana aur le jaana (removal); abrasion = ragad kar ghisana; saltation = kanon ka uchhalna.

qe: Which wind-eroded landform is shaped like a 'Mushroom' because of intense erosion near the base?
qh: आधार के पास तीव्र अपरदन के कारण कौन सी भू-आकृति 'मशरूम' के आकार की होती है?
e: Mushroom rock (pedestal rock) wo chattaan hai jiska upari hissa chaudi (chhatri) aur nichla hissa patla (dand) dikhta hai - isliye naam 'mushroom' pada. Iski wajah ye hai ki hawa zameen ki satah ke paas hi ret ke kan lekar tez chalti hai (sand-blast), isliye tal ke paas ka hissa zyada ghista hai aur upar chhata bach jaata hai. Ye abrasion aur deflation ka milkar banaya aakaar hai. Playa registan ki namki jheel, barchan ret ka tila, inselberg ekal (isolated) pahaadi hai. Exam point: mushroom rock = tal ke paas tez abrasion + upar ka chhat bachna (sand-blasted by wind).

qe: A flat-topped isolated hill with steep sides, remaining after surrounding areas are eroded in a desert, is called:
qh: मरुस्थल में आसपास के क्षेत्रों के अपरदित होने के बाद बची हुई चपटी चोटी वाली अलग-थलग पहाड़ी कहलाती है:
e: Inselberg ek ekal (isolated), choti si, chapti choti (flat-topped) aur khadi deewar wali pahaadi hoti hai jo registan ke beech se ubhri dikhti hai. Ye asal mein puraani chattaan ka wo tukda hai jo aas-paas ke ilaake ke ghulne-ghisne (erosion) ke baad bach gaya - matlab ye 'residual' hill hai. Africa ke Kalahari, Australia ke outback aur Thar mein ye milti hai; Deccan ke granite inselbergs bhi mashhoor hain. Playa namki jheel, esker glacial dhaar, delta nadi ka jamaav hai. Exam point: inselberg = registan mein bacha hua puraani chattaan ka residual pahaadi (aas-paas sab ghul-ghis gaya).

qe: What is a 'Playa' in a desert environment?
qh: मरुस्थलीय वातावरण में 'प्लाया' (Playa) क्या है?
o: A shallow, temporary salt lake in a basin
e: Playa ek shallow, thoda gehri aur aarzi (temporary) namki (salt) jheel hoti hai jo registan ke andar ke basin (gaddha) mein banti hai. Barsaat aane par paani bhar jaata hai aur garmi mein wo vaashpit (evaporate) ho jaata hai, jisse usme ghula namak (salt, gypsum, boron) satah par jam jaata hai - tab us jheel ko 'salt pan' ya 'saline flat' kehte hain. Aise basin mein paani bahar nikal hi nahi sakta, isliye yahan endorheic (band) drainage hota hai. Thar mein Sambhar jheel aisa hi salt lake hai. Exam point: playa = registan ki aarzi namki jheel + endorheic basin + salt flat.

qe: Crescent-shaped sand dunes with 'horns' pointing downwind are called:
qh: पवन की दिशा में 'सींगों' वाली अर्धचंद्राकार रेत के टीलों को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Barchan ek chandrama (crescent) ke aakar ka ret ka tila hota hai jiske do siRa (horns) hawa ki disha ke saath aage ki taraf moote (point) karte hain. Iska hawa ki taraf wala dhalan halka (gentle) hota hai jahan se kan hawa mein uchhalte hain, aur hawa ke doosri ore wala dhalan khada (steep) hota hai jahan gaad gir kar jama hoti hai. Isi wajah se tila dheere-dheere hawa ki disha mein aage sarkta hai - isliye barchan hawa ki disha ka pakka ishara hai. Seif lamba longitudinal tila, transverse tila hawa ke lambavat, aur loess hawa se aaya silt. Exam point: barchan = crescent tila + horns downwind (hawa ki disha mein).

qe: The vast, uniform deposits of wind-blown silt found far from deserts are called:
qh: मरुस्थलों से दूर पाए जाने वाले पवन-जनित गाद के विशाल, एकसमान निक्षेप कहलाते हैं:
e: Loess hawa se ud kar door tak pahunchi hui barik silt aur dhool ka mota, chana hua (uniform) aur bina paraton wala jamaav hai. Ye registan ke kinaron aur barfani ilaakon ke aas-paas milta hai kyunki barf pighalne se nikale silt aur dhool hawa uthati hai aur door jama kar deti hai. Loess ki mitti bahut upjaau hoti hai, isliye China ka Huang He (Yellow River) plain - duniya ka sabse bada loess kshetra - bahut ghani aabadi wala hai. Dunes ret ke tila, moraine glacial gaad, delta nadi ka muhane ka jamaav hai. Exam point: loess = wind-blown fine silt (very fertile soil), source = registan ya glacial outwash.

qe: Which of the following is a result of 'Deflation' that creates hollows in the desert?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन 'अपवहन' का परिणाम है जो मरुस्थल में गर्त बनाता है?
e: Deflation hollows (blowouts) wo gaddhe (depressions) hote hain jo deflation (utha kar le jaana) kriya ke karan ek hi jagah se poori dhool aur ret hat jaane par bante hain. Jab hawaek jhonka barik gaad ko uthata hi rehta hai aur koi naya gaad nahi aata, to satah niche dhas jaati hai - isi tarah Qattara aur bahut si registani oases wale gaddhe bane hain. Ye gaddhe kabhi-kabhi bade nadi jaisa aakar le lete hain. Sand bars nadi ke andar, V-shaped valleys nadi ke, moraines glacier ke aakaar hain. Exam point: deflation hollow/blowout = hawa se gaad uthakar bana khadda; registan mein bade bed (basin) isi se bante hain.

qe: In 'Rock Creep', what causes the movement?
qh: 'रॉक क्रीप' (Rock Creep) में संचलन का क्या कारण है?
o: Gravity acting on jointed rock blocks over time
e: Rock creep (bhumi-kshay ka dheema roop) mein chattaan ke blocks joints (puriya) ke karan alag-alag rehte hain; gurutvakarshan in sadhi (jointed) blocks ko saalon mein thoda-thoda niche sarka deta hai. Baarish ka paani joints mein ja kar barf ban jaata hai aur failta hai, ya garmi-thandak se phailav-sikudav hoti hai - isse joints chaudi hoti jaati hain aur block aage fisalta hai. Iska pramaan tirche pad gaye stambh aur deewaron ke jhukav se milta hai. Magnetic pull, nadi ka paani ya jwalamukhi ki raakh iske chalayak (driver) nahi hain. Exam point: rock creep = gravity + jointed rock blocks ka dheema sarkav (years mein cm), freeze-thaw ise tez karta hai.

qe: What is the 'diurnal temperature' range in deserts, and how does it help weathering?
qh: मरुस्थलों में 'दैनिक तापांतर' क्या है, और यह अपक्षय में कैसे मदद करता है?
o: Very high; causes constant expansion and contraction of rocks
e: Registan ki hawa mein jallvaashp (water vapour) bahut kam hoti hai, isliye din mein suraj ki tez garmi patthar ko bahut garam kar deti hai aur raat mein vikiran (thermal radiation) se tapman bahut tez gir jaata hai - din-raat ka tapman antar 30 degree C se bhi zyada (diurnal range) ho jaata hai. Isi se chattaan baar-baar failti aur sikudti hai, andar tanav (stress) paida hota hai, aur daraar (crack) ke saath patthar ki upari parat chhat (exfoliation) ki tarah utar jaati hai. Ye thermal stress weathering ka classic udaharan hai. Ocean waves isse sambandhit nahi. Exam point: desert ka high diurnal range = baar-baar failna-sikudna = chattaan ka shattering aur exfoliation.

qe: Which state of matter describes a glacier's flow?
qh: ग्लेशियर के बहाव को पदार्थ की कौन सी अवस्था वर्णित करती है?
e: Glacier aankhon mein thos (solid) dikhti hai, lekin lakhon ton barf ke bhaar, dabaav aur talay (base) par pighalne ke karan ye plastic ya viscous padarth ki tarah dheere-dheere behne lagti hai (1 se 100 m per saal) - isliye glacier ko 'solid jo beh jaati hai' kehte hain. Iska flow upari part (uplift) aur tal ke regelation (jamne-pighalne) se hota hai, aur tez glacier ghatiyon se turant beh sakti hai. Soild ke bahav (plastic flow) ki isi khaas gunavatta ki wajah se glacial erosion aur glacial landforms bante hain. Gas, liquid ya plasma nahi. Exam point: glacier = solid magar plastic/viscous flow karne wali - solid state mein bahav.

qe: The term 'Outwash Plain' refers to a ______ feature.
qh: 'आउटवाश प्लेन' शब्द एक ______ विशेषता को संदर्भित करता है।
e: Outwash plain wo samtal (flat) maidan hai jo glacier ke snout (ant) se bahri paani ki nadiyan barf ke basne ke saath paani ke behav se chana hua ret-kankar (sorted sand and gravel) chhod jaati hain - isliye ye nirmanatmak (depositional) landform hai. Iska gaad till se alag hai kyunki paani ne barik gaad kar aur baad wale gaad ko door le ja kar channa (sorted) kar diya hota hai. Icelandic aur Alps ke sandur (outwash plains) bade mashhoor hain. Erosional features wo hain jo kisi agent ne kat kar banaye (jaise U-valley). Exam point: outwash plain = depositional (glaci-fluvial) maidan; sorted + stratified gaad, glacier ke aage banata hai.

qe: Which factor is most responsible for 'Lateral Erosion' in glaciers?
qh: हिमनदों में 'पार्श्विक अपरदन' (Lateral Erosion) के लिए कौन सा कारक सर्वाधिक उत्तरदायी है?
o: The sheer mass and movement of ice against the side walls
e: Glacier ka gehra bhura (mass) jahan bhi chalta hai wahan khadi kinare ki deewaron (side walls) par dabav dalta hai aur unhe barf ke andar jakade hue pathron ki madad se ghista hai - isi ko lateral erosion kehte hain. Jab ek aisi hi barf phail kar chaudi ghati ban jaati hai (U-shaped valley), tab uski chaudai bhi isi lateral erosion aur plucking se badhti hai. Rainfall, sunlight ya wind speed glacier ke lateral erosion ke liye zimeddar nahi hain. Exam point: lateral erosion = khadi deewaron ko kaatna (glacier ki chaudai badhna); vertical erosion = tal ko gehra karna (valley deepening).

qe: What is 'Salt Weathering' in a desert?
qh: मरुस्थल में 'नमक अपक्षय' (Salt Weathering) क्या है?
o: Expansion of salt crystals in rock pores due to temperature changes
e: Registan mein chattaan ke chhote-chhote ched (pores) aur daraaro mein khaari paani ka namak (salt) ghus jaata hai; garmi mein paani vaashpit ho jaata hai aur namak ke kiran (crystals) banta hai. Namak ke kiran badhne par chhat par bahut dabav dalte hain aur pathar ko tod-fod dete hain - isi ko salt weathering kehte hain. Ye khaar se sookhe-registani ilaake, samundri kinare aur aisi jagah aam hai jahan namak-tuphan (dust of salt) hawa se aata hai. Pathar khaana ya sand se namak banna physical sense nahi rakhta. Exam point: salt weathering = namak ke crystal ka failav (expansion) se chattaan ka tootna - desert aur coastal region ki aam kriya.

qe: A 'Pediment' is an erosional surface located at the foot of a:
qh: 'पेडिमेंट' (Pediment) किसके आधार पर स्थित एक अपरदित सतह है?
e: Pediment ek bahut halki dhalan wali (bahut kam dhaal) patthariya satah hai jo registan mein pahad ya cliff ke panw (foot) par faili hui hai. Ye ek erosional surface hai - matlab ye pahad se aaye gaad ke hatne (removal) se bacha hua paththar ka bahav hai jise hawa aur aarzi nadiyan kat-ti rehti hain. Isi tarah ki satah par aage inselberg khadi reh jaati hai. River ter, glacial U-valley ya ocean floor par aisa aakaar nahi banta. Exam point: pediment = registan mein pahad ke panw ki halki dhalan wali erosional satah (bajada + playa ke saath mila registani tal).

qe: Which type of 'Moraine' is formed when two valley glaciers merge, combining their lateral moraines?
qh: जब दो घाटी हिमनद मिलते हैं, तो उनके पार्श्व हिमोढ़ों के जुड़ने से कौन सा 'हिमोढ़' (Moraine) बनता है?
e: Jab do valley glaciers ek doosri ghati mein milkar ek bada glacier ban jaate hain, to dono ki lateral moraines aapas mein mil jaati hain aur ek hi dhaar bagal se beech (centre) mein aa jaati hai - isi ko medial moraine kehte hain. Isliye medial moraine ka hona ye batata hai ki aage (upar) do glacier mil kar ek bane hain. Terminal moraine glacier ke ant (snout) par, recessional moraine pichhe hatte samay ki rukawaton par, aur ground moraine tal par faili hoti hai. Exam point: medial = do glacier ke milne se beech mein bani moraine; glacier ke vikas (confluence) ka sabse acha pramaan.

qe: What describes 'Abrasion' in glacial action?
qh: हिमनद क्रिया में 'अपघर्षण' (Abrasion) का वर्णन क्या है?
o: The scratching/scraping of the bedrock by rocks embedded in the ice
e: Abrasion (gharshan) glacier ka wo kaam hai jisme barf ke andar jakade hue pathar, ret aur kan ghis kar tal aur kinaron ko ragadte hain - isse chattaan par lambe-lambe kharaash (striations) aur chamkile-chanak (polished) jal (surface) ban jaate hain. Ye ek dheema par bhartpur (powerful) ghisaav hai jo seedha glacier ke bhare hue bhaar ke karan hota hai. Ice ka pighalna, hawa ka behna ya aasman se pathron ka girna iska varnan nahi karta. Exam point: abrasion = barf mein phase pathron se tal/kinaron ka ghisna (striations + polish); plucking = pathron ka ukhad kar nikalna.

qe: The 'Stoss' and 'Tail' sides are parts of which landform?
qh: 'स्टॉस' और 'पूंछ' (Tail) किस भू-आकृति के भाग हैं?
e: Drumlin ke do dhalan alag-alag hote hain: ek taraf 'stoss' (garam, thoda khada) dhalan hota hai - ye glacier ki aane ki disha (upstream) batata hai, aur doosri taraf 'tail' (lamba, halka) dhalan hota hai - ye bahav ki disha (downstream) batata hai. Barf ke neeche jama till ke upar se glacier ka bahav ise ande jaisa aakaar deta hai aur stoss ko thoda kasa (compact) kar deta hai. Isliye drumlins ke jhund (swarm) se puraani glacier ke bahav ki disha nikal sakti hai. Barchan hawa ka, moraine gaad ki dhaar, fiord samundar mein dubi ghati hai. Exam point: drumlin ka stoss = glacier aane ki disha, tail = jaane ki disha ('basket of eggs' topography).

qe: What results when a 'Playa' dries up and leaves behind salt deposits?
qh: जब 'प्लाया' सूख जाता है और नमक के निक्षेप छोड़ जाता है, तो क्या बनता है?
e: Playa ke paani ka vaashp (evaporation) ho jaane ke baad usme ghule namak (sodium chloride, sodium sulfate, borax, gypsum) satah par safed parat ki tarah jama ho jaate hain - isi ko alkali flats (salt pans) kehte hain. Aise ilaake mein paani bahar nahi nikal sakta (endorheic basin) aur paani ka mausam aarzi hota hai; Bundelkhand-rajasthan ke Sambhar aur Sahara ke chott jaisa talaab aise hi banti hai. U-valleys glacier ki, moraines glacial gaad ki aur sand dunes hawa ke nirmanatmak aakaar hain. Exam point: playa ka sookhna = alkali flats (salt pan) - endorheic basin ka sabse saaf nishaan.

qe: The term 'Hamada' in a desert refers to:
qh: मरुस्थल में 'हमादा' (Hamada) शब्द का तात्पर्य है:
e: Hamada (ya hamada) registan ka wo hissa hai jo pathariya (rocky) aur hawa se saaf ki hui chattaan wali satah hota hai - yahan ret nahi, sirf nangi chattaan aur bade pathar milte hain kyunki hawa ne saara barik gaad utha kar door kar diya. Iske doosre saathi hain - reg (pathar aur gravel se dhaka maidan) aur erg (ret ke tila wala kshetra). Isliye 'hamada' ka matlab sandy desert nahi, balki pathariya registani plateau hai (jaise Sahara ka Hamada du Draa). Exam point: registan ke 3 roop - hamada (pathariya), reg (gravel/pebbles), erg (ret ke tila).

qe: What is 'Shattering' in desert weathering?
qh: मरुस्थलीय अपक्षय में 'शटरिंग' (Shattering) क्या है?
o: Disintegration of rocks into angular fragments due to thermal stress
e: Registan mein din ke waqt suraj ki tez dhoop chattaan ko bahut garam karti hai aur raat mein thandak ke saath achanak sikudav (contraction) aata hai. Ye baar-baar failna-sikudna (thermal stress) chattaan ke andar daraar paida karta hai, aur chattaan chhote-kone (angular) tukdon mein toot jaati hai - isi ko shattering kehte hain. Ye thermal weathering ka roop hai aur registan mein pathariya satah (hamada) ke bante ka kaaran hai. Pathar ka pighalna ya kisi gaar mein hawa bhar jaana isse alag hai. Exam point: shattering = thermal stress se chattaan ka kone-kone tukdon mein tootna (desert weathering); iska phal hamada aur pathariya registan.

qe: Which mineral is the hardest on the Mohs scale?
qh: मोह स्केल पर कौन सा खनिज सबसे कठोर है?
e: Mohs scale par sabse sakht (hardest) khanij Diamond hai jiski hardness 10 hai. Diamond pure carbon ka ek crystalline roop hai jo zameen ki gehrai mein bahut tez dabaav aur garmi se banta hai, aur uske carbon atoms char-Children (tetrahedral) jaali mein poore taur par jude hote hain isliye use khurach pana mushkil hai. Corundum 9 par, Topaz 8 par aur Quartz 7 par hote hain, matlab ye sab diamond se mulaayam hain. Diamond ki isi sakhti ke karan ise drill bits aur cutting tools mein lagta hai. Exam point: Mohs hardness - 7 Quartz, 8 Topaz, 9 Corundum, 10 Diamond (sabse sakht).

qe: What happens at a 'Convergent' plate boundary?
qh: 'अभिसरण' (Convergent) प्लेट सीमा पर क्या होता है?
o: Plates move towards each other, leading to subduction or mountain building
e: Convergent (khandan/waste) plate boundary par do plate ek doosre ki taraf chal kar takrate hain. Do tarah ke nateeje hote hain: agar ek samudri plate doosri continental plate ke neeche dhansa (subduction) to deep trench + volcanic island arc + bhukamp bante hain (jaise Andes, Japan); aur agar do continental plate takrai to unki chattaan mud kar bade fold mountains bante hain (jaise Himalaya). Plate ghumne, khinchne ya faelne ki baatein divergent aur transform boundaries ki hain. Exam point: convergent = plate aapas mein takrate hain = subduction + Himalaya type fold mountain + Ring of Fire ke bhukamp.

qe: The 'Reg' desert is characterized by being ______.
qh: 'रेग' (Reg) मरुस्थल की विशेषता क्या है?
e: Reg ek registani maidan hota hai jo chhote-chhote pathron aur gravel (kankar) se dhaka hota hai - yahan barik ret aur dhool hawa ne utha kar door pahuncha di hoti hai. Iska naam 'reg' Arabic se aaya hai aur Sahara, Arabian aur Thar ke kuch ilaake aise hain. Isliye reg ko sandy desert nahi samjho; pura sandy desert 'erg' kehlata hai aur pathariya satah 'hamada'. Chhote kankar wahan bach jaate hain jahan hawa barik barik kan utha leti hai (deflation). Exam point: reg = gravel/pebbles wala registani maidan (na sandy erg, na rocky hamada).

qe: Which force is primarily responsible for forming 'Rift Valleys'?
qh: 'भ्रंश घाटियाँ' (Rift Valleys) बनाने के लिए मुख्य रूप से कौन सा बल जिम्मेदार है?
e: Rift valley tension (khinchav) bal se banti hai. Jab plates door khisakte hain to upari chattaan phat jaati hai aur do normal faults ke beech ka bada tukda neeche dhans jaata hai - isi dhansi patti ko rift valley (graben) kehte hain, jaise East African Rift, Narmada-Tapi valley, Rhine valley aur Baikal. Compression (dabav) se fold mountains bante hain, tidal force samundar mein, aur erosion sirf upar ki satah ka kaam hai. Exam point: rift valley = tension (pulling apart) + normal faults + beech ka dhansa block (graben).

qe: A 'V-shaped' valley becomes a 'U-shaped' valley due to ______ action.
qh: एक 'वी-आकार' की घाटी ______ क्रिया के कारण 'यू-आकार' की घाटी बन जाती है।
e: Nadi ki ghati tez paani ke vertical kattav se 'V' aakar ki banti hai. Lekin jab usi ghati mein glacier aa kar chalti hai, to barf ghati ki dono deewaron ko chaudi (lateral erosion) aur tal ko barabar (glacial abrasion) karti hai, isliye ghati ka profile U aakar ka (chaudi tal wala) ho jaata hai - ise glacial trough kehte hain aur samundar bharne par ye fiord ban jaati hai. Hawa, insaan ya nadi khud U-valley nahi bana sakte. Exam point: V to U valley = glacial action; nadi ki V-ghati badal kar glacier se U-ghati banti hai (dono ka antar exam favourite hai).

qe: The term 'Barchan' comes from the shape of a ______.
qh: 'बरखान' शब्द का आकार किसके समान होता है?
e: Barchan tila ka naam uske aakaar se pada - crescent (chandrama), kyunki uska leeward kinara ghuma hua aur dono siRe (horns) aage ki taraf nikle hote hain. Ye hawa ki disha se banta hai: hawa ret ke kanon ko utha kar obar (gentle) slope par chadhati hai aur khadi slope se gira kar aage badhati hai, isliye tila chandrama jaisa mud jaata hai. Square, triangle ya circle aakaar se hawa tikau (stable) nahi rehti, isliye registan mein tila in aakaaron mein nahi banta. Exam point: barchan = crescent (chandrama) shape, horns downwind (hawa ki disha mein).

qe: Which seismic wave is the first to arrive at a seismograph?
qh: सीस्मोग्राफ पर सबसे पहले कौन सी भूकंपीय तरंग पहुँचती है?
e: Bhukamp ki P-wave (primary) sabse tez chalti hai - lagbhag 6-8 km/s - isliye seismograph par sabse pehle wahi record hoti hai. Ye longitudinal (dhakka wali) wave hai jo solid, liquid aur gas sabhi mein chal sakti hai. S-wave uske baad pahunchti hai (shear wave, sirf solid mein), aur L-wave ya R-wave (surface waves) sabse der se pahunchti hain par sabse zyada nuksan karti hain. Isi waqt antar (time difference) se bhukamp ke kendra (epicentre) ki doori nikalti hai. Exam point: P-wave = first arrival (fastest) + longitudinal; S-wave = second; surface waves = slowest + most destructive.

qe: What mineral is the primary component of 'Limestone'?
qh: 'चूना पत्थर' का प्राथमिक घटक कौन सा खनिज है?
e: Limestone ka mukhya khanij Calcite (calcium carbonate, CaCO3) hai jo samudri jeevon ke khol (shells) aur chuna-reh kar jama hone se banta hai. Calcite halka rasayanik amliya paani (carbonated water) mein ghul jaata hai, isliye limestone mein karst topography (sinkhole, cave, stalactite) banti hai aur wo cement, chuna aur construction mein istemal hota hai. Talc sabse mulaayam khanij hai, mica patariya (flake) hai aur quartz bahut sakht - ye limestone ke mukhya hisse nahi hain. Exam point: limestone = calcite (CaCO3) = karst + cement industry ka aadhar; marble limestone ka metamorphic roop hai.

qe: Which type of fold has both limbs tilted in the same direction at similar angles?
qh: किस प्रकार के वलन में दोनों भुजाएँ एक ही दिशा में समान कोणों पर झुकी होती हैं?
e: Isocline (isoclinal fold) wo fold hota hai jismein dono limbs (bagal) ek hi disha mein ek jaise kon (angle) par jhuke hue hote hain - matlab dono taraf ke parat lagbhag samantar (parallel) dikhte hain. Ye bahut tez dabaav (compression) ki nishani hai jo pahadi patti (orogenic belt) mein milta hai, aur aise folds mein kabhi-kabhi purani chattaan nayi ke upar chadh jaati hai. Symmetrical fold mein dono limb barabar angle par ulti disha mein hote hain, asymmetrical mein ek zyada jhuka hota hai, aur recumbent fold leta (horizontal) ho jaata hai. Exam point: isocline = dono limbs ek hi disha mein ek jaise jhuke; iska agla charan recumbent fold hai.

qe: The study of the relationship between Earth's materials and landforms is part of:
qh: पृथ्वी के पदार्थों और भू-आकृतियों के बीच संबंधों का अध्ययन किसका हिस्सा है?
e: Geomorphology bhautik bhugol ki wo shakha hai jo prithvi ki satah ke aakaar (landforms) aur unhe banane wale padarth (chattaan, mitti) tatha prakriyavon (nadi, hawa, glacier, hawa) ke sambandh ka adhyayan karti hai. Ismein pahadi, ghati, tila, delta, karst sab aate hain aur ye batati hai ki kaunsi kriya kaunsa aakaar banati hai. Meteorology hawa tatha mausam ka, climatology jalvaayu ka aur oceanography samundar ka adhyayan karti hai. Exam point: geo = prithvi, morph = aakaar; geomorphology = landform + unki utpatti/ vikas ka vigyaan (Davis, Penck iske bade naam hain).

qe: What happens to the density of Earth as we go deeper?
qh: गहराई में जाने पर पृथ्वी के घनत्व का क्या होता है?
e: Prithvi ke andar gehrai mein jaane par ghanatva (density) badhta jaata hai - satah ke nazdik wali chattaan ka ghanatva lagbhag 2.7-3.0 g/cm3 hota hai, mantle ka 3.3-5.5 g/cm3 aur core ka 10 se 13 g/cm3. Iska kaaran ye hai ki gehre hisse bhaari dhaatu (iron-nickel) se bane hain, upar ki chattaan halki silicates se, aur poore grah par gurutvakarshan ka dabav badhta hai jisse padarth kas jata hai. Density kabhi ghatti nahi aur shunya to bilkul nahi hoti. Exam point: depth badhne par density - crust (2.7) se core (13) tak badhti hai; yahi prithvi ki paraton (layers) ka aadhar hai.

qe: Do water particles in an ocean 'Wave' travel horizontally across the sea?
qh: क्या समुद्री 'तरंग' (Wave) में पानी के कण क्षैतिज रूप से समुद्र के पार यात्रा करते हैं?
o: Yes, they flow like a river
Only if it is a tsunami
No, they only oscillate in a circular motion at the same spot
e: Samundar ki leher (wave) mein paani kan (particles) apni jagah par hi ek giradaar (circular) path par upar-neeche ghoomte rehte hain, wo leher ke saath aage nahi bahate. Leher sirf energy ka sancharan (energy transfer) hai, paani ka nahi - isliye ek hi jagah tairta hua kagaz leher ke saath aage-peeche hilta hai par jal (current) ki tarah door nahi pahunchta (pahunchne ke liye current chahiye, jo gravity, hawa aur salt/taapman ke antar se banta hai). Haan, tsunami ya tide mein paani ka asli star (level) badalta hai. Exam point: leher = energy transfer (paani particle circular oscillation), current = paani ka asli behav.

qe: At which part of the ocean is the oscillation of water particles highest?
qh: महासागर के किस भाग में पानी के कणों का दोलन (Oscillation) सर्वाधिक होता है?
e: Leher ke ek giradaar (orbit) mein paani ke kanon ki gati (oscillation) surface par sabse zyada hoti hai kyunki hawa ka jhonka seedha satah par kaam karta hai aur kan poora giradaar poora karte hain; gehrai badhne par ye gati tezi se ghatti jaati hai aur lagbhag aadhi wavelength ki gehrai par zero ho jaati hai. Isi liye gehra samundar mein bhi leher ka asar satah tak hi rehta hai aur tal par rehne wale jeev isse bahut kam prabhavit hote hain. Surface par sabse zyada uchhal (oscillation) = sabse zyada energy aur erosion. Exam point: wave energy surface par maximum, gehrai ke saath lagbhag zero (half wavelength tak).

qe: Which force is primarily responsible for the generation of ocean waves?
qh: समुद्री तरंगों की उत्पत्ति के लिए मुख्य रूप से कौन सा बल जिम्मेदार है?
e: Samundar ki adhikansh lehrein (waves) hawa ke samundar ki satah par behne se banti hain - hawa ke jhonke paani ko dhakElte hain aur gharshan se giradaar (orbital) gati paida hoti hai. Isliye hawa ki raftar aur der (duration) tatha 'fetch' (khula paani) jitna zyada, leher utni unchi hoti hai. Iske alawa bhukamp, samudri bhu-skhalan aur jwalamukhi se tsunami (giant wave) banti hai, aur chandrama-suraj ki gravitation se tide aate hain - par rozana ki waves wind ka kaam hain. Exam point: waves = wind ka prakop (wind speed + fetch), tsunami = earthquake (not wind), tides = moon-sun gravity.

qe: The vertical wall-like rocky landform facing the sea is called a:
qh: समुद्र की ओर मुख वाली ऊर्ध्वाधर दीवार जैसी चट्टानी भू-आकृति कहलाती है:
e: Cliff ek khadi, ~lambavat (vertical) chattaan ki deewar hai jo samundar ki taraf hai - ye samundri lehron ke kattav (marine erosion) se banti hai. Iske tal par lehrein dabav aur ret-pathar se gharshan (abrasion + hydraulic action) karti rehti hain, aur khadi deewar ke upari hisse ko support nahi milta, isliye wo gir (collapse) jaata hai aur naya cliff peeche (landward) ban jaata hai. Isi liye cliff ko 'retreating (piche hadne wala)' cliff kehte hain. Delta nadi ke muhane ka jamaav, beach aur dune nirmanatmak (depositional) hain. Exam point: cliff = marine erosion ka khada boat; base kat-ti hai to top girta hai aur cliff pichhe hatta hai.

qe: Cliffs are said to be 'Retreating' in nature because:
qh: क्लिफ स्वभाव में 'पीछे हटने वाले' (Retreating) कहे जाते हैं क्योंकि:
o: Wave erosion at the base causes the top to collapse, shifting the cliff landward
e: Cliffs pichhe (landward) hatte (retreat) rehte hain kyunki samundar ki lehrein cliff ke tal (base) par ek notch (khadda, wave-cut notch) kaat-ti rehti hain. Jab ye khadda itna gehra ho jaata hai ki upar ka bhaari pathar ko support nahi milta, to wo gir (collapse) jaata hai aur cliff ki position peeche sarak jaati hai. Isi tarah lambi samay mein bahut chaudi wave-cut platform banti hai. Wo grow taller, sink ya walk away nahi karte, aur basa (soil) le jaana isse alag hai. Exam point: cliff retreat = tal par notch ka banna + upar ka pathar ka girna; isi se wave-cut platform banati hai.

qe: What is a 'Wave-cut Terrace'?
qh: 'तरंग-कर्तित वेदिका' (Wave-cut Terrace) क्या है?
o: A flat platform at the base of a cliff formed by wave erosion
e: Wave-cut terrace (platform) ek lagbhag samtal (flat) pathariya satah hoti hai jo cliff ke tal (base) par samundar ki lehron ke kattav se banti hai. Ye tab banati hai jab cliff peeche hatte rehta hai aur uske aage ghisi hui chattaan ki satah bach jaati hai; kuch hissa to low tide par khula dikhta hai. Puraani terrace samundar ki satah ke badalne (uplift ya sea level fall) ka pramaan bhi hoti hai. Mountain peak, river island ya sand dune isse alag cheezein hain. Exam point: wave-cut terrace = cliff ke base par samtal pathariya platform (marine erosion ka nishaan).

qe: A hollow space carved into a cliff at the sea level by wave impact is called a:
qh: तरंगों के प्रभाव से समुद्र तल पर क्लिफ में नक्काशीदार खोखली जगह कहलाती है:
e: Sea cave ek khokhla (hollow) sthaan hai jo cliff ke andar samundar ki satah (sea level) par ban jaata hai. Lehrein jab fault, joint ya naram (soft) chattaan ki daraar par hydraulic pressure aur abrasion se vaar karti hain, to daraar chaudi hokar gaar (cave) ban jaati hai. Agar ye gaar aar-paar nikal jaaye to sea arch banta hai, aur arch girne par sea stack bach jaata hai. Exam point: sea cave = samundar ki satah par cliff ke andar khokhla (wave erosion); aage ka charan = sea arch phir sea stack.

qe: When wave erosion pierces through a headland, creating a bridge-like structure, it is called a:
qh: जब तरंग अपरदन एक अंतरीप के आर-पार छेद कर देता है और पुल जैसी आकृति बनाता है, तो उसे क्या कहते हैं?
e: Sea arch ek pool jaisi sanrachna (bridge-like) hoti hai jo headland (aage nikalte huye patthar) ke aar-paar (through) samundar ki lehron ke kattav se ban jaati hai. Pehle dono taraf se sea cave banti hai, phir wo aapas mein mil jaati hain aur beech ka pathar chhat (roof) jaisa reh jaata hai - ise arch kehte hain (jaise Neil Island ka Natural Bridge). Ye arch aage gir jaaye to alag khada stambh (stack) bach jaata hai. Stack, spit aur window (shutter) isse alag aakaar hain. Exam point: cave (do taraf) + beech ki chhat = sea arch; arch girna = sea stack.

qe: What is a 'Sea Stack'?
qh: 'सी स्टैक' (Sea Stack) क्या है?
o: An isolated pillar of rock left in the sea after an arch collapses
e: Sea stack ek alag khada pathar ka stambh (pillar) hota hai jo samundar mein khada milta hai. Ye tab banta hai jab sea arch ki chhat (roof) gir (collapse) jaati hai aur arch ke dono kinaron wale stambh bache reh jaate hain - kyunki stack ki chattaan khaas taur par sakht (hard) hoti hai jo lehron ko zyada der tak rok leti hai. Isliye stack kabhi-kabhi alag chattaan ke roop mein pehchan banta hai (jaise Scotland ka Old Man of Hoy). Sand ka dher, deep trench ya coral reef isse alag cheezein hain. Exam point: sea stack = arch girne ke baad bacha hua khada stambh; iski uchai sabse pehle kat jaaye to stump banta hai.

qe: The eroded remnant of a sea stack that is barely visible above water is called a:
qh: समुद्री स्टैक का वह अपरदित अवशेष जो पानी के ऊपर मुश्किल से दिखाई देता है, कहलाता है:
e: Stump wo sea stack ka ghisa hua avshesh hai jo samundar ki satah par lagbhag dikh nahi paata aur high tide par poori tarah doob jaata hai. Lehrein kabhi-kabhi sabse pehle stack ke sirsh (top) ko tod-ti hain, isliye uski uchai ghatti rehti hai aur wo dheere-dheere chhota ho kar pani ke andar chala jaata hai. Isi tarah samundri erosion ke chakra (cliff - cave - arch - stack - stump) ke aakhir (last) charan ka nishaan milta hai. Arch aur cave abhi nirman ke charan hain, beach aur dune nirmanatmak (depositional) hain. Exam point: marine erosion ka chakra = cave - arch - stack - stump (ek hi kram mein).

qe: Which 'Depositional' feature is made of sand and shingles found along the coast?
qh: तट के किनारे पाया जाने वाला रेत और कंकड़ों से बना कौन सा 'निक्षेप' लक्षण है?
e: Beach ek samundri kinare ka nirmanatmak (depositional) aakaar hai jo ret aur kankar (shingle) se bana hota hai. Ye samundri lehron aur currents dwara le aaye gaad (sediment) ke jama hone se banta hai, aur iska dhalan halka hota hai. Beach material ka source chattaan ka katav, nadi ka gaad aur samundri jeevon ke khol (shells) hote hain. Prithvi ki 30% se zyada aabadi to kinaron ke nazdik rehti hai isliye beachs aarthik aur paryaavaran drishti se bahut ahem hain. Cliff, gorge aur arch erosional features hain. Exam point: beach = depositional (sand+shingle), samundri gaad ka jamaav (Marina, Juhu jaise).

qe: A beach dominated by large pebbles and cobbles (rather than fine sand) is called a:
qh: बारीक रेत के बजाय बड़े पत्थरों और कंकड़ों के वर्चस्व वाले बीच को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Shingle beach wo samundri kinara hota hai jismein barik ret ke bajaye bade kankar (pebbles aur cobbles) aur gaad hote hain. Aise kinare wahan bante hain jahan samundar ki lehrein tez ho aur wo chhote ret ke kan ko baha kar le jaaye, sirf bade pathar bache rahein - ya jahan cliff se bade pathar girte rehte hain. Inka dhalan ret wale beach se zyada khada hota hai aur paani inmein se turant nichar (drain) ho jaata hai. Coral beach coral se, sand dune hawa se banta hai, mudflat jwar ke paani mein banta hai. Exam point: shingle beach = bade kankar/pebbles wala kinara; sand beach = barik ret wala kinara.

qe: What is a 'Bar' in coastal geography?
qh: तटीय भूगोल में 'बार' (रोधिका) क्या है?
o: A ridge of sand or shingle deposited parallel to the shore but off the mainland
e: Bar ek samundri ret ya shingle ki dhaar hoti hai jo tat (shore) ke samantar (parallel) ban jaati hai lekin mainland se thoda door (offshore) - isliye ye pani ke beech zameen ki dhaar jaisi dikhti hai. Ye lehron aur currents ke gaad jama hone se banti hai, aur agar ye poori tarah satah se ubhar kar samundar ko rok le to uske peechhe ek lagoon ban jaata hai. Spit bhi bar hi hai par uska ek siRa mainland se juda hota hai. Mountain, deep hole ya waterfall isse alag aakaar hain. Exam point: bar = shore ke samantar (parallel) ret-ki dhaar (offshore); spit = ek siRa juda (one end attached).

qe: A 'Spit' is a bar that has:
qh: एक 'स्पिट' (Spit) वह रोधिका है जिसमें:
o: One end attached to the mainland while the other extends into the sea
e: Spit ek bar hi hota hai jiska ek siRa mainland se j udA (attached) hota hai aur doosra siRa samundar mein aage nikal jaata hai (protrudes). Ye lehron aur lambi dhaara (longshore current) ke gaad ko kinare ke saath-saath le jaane aur baad mein kinare se door jama kar dene se banta hai - jaise Chilika, Pulicat jheel ke muhane ke paas. Jab spit aur aage badh kar jale-marg (channel) ko band kar de to sandbar banta hai aur uske peechhe lagoon. No sand, island ya destroy hona iske lakshan nahi hain. Exam point: spit = attached-at-one-end bar (hook), longshore drift ka nateeja.

qe: The saltwater body partially or completely separated from the sea by a barrier bar or spit is called a:
qh: रोबिका या स्पिट द्वारा समुद्र से आंशिक या पूर्णतः अलग किए गए खारे जल के निकाय को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Lagoon ek khaari (saline) paani ka tal hai jo barrier bar, spit ya riff (reef) ke karan samundar se poori tarah ya aadhe raste se alag ho jaata hai. Iska paani kam gehra hota hai, iski lahari (salinity) badal sakti hai aur jameen se aane wala meetha paani aur barish ise bharte hain. India ki mashhoor lagoons - Odisha ka Chilika (Asia ki sabse badi khari jheel), Andhra ka Pulicat, Kerala ka Vembanad aur Tamil Nadu ka Point Calimere - isi tarah bani hain. Plunge pool jal-prapat ke niche, river aur waterfall srot (source) hain. Exam point: lagoon = bar/spit ke peechhe bani khaari jheel (Chilika + Pulicat + Vembanad).

qe: A sand ridge that connects an island to the mainland is called a:
qh: एक रेत की पट्टी जो एक द्वीप को मुख्य भूमि से जोड़ती है, कहलाती है:
e: Tombolo ek ret ki dhaar (ridge) hoti hai jo kisi dweep (island) ko mainland se jod deti hai - matlab ye ek 'pul' (bridge) ka kaam karti hai. Ye tab banti hai jab dweep ke do tarafon par lehrein aur longshore currents gaad jama kar deti hain aur wo jamaav aage badh kar zameen se mil jaata hai. Isi tarah Chatham island aur Chennai ke aas-paas aise tombolo mile hain. Cliff, delta aur spit isse alag aakaar hain (spit ka ek siRa hi j udA hota hai). Exam point: tombolo = ret ki dhaar jo dweep ko mainland se jodti hai (island-mainland bridge).

qe: Why does groundwater primarily erode 'Limestone' and 'Dolomite' rocks?
qh: भू-जल मुख्य रूप से 'चूना पत्थर' और 'डोलोमाइट' चट्टानों का अपरदन क्यों करता है?
o: Because they are chemically soluble in carbonated water
e: Groundwater 'limestone' aur 'dolomite' jaisi chattaan ko isliye kat-ti hai (erode karti) kyunki ye dono paani mein ghulansheel (soluble) hain - khaas taur par jab paani mein CO2 ghul kar carbonic acid ban jaaye. Ye acid chuna patthar ke calcium carbonate se chemical abhikriya karke use calcium bicarbonate ke roop mein ghula leta hai, jisse gaar, sinkhole, karst aur stalactite bante hain. Magnetic hona ya bahut sakht hona ghulne ka kaaran nahi; aur 'erode nahi hot ' kehna galat hai. Exam point: karst = limestone/dolomite + carbonated water (solution) - chemical solution ka best udaharan.

qe: Small to medium sized round/sub-round depressions on the surface of limestone are called:
qh: चूना पत्थर की सतह पर छोटे से मध्यम आकार के गोल/अर्ध-गोल गर्त कहलाते हैं:
e: Soil khaak (sinkholes ya dolines) limestone ki satah par bane chhote ya madhyam giradaar gaddhe hote hain. Ye tab bante hain jab carbonate chattaan paani mein ghul kar andar khokhli ho jaati hai aur uski chhat dhans jaati hai (collapse sinkhole), ya jab satah dheere-dheere ghulti rehti hai (solution sinkhole). Ye karst ka pehla aur sabse aam roop hain; kai doline aapas mein mil jaate hain to uvala aur phir polje banta hai. Drumlin glacial, arete glacial dhaar aur esker glacial nadi ki dhaar hain. Exam point: sinkhole/doline = limestone ghulne se bana giradaar gaddha; iske milne par badi jheel = uvala ya polje.

qe: A very large depression formed by the merging of several sinkholes is called an:
qh: कई सिंकहोल के आपस में मिलने से बना एक बहुत बड़ा गर्त कहलाता है:
e: Uvala ek bada gaddha (depression) hota hai jo kai sinkholes (dolines) ke aapas mein mil jaane se banta hai - isliye iska aakaar giradaar nahi, balki tedha-medha (irregular) aur lamba hota hai. Uvala karst chakra ka pehla bada dhansav (collapse) hai; agar ye aur bada ho jaaye to polje ban jaata hai (polje ka tal samtal aur kinare khade hote hain). Aise aakaar limestone ilaakon mein banti hain jahan paani ke bahav se ghulav badhta hai. Delta nadi ke muhane ka, arete glacial dhaar aur moraine glacial gaad hain. Exam point: karst depression order = doline (chhota) - uvala (kai doline ka mel) - polje (bada samtal basin).

qe: What is the 'Stalactite' found in a karst cave?
qh: कास्ट गुफा में पाया जाने वाला 'स्टैलेक्टाइट' (Stalactite) क्या है?
o: A mineral deposit hanging like an icicle from the ceiling
e: Stalactite wo calcium carbonate ka jamaav (deposit) hai jo karst gaar (cave) ki chhat (ceiling) se barf ke lamkadi (icicle) jaisa latakta hua niche badhta hai. Jab gaar ki chhat se tapakta paani mein se CO2 bahar nikalta hai to chuna (calcium carbonate) chhat par hi jama hone lagta hai aur dheere-dheere niche latakta stambh banta hai. Iska sabse mashhoor udaharan Bhimbetka aur Belum caves hain. Zameen ka gaddha, ret ka dher ya nadi isse alag hain - stalactite ek chhat ka nirmit (deposit) hai, farsh ka nahi. Exam point: stalactite = chhat se latchak (icicle, c-chhat), stalagmite = farsh se upar.

qe: Which mineral deposit rises from the cave floor as water drips from above?
qh: ऊपर से पानी गिरने पर गुफा के फर्श से कौन सा खनिज निक्षेप ऊपर उठता है?
e: Stalagmite wo calcium carbonate ka stambh hai jo gaar ke farsh (floor) se upar ki taraf badhta hai. Jab chhat se tapakta paani boond-bood hokar niche girta hai, to us paani mein ghuli hui calcium bicarbonate hawa ke contact mein aakar calcium carbonate chhod deti hai, jo jahan boond girti hai wahin jama hoti rehti hai - isliye farsh par niche se upar stambh banta hai (jaise Borra caves ke stambh). Moraine glacial gaad, stalactite chhat se latakta hai aur barchan hawa ka ret ka tila hai. Exam point: stalagmite = farsh se upar badhta chuna stambh; chhat se niche latakne wala = stalactite; dono milen to pillar.

qe: What is 'Lapis' in karst topography?
qh: कास्ट टोपोग्राफी में 'लैपीज' (Lapis) क्या है?
o: Irregular grooves and ridges on a limestone surface caused by solution
e: Lapies (limestone pavements) wo ek chaudai mein spread hui tedhi-medhi naaliyan (grooves) aur unke beech bachi patli dhaarein (ridges) hain jo limestone ki satah par paani ke ghulne (solution) se banti hain. Jab barsaat ka paani limestone ke joints par se behne lagta hai, to wo joints ke saath-saath patthar ko ghula deta hai, isliye gehri naaliyan ban jaati hain - ise 'karren' bhi kehte hain. Yahan mitti aur paudhe kam rehte hain kyunki chattaan nangi ho jaati hai. Jwalamukhi chattaan, bird ya deep ocean isse alag hain. Exam point: lapies = limestone par ghulne se bani chaudi naaliyan + patli dhaarein (solution grooves).

qe: Which seismic wave is 'Transverse', vibrating at right angles to the direction of travel?
qh: कौन सी भूकंपीय तरंग 'अनुप्रस्थ' है, जो संचरण की दिशा के समकोण पर कंपन करती है?
e: S-wave (shear ya transverse wave) wo bhukamp ki leher hai jisme zameen ke kan (particles) leher ki chalne ki disha ke lambavat (right angle) hilte hain - isliye ise 'transverse' kehte hain. P-wave longitudinal hoti hai (kan aage-piche), isliye wo bhi S-wave se alag hai. S-wave sirf thos (solid) padarth mein hi chal sakti hai, liquid mein nahi - isi karan ye bahri core mein pahunch kar ruk jaati hai aur 'S-wave shadow zone' banta hai, jo core ke taral hone ka pakka pramaan hai. Light wave electromagnetic hai (bhukamp ki nahi). Exam point: S-wave = transverse (right angle vibration) + solid-only; P-wave = longitudinal (aage-piche) + sabhi medium mein.

qe: A 'Gabbro' rock is the intrusive equivalent of which extrusive rock?
qh: 'गैब्रो' किस बहिर्भेदी शैल का अंतर्भेदी समकक्ष है?
e: Gabbro ek intrusive (gehre jamne wala) igneous chattaan hai jo basalt ka hi rasayanik (chemical) roop hai, lekin bade kiran (coarse crystals) wala - kyunki wo zameen ke andar dheere-dheere thanda hua. Basalt usi magma ka extrusive (satah par jamne wala) roop hai jisme kiran bahut chhote hote hain kyunki lava turant thanda ho jaata hai. Isliye granite (felsic, halka) aur gabbro (mafic, gehra) intrusive ke roop mein milte hain aur unke extrusive saathi rhyolite aur basalt hote hain. Sandstone aur limestone sedimentary hain. Exam point: Gabbro (intrusive) = Basalt (extrusive); Granite (intrusive) = Rhyolite (extrusive).

qe: In the context of Mass Movement, what is 'Unloading'?
qh: वृहत संचलन के संदर्भ में 'अनलोडिंग' (Unloading) क्या है?
o: Pressure release due to erosion of overlying rock, causing lower rock to expand
e: Unloading (pressure release) mass movement mein ek ahem kadam hai jisme upar ki chattaan ka bojh (erosion se) hat jaata hai to niche ki chattaan par ka dabaav kam ho jaata hai aur wo fail kar ukhad jaati hai. Isi se 'sheeting joints' (chhoti patali paratein) banti hain jo chattaan ki satah se chhilke (exfoliation) ki tarah alag hone lagti hain; dhalan par ye patali paratein fisal kar gir sakti hain. Wind blowing, ice melting ya mud add karna iska varnan nahi hai. Exam point: unloading = upar ka bojh hatne se dabaav kam hona = failav + exfoliation + sheeting joints (granite domes ke nirmaan mein ahem).

qe: Which type of 'Moraine' is found at the very end (snout) of a glacier?
qh: हिमनद के बिल्कुल अंत (थूथन) पर कौन सा 'हिमोढ़' (Moraine) पाया जाता है?
e: Terminal moraine (end moraine) wo gaad (debris) ki dhaar hai jo glacier ke snout (aage ke siRe) par jama hoti hai - yahi batati hai ki glacier kitni door tak pahunchi thi. Aaj kal ki snout wahan hoti hai jahan barf pighalne ki raftar barf aage badhne ki raftar ke barabar ho jaati hai. Jab glacier kuchh der ke liye rukta hai aur phir peeche hatte hai, to rukne ke har sthaan par ek nayi moraine banti hai (recessional moraine). Medial moraine beech mein, lateral kinaron par, ground moraine tal par failti hai. Exam point: terminal moraine = glacier ke ant (snout) par gaad ki dhaar (glacier ki maximum advance ka nishaan).

qe: What happens to the 'Velocity' of a river when it reaches a flat plain or the ocean?
qh: मैदानी इलाके या समुद्र तक पहुँचने पर नदी के 'वेग' का क्या होता है?
e: Nadi jab pahad se utar kar samtal maidan ya samundar ke paas pahunchti hai, to uski dhalan (gradient) bahut kam ho jaati hai. Isliye paani ki raftar (velocity) bahut ghat jaati hai, aur nadi apna bhaari gaad (sediment) uthane ke bajaye wahin gira (deposit) deti hai - isi karan se delta, floodplain aur natural levee bante hain. Velocity kabhi turant shunya nahi hoti (nadi behti rehti hai) aur constant bhi nahi rehti, kyunki barish ke mausam aur jhuke (slope) ke hisaab se badalti rehti hai. Exam point: maidan mein raftar ghatne se nadi kattav kam karti hai aur jamaav (deposition) badh jaata hai - delta ka janm.

qe: At a 'Divergent' plate boundary, what is being created?
qh: एक 'अपसारी' (Divergent) प्लेट सीमा पर क्या निर्मित हो रहा है?
e: 'Divergent plate boundary' par do plate ek doosre se door khisakte hain. Samudri plate ke andar jab ye hota hai, to beech ki daraar se magma/lava nikalta hai, thanda hokar naya samudri bhaag (new oceanic crust) banta hai aur wo nemi (ridge) ke roop mein ubharta hai - isi karan Mid-Atlantic Ridge aur East Pacific Rise bane. Yahi 'sea floor spreading' hai jise Harry Hess ne samjhaya. Deep trench aur fold mountains convergent boundaries par bante hain. Exam point: divergent = plate door jaate hain = naya samudri tal (mid-oceanic ridge) + rift valley (continental mein).

qe: What is 'Loess' composed of?
qh: 'लोएस' (Loess) किससे बना है?
e: Loess hawa se bahut door tak ud kar pahuncha hua barik silt aur dhool ka mota jamaav hai. Ye barik kan itne halke hote hain ki hawa unhe hazaron km tak le jaati hai aur door ja kar parat ban jaati hai; isliye loess aksar registan ke kinaron aur glacial outwash maidan ke aas-paas chatti (accumulate) hoti hai. Loess ki mitti phali-phooli (porous) aur upjaau hoti hai, isliye is par ghani kheti aur aabadi hoti hai (China ka Huang He basin duniya ka sabse bada loess), lekin aise dhalan theek (vertical cliff) par aasani se kat jaate hain. Jwalamukhi lava, glacial barf ya bade boulders isme nahi hote. Exam point: loess = wind-blown silt (hawa se aaya silt), khaas taur par glacial-registani patti mein.

qe: The 'Moho Discontinuity' is the boundary between the ______ and the ______.
qh: 'मोह असंबद्धता' ______ और ______ के बीच की सीमा है।
e: Moho (Mohorovicic discontinuity) wo reyna (boundary) hai jahan khamandali (crust) poori hoti hai aur neeche mantle shuru hota hai. Ismein P-wave ki rafthar (velocity) achanak lagbhag 6-7 km/s se badh kar 8 km/s ho jaati hai kyunki niche ka padarth bhaari (peridotite) hai. Iski khoj 1909 mein Andrija Mohorovicic ne ki thi. Crust aur core, outer-inner core, ya upper-lower crust ke beech ye reyna nahi hoti - unki alag discontinuities hain (Gutenberg aur Lehmann). Exam point: Moho = crust aur mantle ke beech ki boundary; Gutenberg = mantle aur core ke beech; Lehmann = inner-outer core ke beech.

qe: Which mineral is standard for hardness level 10?
qh: कौन सा खनिज कठोरता स्तर 10 के लिए मानक है?
e: Diamond Mohs scale ka sabse sakht (hardness 10) khanij hai. Ye shuddh (pure) carbon ka crystal hai jo zameen ki 150-200 km gehrai mein bahut tez dabaav aur garmi (kimberlite pipe) ke karan banta hai. Diamond ke carbon atoms char kone wali (tetrahedral) jaali mein poore taur par jude hote hain, isliye wo khurach nahi paata aur electricity aur garmi ko bahut tez le jaata hai. Corundum 9, Topaz 8 aur Quartz 7 par hote hain - ye sab isse mulaayam hain. Exam point: 10 = Diamond (pure carbon), 9 = Corundum, 8 = Topaz, 7 = Quartz; Mohs scale mineral ki khurach resistance hai.

qe: Which rock results from metamorphosed Limestone?
qh: चूना पत्थर के कायांतरण से कौन सी चट्टान बनती है?
e: Marble wo metamorphic chattaan hai jo limestone (chuna patthar) ke badle hue roop se banti hai. Jab limestone gehre dabaav aur tez garmi (metamorphism) ke andar aati hai, to uske calcite ke kiran (crystals) bade hote hain aur chattaan sakht, chamkili aur patali ho jaati hai - isi liye marble deewar, farsh aur murti ke liye istemal hota hai. Basalt igneous hai, quartzite sandstone se banti hai, aur slate shale se banti hai. Exam point: limestone to marble (metamorphism); sandstone to quartzite; shale to slate; granite to gneiss - ye chaar jod exam mein baar-baar aate hain.

qe: What is 'Sima' shorthand for in Earth's layers?
qh: पृथ्वी की परतों में 'सीमा' (Sima) किसका संक्षिप्त रूप है?
e: 'Sima' ka pura naam Silica aur Magnesium hai. Ye samudri tal (oceanic crust) ki chattaan batata hai, jismein silica (SiO2) ke saath magnesium zyada hota hai aur loha (iron) bhi; is kaali-bhoori basaltic chattaan ka ghanatva zyada hone ke karan ye khamandali chattaan se neeche dhansi rehti hai. Sial (Silica + Aluminum) mahadeepon ki halki granitic chattaan hai, aur Nife (Nickel + Iron) core ka naam hai. Sodium, Lead ya Zinc se ye shorthand nahi banta. Exam point: Sima = samudri tal (basalt), Sial = mahadeep (granite), Nife = core (nickel-iron).

qe: Which seismic wave moves ground horizontally side-to-side?
qh: कौन सी भूकंपीय तरंग जमीन को क्षैतिज रूप से अगल-बगल ले जाती है?
e: Love wave ek surface wave hai jisme zameen ke kan (particles) leher ki disha ke lambavat (perpendicular) horizon-tal tarike se bayen-dine (side-to-side) hilte hain. Ye tarang zameen ki upari paraton mein phans kar tez chal pati hai aur imaraton ke foundation ko sabse zyada hilati hai. P-wave longitudinal hai, Rayleigh wave roll (ret) jaisa up-down movement karta hai, aur 'body wave' ek saamanya naam hai (P aur S dono). Exam point: Love wave = horizontal side-to-side (transverse); Rayleigh = rolling; P = push-pull; S = lambavat shear.

qe: The term 'Orogeny' is specifically related to:
qh: 'ओरोजेनी' (Orogeny) शब्द विशेष रूप से किससे संबंधित है?
e: Orogeny (parvat-nirmaan ki kriya) ka matlab hai plate ke takrav (convergence) se chattaan ka mud kar (fold) uncha uthta aur parvat shrinkhala banna - jaise Himalaya, Alps aur Andes. Ye ek endogenic (andar ki shakti) kriya hai jo karodon saal mein chalti hai aur isi se fold mountains, fault aur bhukamp bhi juda hote hain. Mitti ka banna (pedogenesis) alag kriya hai, samundar ki satah ka girna eustatic change, aur barf pighalna jalvaayu ka kaam hai. Exam point: oro = parvat + geny = janm; orogeny = plate takrav se parvat banne ki kriya (Himalaya ka sabse bada udaharan).

qe: Which state of matter is the 'Inner Core' of Earth?
qh: पृथ्वी का 'आंतरिक कोर' पदार्थ की किस अवस्था में है?
e: Prithvi ki 'inner core' isliye thos (solid) hai kyunki us par upar ki saari paraton ka bahut zyada dabaav (pressure) padta hai - lagbhag 3.5 million times atmosphere ke dabaav ke barabar. Itni dabaav mein loha-nickel ke atom aapas mein kas kar jama reh jaate hain aur tapman 5000 degree C se zyada hone ke bawajood bhi wo na taral hote hain na gas banate hain. Iske ulta bahri core (outer core) mein dabaav thoda kam hai isliye wo taral (liquid) hai. Gas ya plasma bahut kam dabaav wale padarth hote hain. Exam point: inner core = thos + sabse zyada dabaav + sabse zyada ghanatva.

qe: What is the primary factor that turns 'Pangea' into today's continents?
qh: 'पंजिया' को आज के महाद्वीपों में बदलने वाला प्राथमिक कारक क्या है?
e: Pangea (ya Pangaea) ek vishaal supercontinent tha jo lagbhag 20 crore saal pehle plate tectonics aur continental drift ki kriya se toot kar aaj ke mahadeep ban gaye. Wegener ne 1912 mein dikhaya tha ki mahadeepon ka tat (coastline) milta hai aur unke fossils-pathar bhi milte hain, lekin uske paas chal ke karan (mechanism) nahi tha - baad mein plate tectonics, sea-floor spreading aur convection currents se wo samjhaya gaya. Barf pighalna, suraj ki roshni ya hawa ka erosion mahadeep nahi banate. Exam point: Pangaea (ek jgah sab bhoomi) se Laurasia aur Gondwana, phir aaj ke 7 mahadeep - yahi continental drift ka safar.

qe: Which property describes how a mineral reflects light from its surface?
qh: कौन सा गुण यह बताता है कि एक खनिज अपनी सतह से प्रकाश को कैसे परावर्तित करता है?
e: Lustre (chamak) wo khanij ki gunavatta hai jo batati hai ki uski satah roshni ko kaise wapas bhejti hai - matlab use dekh kar chamkila, sone jaisa, sheesh (glassy) jaisa, moti jaisa ya dull lagta hai. Lustre khanij ke light reflection par nirbhar karta hai aur ise dekh kar hi pehchan mein madad milti hai, jaise mica ki moti jaisi chamak aur galena ka metal jaisa chamak. Streak powder ka rang, density bhaar, aur hardness khurachne ki khinchat batati hai. Exam point: lustre = roshni ka reflection (chamak) - isse optical test kaha jaata hai.

qe: What is the primary reason the Earth's atmosphere stays attached to the planet?
qh: पृथ्वी का वायुमंडल ग्रह से किस प्राथमिक कारण से जुड़ा रहता है?
e: Prithvi apni vayu (atmosphere) ko apne paas isliye rakhti hai kyunki uska gurutvakarshan (gravitational force) hawa ke anuon ko apni taraf khinchta rehta hai. Gas ke anu (molecules) bahut tez bhaagte hain, isliye unhe antariksh mein jaane se rokne ke liye gravity ka paryapt hona zaroori hai; prithvi itni bhaari hai ki uski escape velocity (11.2 km/s) zyada tar gas anuon ki raftar se zyada hai. Isi karan chandrama (chhota) aur mangal (patla) ki vayu bhaag gayi. Centrifugal force, tides ya solar energy vayu ko bandh nahi rakhte. Exam point: gravity = vayu ka bandhan; light gases (Helium, Hydrogen) door khisak kar antariksh mein nikal jaate hain.

qe: which of the following describes 'Air' correctly?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन 'वायु' (Air) का सही वर्णन करता है?
o: A combination of solids, liquids, and gases
e: 'Air' (vayu) sirf gas nahi hoti - usmein gases (nitrogen, oxygen, CO2), taral (aerosol ke roop mein paani ki boondein), aur thos kan (dhool, dhuen, samundri namak) sabhi shamil hote hain. Isliye vayu ko 'solid + liquid + gas ka mel' kehna zyada sahi hai. Sohai-vayu (pure) gas ka mel maan lena galat hai kyunki ismein aerosols, boondein aur thos kan bhi saans-nas (health) aur jalvaayu par asar daalte hain. CO2 ki bahut chhoti matra bahut ahem hai. Exam point: vayu = gases + water vapour + aerosols (solid/liquid kan) ka mishran - isliye wo ek 'mix' hai na ki sirf gas.

qe: Which of the following are considered 'Constant Gases' whose concentration does not vary significantly with position?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से किसे 'स्थिर गैसें' माना जाता है जिनकी सांद्रता स्थिति के साथ महत्वपूर्ण रूप से नहीं बदलती है?
e: 'Constant gases' wo gases hoti hain jinki matra (proportion) prithvi ki satah par jagah-jagah aur samay ke saath lagbhag nahi badalti. Nitrogen (78%), Oxygen (21%) aur Argon (0.93%) teenon isi tarah ki gases hain - inka mixture poore vishwa mein hamesha same rehta hai. Iske vipreet 'variable gases' wo hain jinki matra bahut badalti hai - jaise jallvaashp (0.02% se 4% tak) aur CO2 (ghatne-badhne wala), aur ozone bhi ek chhote kshetra mein hi milta hai. Exam point: constant = N2, O2, Argon (99%+); variable = water vapour, CO2, ozone, dust.

qe: The process of 'Volcanic Outgassing' in the early Earth (Hadean Eon) primarily released which gas?
qh: प्रारंभिक पृथ्वी (हैडियन इयोन) में 'ज्वालामुखीय आउटगैसिंग' की प्रक्रिया ने मुख्य रूप से कौन सी गैस छोड़ी?
e: Hadean Eon (4.6 se 4.0 billion saal pehle) mein prithvi ki satah bahut garm aur jwalamukhi (volcanic) thi. Jwalamukhi se nikalne wali gases (volcanic outgassing) mein sabse pramukh gas Carbon Dioxide (CO2) thi, saath mein water vapour, nitrogen, methane, ammonia aur sulphur gases bhi the. Yahi vayu aage chalkar prithvi ka doosra vayumandal bani; shudh (pure) oxygen us samay bilkul nahi tha kyunki zindagi aur photosynthesis abhi shuru hi nahi hui thi. Helium sirf gas ke roop mein bhaag jaati. Exam point: prathmik vayu (H+He) khatam - volcanic outgassing se doosri vayu (CO2, H2O, N2) - phir photosynthesis se oxygen aaya.

qe: Which organism is credited with starting the production of free Oxygen through photosynthesis about 2.5 billion years ago?
qh: लगभग 2.5 बिलियन वर्ष पहले प्रकाश संश्लेषण के माध्यम से मुक्त ऑक्सीजन का उत्पादन शुरू करने का श्रेय किस जीव को दिया जाता है?
e: Cyanobacteria (nile-hare rang wali algae) wo pehle jeev the jinhone lagbhag 2.5 billion saal pehle oxygenic photosynthesis shuru ki - matlab suraj ki roshni aur CO2 se apna khana banate samay Oxygen gas chhodna shuru kiya. Isi 'Great Oxidation Event' se vayu mein mukta (free) oxygen aaya, ozone parat banne lagi aur aage chalkar jeev jantu (animals) bade bane. Mammals aur dinosaurs bahut baad mein aaye (Phanerozoic mein), aur fungi oxygen dena nahi banaate. Exam point: oxygen ka asli sting (source) = cyanobacteria (blue-green algae) ka photosynthesis, ~2.5 billion saal pehle.

qe: What is the third most abundant gas in the Earth's atmosphere today?
qh: आज पृथ्वी के वायुमंडल में तीसरी सबसे प्रचुर मात्रा में पाई जाने वाली गैस कौन सी है?
e: Prithvi ki aaj ki vayu mein Nitrogen (78%) aur Oxygen (21%) ke baad sabse zyada matra Argon ki hai - lagbhag 0.93% (volume ke hisaab se dry air mein). Iske baad CO2 (~0.04%), neon aur helium ki bahut chhoti matra aati hai. Argon ek nishkriya (inert) gas hai, isliye bulb, tube-light aur welding mein ise bharte hain taaki andar ka filament zang na lagaaye. Exam point: teesra sabse abundant gas = Argon (0.93%), chautha = CO2; Helium aur Neon keval trace (bahut kam) matra mein hain.

qe: Oxygen concentration in the atmosphere is essentially found up to a height of:
qh: वायुमंडल में ऑक्सीजन की सांद्रता मुख्य रूप से कितनी ऊँचाई तक पाई जाती है?
o: 16 km (maximum concentration) but present up to 120 km
e: Vayu mein Oxygen ki asli matra (concentration) jo saans lene ke liye paryapt hoti hai, lagbhag 16 km tak bahut zyada (20-21%) rehti hai - ise 'homosphere' kehte hain jahan gases achhi tarah se mix hote hain. Iske upar, lagbhag 120 km tak, oxygen bahut patli (thin) matra mein bhi milta hai (khaas taur par ionized roop mein) jo ozone layer aur ionosphere ke liye ahem hai. 400 km par oxygen ki matra itni kam ho jaati hai ki breathing suru nahi ho sakti; 5 km par to ye bilkul ghalat hai (wahan O2 21% ke barabar hi hai, kam sirf dabaav hota hai). Exam point: oxygen 16 km tak pramukh, 120 km tak upalabdh (thin), iske baad bahut kam.

qe: Which gas acts as a 'Greenhouse Gas' by trapping long-wave terrestrial radiation but is transparent to short-wave solar radiation?
qh: कौन सी गैस लंबी तरंग वाली स्थलीय विकिरण को रोककर 'ग्रीनहाउस गैस' के रूप में कार्य करती है, लेकिन लघु तरंग सौर विकिरण के लिए पारदर्शी है?
e: Carbon Dioxide (CO2) ek aisi gas hai jo suraj ki chhoti (short-wave) kiranein ko saaf-saaf guzarne deti hai lekin bhoomi se nikalne wali lambi (long-wave) infrared kiranein (terrestrial radiation) sokh leti hai - isse bhoomi ki garmi wapas nikal nahi paati aur vayu garam hoti hai. Isi karan ise greenhouse gas kehte hain; ye gasadi (fossil fuel) jalaane, kheti aur jwalamukhi se vayu mein badhti hai. Nitrogen aur argon roshni ke prati lagbhag udaaseen hain aur oxygen bhi infrared ko kam sokhta hai. Exam point: CO2 short-wave ke liye saaf, long-wave ke liye anusaar (opaque) - greenhouse effect ki kunjur.

qe: Which of the following describes 'Water Vapor' concentration in the atmosphere correctly?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन वायुमंडल में 'जलवाष्प' की सांद्रता का सही वर्णन करता है?
o: Variable (0.02% to 4%), highest in warm/wet tropics and lowest in dry/polar regions
Highest at the poles, lowest at equator
e: 'Water vapour' (jallvaashp) ek 'variable gas' hai - iski matra sthaan aur mausam ke hisaab se 0.02% se 4% tak badalti rehti hai. Ye sabse zyada garam aur naam (geele) tropics par samundar se vaashpiki (evaporation) se badhti hai aur badal-barsaat ka bada hissa banti hai; samundar se door registani aur thande polar ilaakon mein lagbhag 0.02% hi rehti hai. 50 km ke upar ye lagbhag nahi milti aur equator-pol mein ulta pattern hai, isliye baki vikalp galat hain. Exam point: water vapour = mausam ki sabse badalti hui gas + sabse pramukh natural greenhouse gas.

qe: The 'Ozone Layer' (O3) is primarily located in which layer of the atmosphere?
qh: 'ओजोन परत' (O3) मुख्य रूप से वायुमंडल की किस परत में स्थित है?
e: Ozone layer (O3) vayu mandal ki stratosphere parat mein hai - lagbhag 15 se 35 km ki unchai par (sabse zyada 20-25 km par). Yahi ozone concentration ka 90% hota hai jise 'ozonosphere' bhi kehte hain. Troposphere mein sirf 10% ozone hota hai (jo pollution ke karan banta hai), mesosphere mein thoda aur exosphere mein bilkul nahi. Isi liye ozone hole ki baat stratosphere ke saath hoti hai. Exam point: ozone layer = stratosphere (15-35 km), 90% ozone; bad ozone = troposphere (pollutant), good ozone = stratosphere (shield).

qe: What is the main function of the Ozone layer for life on Earth?
qh: पृथ्वी पर जीवन के लिए ओजोन परत का मुख्य कार्य क्या है?
o: To reflect all sunlight back to space
To absorb harmful Ultraviolet (UV-B and UV-C) rays
e: Ozone layer ka mukhya kaam suraj se aane wali khatarnak 'Ultraviolet-B aur Ultraviolet-C' kiranein sokhna hai. Ye UV kiranein jeevan ke liye khatarnak hain kyunki ye DNA ko tod-ti hain, skin cancer, motiyabind (cataract) aur paudhon ke photosynthesis ko nuksan pahunchati hain. Ozone ke atoms in kiranein ko sokh kar (photo-dissociation) vayu ko garam rakhte hain aur prithvi ki satah ko in desha se bachate hain. Ozone saans lene ke liye oxygen nahi deta, barsaat nahi karata aur poori roshni wapas nahi bhejta. Exam point: ozone = UV-B aur UV-C ka dhaal (shield); ise 'prakriti ka sunscreen' bhi kehte hain.

qe: What are 'Hygroscopic Nuclei'?
qh: 'हाइग्रोस्कोपिक न्यूक्लिआई' क्या हैं?
o: Solid particles like dust and salt that provide surfaces for water vapor to condense
e: 'Hygroscopic nuclei' wo chhote-chhote thos kan hain (jaise samundri namak ke kiran, dhool, dhuaan, parag (pollen) aur jwalamukhi ki raakh) jo vayu ki nami (aerosols ke roop) mein maojood rehte hain aur jallvaashp ke anuon ko apni satah par jama kar lete hain. Ye nuclei condensation ke liye 'chhabri' (platform) ka kaam karte hain - inke bina hawa ko bahut zyada super-cooling chahiye hoti, isliye baadal, kohra aur baarish inhi se bunte hain. Isi karan cloud seeding mein chandi iodide (silver iodide) daala jaata hai. Exam point: hygroscopic nuclei = condensation ke liye kan (aerosol surface) - baadal ki boond (cloud droplet) ka pehla kadam.

qe: Why does the sky appear 'Blue' during the day?
qh: दिन के दौरान आकाश 'नीला' क्यों दिखाई देता है?
o: Due to the scattering of sunlight by tiny solid and gas particles in the atmosphere
e: Aakash (sky) din mein neela isliye dikhta hai kyunki suraj ki safed roshni vayu ke bahut chhote-chhote kan aur gas ke anuon se takrati hai aur unmein se neele rang ki tarang (chhoti wavelength) sabse zyada bhikharti (scatter) hai - ise Rayleigh scattering kehte hain. Isliye humein aakash ka neela rang chaaron taraf se dikhta hai, halanki suraj ka rang safed hai. Samundar ka reflection, suraj ka neela hona ya vayu ka apna rang aisa nahi hai. Exam point: blue sky = chhote kan se neeli tarang ka scattering (Rayleigh); suryaast-suryoday laal = lambi taarang ka scattering.

qe: What is 'Normal Lapse Rate' in the Troposphere?
qh: क्षोभमंडल (Troposphere) में 'सामान्य ह्रास दर' (Normal Lapse Rate) क्या है?
o: Decrease in temperature at a rate of 6.4°C per 1 km of ascent
