e: Normal lapse rate vayu mandal ki troposphere parat ka niyam hai, jismein har 1 km unchai par tapman lagbhag 6.4 degree C (bahut source 6.5 degree C) ghatta hai. Iski wajah ye hai ki troposphere zameen ki satah se garam hoti hai, jo suraj ki kiranein sokh kar apni garmi (long-wave) hawa ko deti hai, aur upar jaate-jaate hawa failti (expand) hai jisse uski garmi ghatti hai. Isi liye pahadon par thand hoti hai aur Himalaya mein 5 km par tapman 0 degree C se bhi neeche ho jaata hai. Exam point: troposphere = 6.4 degree C per km ki kami (exception: temperature inversion mein badhti hai).

qe: The height of the 'Troposphere' is highest at the ______ and lowest at the ______.
qh: क्षोभमंडल की ऊँचाई ______ पर सर्वाधिक और ______ पर सबसे कम होती है।
e: Troposphere ki motai (height) equator par sabse zyada (lagbhag 18 km) aur dhruvon par sabse kam (lagbhag 8 km) hoti hai. Iska kaaran ye hai ki equator par suraj ki seedhi kiranein tez garam karti hain, jisse hawa halki hokar upar uthti hai (strong convectional currents) aur parat ki chhat ko door tak dhakEl deti hai. Dhruvon par thand ke karan hawa bhaari aur sthir hoti hai isliye parat patli reh jaati hai. Samundar ki satah ya pahad iska kaaran nahi hain. Exam point: troposphere ki unchai - equator 18 km, poles 8 km; isi liye pahadi udaan (flight) badalti hai.

qe: Which of the following is NOT a solid particle (aerosol) found in the atmosphere?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन वायुमंडल में पाया जाने वाला ठोस कण (एरोसोल) नहीं है?
e: Vayu ke thos kan (aerosols) ke chhote-chhote kanak - jaise samundri namak, jwalamukhi ki raakh, dhool, parag (pollen) aur dhuen ke kan. 'Water droplets' (paani ki boondein) aerosol hote hue bhi thos (solid) nahi hain - wo taral (liquid) kan hain. Isliye unhe 'thos kan' nahi kaha jaata; wo aerosol ke taral roop hain jo condensation se bante hain. Yahi bareek farq (fine difference) is prashn mein poocha jaata hai. Exam point: aerosols = thos kan (dhool, namak, raakh, pollen) + taral boondein; bas condense hui boond ko solid particle nahi kehte.

qe: The 'Argon' gas in our atmosphere primarily comes from:
qh: हमारे वायुमंडल में 'आर्गन' गैस मुख्य रूप से कहाँ से आती है?
o: Radioactive decay of Potassium-40 in Earth's crust
e: Vayu mein Argon ki sabse badi matra isliye hai kyunki ye radioactive decay ka natija hai: prithvi ki chattaan (crust) mein maujood Potassium-40 ka radioactive decay dheere-dheere ho kar Argon-40 gas banata hai, jo chattaan se nikal kar vayu mein jama hota rehta hai. Kyunki Argon nishkriya (inert) gas hai, wo kisi se mil kar nasht nahi hota, isliye karodon saal mein uski matra badhti gayi. Fossil fuel jalana CO2 aur SO2 dega, photosynthesis oxygen, aur jwalamukhi se mainly CO2 aur water vapour. Exam point: Argon (0.93%) = Potassium-40 ke radioactive decay ka byproduct (isliye ye vayu mein teesra sabse abundant gas hai).

qe: What is 'Latent Heat of Condensation'?
qh: 'संघनन की गुप्त ऊष्मा' (Latent Heat of Condensation) क्या है?
o: Heat released into the atmosphere when water vapor turns back into liquid water
e: 'Latent heat of condensation' wo chhupi hui garmi (hidden heat) hai jo hawa mein jallvaashp ke taral paani ki boond banne (condensation) ke samay chhod di jaati hai - yani vapor se liquid banne par ye garmi hawa ko mil jaati hai bina tapman badle. Isi garmi se hawa garam hoti hai, failti hai, upar uthti hai aur cloud ke andar convection tez hota hai - isliye baadal bashTi (burst) aur cyclone ko bharpur urja milti hai. Barf pighalne ki garmi aur core ki tapman alag cheezein hain. Exam point: latent heat = chhupi garmi (state change), condensation par chhut-ti hai aur vaporization mein khatch hot-ti hai.

qe: In which period did Oxygen levels reach up to 30%, leading to the growth of giant animals like dinosaurs?
qh: किस काल में ऑक्सीजन का स्तर 30% तक पहुँच गया था, जिससे डायनासोर जैसे विशाल जानवरों का विकास हुआ?
e: Phanerozoic eon (lagbhag 54 crore saal pehle se aaj tak) mein oxygen ki matra kai baar 30% tak pahunchi, jabki aaj ye 21% hai. Oxygen ke itne zyada hone se shaandaar (giant) keerk (insects) aur bade jeev jantu - dinosaurus, dragonflies (2 feet ke pankh wale) - paida hue. Yahi 'Carboniferous period' ka koyla banane wala jungle bhi isi kaal ka hai. Hadean mein oxygen nahi tha, Proterozoic mein bahut kam, aur Archean mein bilkul nahi. Exam point: oxygen ka spike (30%) = Phanerozoic (Carboniferous), isi liye giant insects aur dinosaurs ka vikas hua.

qe: What happens to the amount of 'Dust particles' as we move higher into the atmosphere?
qh: जैसे-जैसे हम वायुमंडल में ऊपर जाते हैं, 'धूल के कणों' की मात्रा का क्या होता है?
e: Vayu mein dhool ke kan (dust particles) samundar ki satah ke nazdik sabse zyada hote hain kyunki registan, kheti, jwalamukhi, gaadi aur karkhane yahin dhool chhodte hain; unchai badhne ke saath ye kan bhaari hone ke karan niche baith jaate hain, isliye unki sankhya aam taur par ghatti jaati hai. Haan, kuch jun (layer) high-altitude par - jaise volcanic ash ke baadal ya jet stream ke soot - door tak chale jaate hain, par average mein ye ghatt-te hain. 5 km ke baad bilkul shunya nahi hote. Exam point: dust particles = surface par sabse zyada, unchai ke saath aam taur par kam (aerosol ka vertical pattern).

qe: Which part of the Earth's atmosphere is known as the 'Zone of mixing' where all weather occurs?
qh: पृथ्वी के वायुमंडल के किस भाग को 'मिश्रण का क्षेत्र' कहा जाता है जहाँ सभी मौसम संबंधी घटनाएँ होती हैं?
e: Troposphere ko 'zone of mixing' kehte hain kyunki yahan gases aur hawa bahut achhi tarah mix hoti hai, jallvaashp aur dhool ke kan saath rehte hain, aur hawa ka vertical (upar-neeche) mixture (convection) tez chalta hai. Yahi karan hai ki baadal, kohra, barsaat, toofan, bijli - mausam ki saari ghatnayein yahin hoti hain. Stratosphere sthir hai (ozone wahan UV sokhta hai), ionosphere charged parat hai (radio reflection), aur exosphere vayu mandal ka sabse bahar ka hissa hai. Exam point: troposphere = 'mausam ki parat' + zone of mixing (atmofiyar ki lagbhag 75-80% mass aur 99% water vapour yahin hai).

qe: Ozone found in the 'Troposphere' is often considered ______.
qh: 'क्षोभमंडल' में पाई जाने वाली ओजोन को अक्सर ______ माना जाता है।
o: A pollutant that can damage buildings and health
e: Troposphere mein bana ozone (jise 'bad ozone' kehte hain) saans lene-par bahut hani karak hota hai aur ek pradusan (pollutant) hai. Ye gaadi, karkhane (factories) aur jalaane se nikle nitrogen oxides aur volatile organic compounds (VOC) se suraj ki roshni ki upasthiti mein banta hai; isse dhundh (smog) badhti hai, aankh-fefra (lungs) par asar padta hai, paudhon aur imaraton (buildings) ko nuksan hota hai. Ozone layer (stratosphere) baandhne wala ozone 'good ozone' hai jo UV se bachata hai. Exam point: tropospheric ozone = pollutant (smog aur health), stratospheric ozone = dhaal (protective).

qe: What is the weight percentage of 'Oxygen' in the present atmosphere approximately?
qh: वर्तमान वायुमंडल में 'ऑक्सीजन' का भार प्रतिशत लगभग कितना है?
e: Vayu mein Oxygen ka weight percentage lagbhag 21% hai. Nitrogen 78% (yani sabse zyada), Argon 0.93%, aur Carbon Dioxide lagbhag 0.036-0.04% hota hai. Isliye 78% nitrogen ka hai aur 0.9% argon ka. Ye percentages dry air ke liye hote hain - agar jallvaashp shamil ho to total 100% se alag ho jaata hai. Oxygen saans lene aur jalne dono ke liye zaroori hai. Exam point: vayu = Nitrogen 78 + Oxygen 21 + Argon 0.93 + CO2 0.04 (%) - ye percentage exam mein baar-baar aate hain.

qe: Why do sunsets and sunrises appear 'Orange/Red'?
qh: सूर्यास्त और सूर्योदय 'नारंगी/लाल' क्यों दिखाई देते हैं?
o: Due to the scattering of light by dust and smoke particles when sunrays travel a longer distance through the atmosphere
e: Suraj ki kiranein subah aur shaam ke samay tirchi (slant) hokar vayu ki moti parat (thickness) se guzarti hain, isliye neeli aur hari tarang (short wavelength) raaste mein hi bikhair (scatter) jaati hai aur sirf lambi tarang ki laal-narangi roshni hamare tak pahunchti hai - isi liye suryaast aur suryoday lal-narangi (orange/red) dikhte hain. Ye bhi scattering ka hi niyam hai (Rayleigh + dust). Suraj paas aane, rang badalne ya baadal ke reflection se ye nahi hota. Exam point: shaam-subah = lambi rays (long path) = neeli scatter, laal bachi; dopahar = short path = neela aakash.

qe: Which layer of the atmosphere is the most 'Dense'?
qh: वायुमंडल की कौन सी परत सबसे अधिक 'सघन' है?
e: Vayu mandal ki sabse ghanee (dense) parat troposphere hai kyunki ye prithvi ki satah ke sabse nazdik hai aur gravity ke karan ismein hawa ke anuon ka jamav (compression) sabse zyada hota hai. Isi parat mein lagbhag 75-80% vayu ka bhaar (mass) aur lagbhag saara jallvaashp hota hai, isliye dabaav bhi sabse zyada (1013 mb) milta hai. Upar jaate-jaate hawa failti aur patli hoti hai, isliye stratosphere, mesosphere aur exosphere ki ghanatva kam hoti jaati hai. Exam point: sabse ghana (dense) aur sabse bhaari (heavy) = troposphere (sabse patli/nirvaat = exosphere).

qe: The 'Troposphere' height is 18 km at the equator because of:
qh: भूमध्य रेखा पर क्षोभमंडल की ऊँचाई 18 किमी किसके कारण होती है?
o: Strong convectional currents carrying heat to greater heights
e: Equator par troposphere 18 km tak unchi isliye hoti hai kyunki yahan suraj ki seedhi kiranein hawa ko bahut garam karti hain. Garam hawa halki hokar tez raftar se upar uthti hai (strong convectional currents) aur lagbhag 18 km ki uchai tak garmi aur nami pahuncha deti hai - isi tarah parat ka sarhad (ceiling/tropopause) upar khisak jaata hai. Dhool ki upasthiti, gravity ka tez hona ya hawa ki raftar iska mool kaaran nahi hain; ye sahakarak (supporting) cheezein ho sakti hain. Exam point: equator = tez convection = 18 km troposphere; poles = thand = 8 km (maximum height equator par hoti hai).

qe: Which of the following is a 'Variable Gas'?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी एक 'परिवर्तनशील गैस' (Variable Gas) है?
e: Water vapour vayu ki wo 'variable gas' hai jiski matra jagah aur mausam ke hisaab se badalti rehti hai (0.02% se 4% tak) - isliye ise ek nishchit (constant) percentage nahi diya ja sakta. Garam aur samundar ke nazdik ilaakon mein ye zyada hoti hai (tropics mein 4% tak) aur thande sookhe ilaakon mein bahut kam; mausam ke saath ye kabhi badh jaati hai aur kabhi ghat jaati hai. Nitrogen, oxygen aur argon ki tarah ise constant nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: variable gases = water vapour + CO2 (+ ozone); constant gases = N2, O2, Argon.

qe: The process where Oxygen was added to Earth's atmosphere by plants is part of the ______ Eon.
qh: पौधों द्वारा पृथ्वी के वायुमंडल में ऑक्सीजन जोड़ने की प्रक्रिया किस इयोन (Eon) का हिस्सा है?
e: Oxygen ki bahut badi matra (lagbhag 21%) aaj ki vayu mein Archean aur Proterozoic eon mein hi jama hui thi, jab cyanobacteria aur aage chalkar paudhon ne oxygenic photosynthesis se mukta oxygen chhoda. Isi liye ise 'Archean / Proterozoic' ka yogdan kehte hain - Archean mein cyanobacteria ka aeitra (origin) aur Proterozoic mein Great Oxidation Event (oxygen ki matra ka tez badhna) hua. Hadean mein sirf volcanic CO2 thi, Cenozoic aur Mesozoic to bahut baad ke kalp hain. Exam point: oxygen ka nirmaan = Archean-Proterozoic (cyanobacteria + photosynthesis); Phanerozoic mein ye 30% tak pahunch gaya.

qe: What is the concentration of 'Carbon Dioxide' (CO2) in the atmosphere approximately?
qh: वायुमंडल में 'कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड' (CO2) की सांद्रता लगभग कितनी है?
e: Vayu mein Carbon Dioxide (CO2) ki matra lagbhag 0.036% se 0.04% (yani 360 se 400 parts per million) hoti hai. Ye matra bahut chhoti dikhti hai lekin bahut ahem hai kyunki CO2 ek mukhya greenhouse gas hai - ye chhoti matra bhi bhoomi ki garmi ko rok kar tapman santulit rakhti hai. 0.0005% bahut kam, 21% oxygen ka aur 0.9% argon ka anka hai. Industrial Revolution ke baad se ye matra badhti ja rahi hai (2024 mein 420 ppm se zyada). Exam point: CO2 = 0.036-0.04% (400 ppm ke aas-paas), chhoti par prabhavi greenhouse gas.

qe: Which seismic waves help identify that the 'Outer Core' is liquid as they don't pass through it?
qh: कौन सी भूकंपीय तरंगें यह पहचानने में मदद करती हैं कि 'बाहरी कोर' तरल है क्योंकि वे इसके माध्यम से नहीं गुजरती हैं?
e: P-wave ki tarah S-wave (shear/transverse wave) taral (liquid) mein nahi chal sakti - aur yahi hamen batati hai ki prithvi ka bahri core taral hai. Jab bhukamp ki S-waves 2900 km gehrai par pahunchti hain to wo bahri core mein aage (jaati hi nahi) nahi badh paati aur 103-143 degree ke beech 'S-wave shadow zone' banta hai jahan S-wave pahunchti hi nahi. Isi shadow se vaigyanikon ne samjha ki bahri core liquid (pighla hua loha-nickel) hai. P-wave, surface wave aur Love wave is varnan se match nahi karte. Exam point: pramaan - S-wave outer core mein nahi jaati = bahri core liquid.

qe: The term 'Aboard of Human Beings' used in the previous lecture refers to the Earth as a ______.
qh: पिछले लेक्चर में प्रयुक्त 'मनुष्यों का आवास' (Aboard of Human Beings) शब्द पृथ्वी को एक ______ के रूप में संदर्भित करता है।
e: 'Aboard of human beings' ka matlab hai ki prithvi hamare liye jaise ek vishaal jahaaz (ship) hai jispar saare manav ek saath oopar chadh kar chal rahe hain - yani prithvi hamara 'ghar' (home/dwelling place) hai. Lecture mein yahi baat prithvi ke prati samvedansheelta aur 'prithvi ek parivaar hai' ke roop mein samjhaye jaate hain (Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam). Yahan prithvi ko sirf ek bhautik sansadhan, laboratory ya factory nahi, balki hamara aavaas maana gaya hai. Exam point: prithvi = manav ka ghar (shared home) - isliye ise bachana hamari zimmedari hai.

qe: Which instrument is used to record 'Seismic Waves'?
qh: 'भूकंपीय तरंगों' को रिकॉर्ड करने के लिए किस उपकरण का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Seismic waves (bhukamp ki lehrein) ko record karne wale yantra ko seismograph kehte hain. Ismein ek sthir adhar (base) aur ek jhoolta hua bhaari bhaag (pendulum) hota hai; zameen hilne par adhar ke saath zameen hilti hai lekin bhaari bhaag apni jagah reh jaata hai, aur isi antar ko kalam (pen) ke ghoomte drum par ek graafh (seismogram) ke roop mein likh deta hai. Barometer dabaav, hygrometer naamta aur anemometer hawa ki raftar maapta hai. Exam point: seismograph = bhukamp ki lehrain record karne ka yantra (record ko seismogram kehte hain).

qe: What is the approximate age of the Universe as per the Big Bang Theory?
qh: बिग बैंग सिद्धांत के अनुसार ब्रह्मांड की अनुमानित आयु क्या है?
e: Big Bang Theory ke anusar vishwa (universe) ki utpatti lagbhag 13.8 billion saal pehle ek bahut chhote, garam aur ghane bindu se hui thi. Iske pramaan mein vishwa ka failaav (red shift), cosmic microwave background radiation (CMB) aur halke tatvon (hydrogen-helium) ki matra shamil hain. 4.6 billion saal sirf prithvi aur suraj ke parivar ki umar hai, 100 million ya 1 trillion saal galat hain. Exam point: universe = 13.8 billion saal, prithvi = 4.6 billion saal - dono ka antar confuse na karo.

qe: Which state of matter is the 'Mantle' of the Earth?
qh: पृथ्वी का 'मेंटल' पदार्थ की किस अवस्था में है?
e: Prithvi ka mantle lagbhag 2900 km mota hai aur ye mainly thos (solid) chattaan se bana hai - iron-magnesium silicate (peridotite) ki chattaan. Iska tapman bahut zyada hai lekin dabaav bhi itna zyada hai ki chattaan ko taral hone se rokta hai, isliye ye 'solid' hai; sirf asthenosphere (100-350 km) ka hissa itna dheela (partially plastic) hai ki wo dheere-dheere beh sakta hai. Purely liquid ya gaseous mantle hona galat hai kyunki S-waves mantle se guzarti hain. Exam point: mantle = mainly solid, par asthenosphere dheela/plastic; magma asthenosphere se hi nikalta hai.

qe: What happens to the density of the atmosphere with 'Increasing Altitude'?
qh: 'बढ़ती ऊँचाई' के साथ वायुमंडल के घनत्व का क्या होता है?
e: Unchai (altitude) badhne par vayu mandal ki ghanatva (density) aur dabaav dono kam ho jaate hain kyunki gravity ke karan hawa ke anu (molecules) zameen ke nazdik kas kar jama rehte hain aur upar uthte hi unka bhaar (weight) kam ho jaata hai. Isliye 5.5 km par lagbhag aadhi hawa niche reh jaati hai aur 10 km ke baad lagbhag 25% se kam. 10 km par vayu 'gayab' nahi hoti, dabaav sthir nahi rehta aur density badhna to ulta hai. Exam point: altitude up = density aur pressure down (exponential decrease); isi liye pahadon par saans lena mushkil hota hai.

qe: Which gas is a byproduct of 'Radioactive decay' of Potassium-40?
qh: पोटेशियम-40 के 'रेडियोधर्मी क्षय' का उपोत्पाद (byproduct) कौन सी गैस है?
e: Argon-40 vayu mein sabse zyada isi karan hai ki prithvi ki chattaan (crust) mein maujood Potassium-40 ka radioactive decay bahut maatra mein Argon gas banata hai. Ye gas dheere-dheere chattaan se nikal kar vayu mein jama hota rehta hai, aur kyunki Argon-40 ek nishkriya (inert) gas hai, wo kisi rasayanik abhikriya se khatam nahi hota - isliye karodon saal mein aaj ye vayu ka 0.93% ban gaya hai. Nitrogen, oxygen ya CO2 is decay ke byproduct nahi hain. Exam point: Argon = Potassium-40 ke radioactive decay ka phal (0.93%); yahi 'Argon dating' mein bhi istemal hota hai.

qe: The 'Troposphere' contains approximately what percentage of the total atmospheric mass?
qh: क्षोभमंडल में कुल वायुमंडलीय द्रव्यमान का लगभग कितना प्रतिशत होता है?
e: Troposphere vayu mandal ki sabse nichli parat hai aur ismein lagbhag 75-80% kul vayu ka bhaar (mass) hota hai - kyunki gravity ke karan hawa ke anu yahin sabse zyada kas kar jama rehte hain. Baaki 20-25% hissa stratosphere tatha upar ki paraton mein fail jaata hai. Isliye samundar ki satah par dabaav 1013 mb hota hai jo upar jaate-jaate kabhi shunya ke nazdik pahunch jaata hai. 1%, 20%, 50% wale anka galat hain. Exam point: troposphere = 75-80% mass + 99% water vapour + saara mausam; isi liye ye sabse ghanee (dense) parat hai.

qe: Which layer of the atmosphere is closest to the Earth's surface?
qh: वायुमंडल की कौन सी परत पृथ्वी की सतह के सबसे करीब है?
e: Troposphere prithvi ki satah ke sabse nazdik (0 se 18 km tak) vayu mandal ki parat hai, isliye ye 'lower atmosphere' bhi kehlati hai. Ismein hawa sabse ghanee, garm aur naam (moisture-laden) hoti hai aur mausam ki saari ghatnayein (baadal, barsaat, toofan, titli) yahin hoti hain. Stratosphere ozone ki parat ka ghar hai, mesosphere sabse thandi, aur ionosphere radio reflection karne wali. Exam point: prithvi ki satah ke sabse nazdik aur sabse ghanee = troposphere; isi par hum saans lete hain aur aeroplane ke chhote flights yahin udte hain.

qe: The boundary separating the Troposphere from the Stratosphere is called:
qh: क्षोभमंडल को समताप मंडल से अलग करने वाली सीमा कहलाती है:
e: Troposphere aur stratosphere ke beech ki sarhad ko tropopause kehte hain - ye lagbhag 18 km par equator par aur 8 km par poles par milti hai. Yahan tapman ka ghatna ruk jaata hai (lagbhag -55 se -80 degree C tak) aur upar ki ore stratosphere mein ozone ki wajah se tapman badhne lagta hai, isliye yahin se hawa sthir ho jaati hai aur cumulonimbus jaise lambe baadal bhi isi sarhad tak ruk jaate hain (anvil shape). Ozone layer uske upar hai, mesopause mesosphere-stratosphere ke beech, stratopause stratosphere-mesosphere ke beech. Exam point: tropopause = troposphere-stratosphere ka border (jet aircraft isi ke thoda upar udte hain).

qe: In which layer of the atmosphere do most commercial 'Airplanes' prefer to fly for a smooth ride?
qh: सुचारू उड़ान के लिए अधिकांश वाणिज्यिक 'हवाई जहाज' वायुमंडल की किस परत में उड़ना पसंद करते हैं?
e: Commercial aeroplanes aam taur par 'lower stratosphere' mein udte hain kyunki ye parat sthir hai, yahan baadal aur convection ka mix nahi hota, isliye udaan smooth rehti hai. Iske alava ye parat lagbhag 8-12 km (tropopause ke upar) hone ke karan wahan hawa ki ghanatva kam hoti hai, jisse aag se (fuel consumption) bachta hai aur tez raftar milti hai. Lower troposphere mein turbulence, toofan aur bijli ki wajah se chhote internal flights udte hain, aur mesosphere bahut patli aur thandi hai. Exam point: aeroplane = lower stratosphere (smooth ride + kam fuel); weather avoidance isi liye.

qe: What happens to the 'Temperature' in the Stratosphere as altitude increases?
qh: ऊँचाई बढ़ने के साथ समताप मंडल (Stratosphere) में 'तापमान' का क्या होता है?
o: It increases due to the presence of Ozone
e: Stratosphere mein tapman unchai ke saath badhta hai kyunki uske andar ozone (O3) ki ek parat hoti hai jo suraj ki ultraviolet (UV) kiranein sokh leti hai aur unki urja (energy) ko garmi mein badal deti hai. Isi karan yahan temperature inversion banta hai - niche se upar ki taraf tapman lagbhag -55 degree C se -2 degree C tak badh jaata hai. Convection zameen se juda hai (troposphere ka kaam), helium ka failaav ya CO2 ki badhotri iska kaaran nahi. Exam point: stratosphere ka tapman upar ki ore badhta hai (ozone UV absorption); isi liye ye parat sthir hai aur inversion banaati hai.

qe: Which is the 'Coldest' layer of the atmosphere where temperature drops to minus 100°C?
qh: वायुमंडल की सबसे 'ठंडी' परत कौन सी है जहाँ तापमान माइनस 100 डिग्री सेल्सियस तक गिर जाता है?
e: Mesosphere (lagbhag 50 se 85 km) vayu mandal ki wo parat hai jahan tapman -100 degree C tak gir jaata hai - isliye yahi sabse thandi parat hai. Yahan ozone ki garmi ka asar nahi rehta, aur CO2 khud infrared ke roop mein garmi chhod deta hai, isliye tapman lagatar girta hai. Isi parat mein upar se aane wali ulkaayein (meteors) jal jaati hain. Thermosphere 1500 degree C tak garam ho sakta hai, troposphere zameen ke garam hone se garam rehta hai, aur stratosphere ozone se garam. Exam point: mesosphere = sabse thandi (-100 degree C) + meteors jalne ki jagah.

qe: The 'Ionosphere' is important for which modern technology?
qh: 'आयनमंडल' किस आधुनिक तकनीक के लिए महत्वपूर्ण है?
o: Radio communication (reflecting radio waves back to Earth)
e: Ionosphere (lagbhag 60 km se upar thermosphere ke andar) mein suraj ki UV aur X-ray kiranein gas ke anuon se electron alag kar deti hain, jisse ionit (charged) kanak bante hain. Ye ionit kanak radio ki khamju (skywave) ko wapas zameen par mod (reflect) dete hain, isliye ek radio station ki aawaz hazaron kilometre door tak pahunch jaati hai - khaas taur par raat mein. Yahi wajah hai ki HF (short-wave) radio sancharna, ship-aircraft communication aur ham radio aaj bhi ahem hain. Pakana, khudai ya plant growth ka isse sambandh nahi. Exam point: ionosphere = radio wave ka aina (reflection) - long-distance radio communication.

qe: Which layer is the 'Outermost' part of the atmosphere that eventually merges with outer space?
qh: वायुमंडल का 'सबसे बाहरी' भाग कौन सा है जो अंततः अंतरिक्ष के साथ मिल जाता है?
e: Exosphere vayu mandal ki sabse bahri parat hai jo lagbhag 500 km se upar shuru hoti hai. Yahan hawa itni patli hoti hai ki gas ke anu (molecules) aur kane ek doosre se pehle jaise poore taur par alag ho jaate hain aur kai kan antariksh mein bhaag jaate hain - isliye yahi parat dheere-dheere 'outer space' (antariksh) se mil jaati hai. Isi parat mein helium aur hydrogen sabse zyada hoti hai aur satellite yahan se guzar kar orbit mein chale jaate hain. Stratosphere, thermosphere aur mesosphere isse alag (andar) hain. Exam point: exosphere = sabse bahri parat + antariksh se milti hui (100% alag = space ka darwaja).

qe: The 'Greenhouse Effect' is primarily caused by which type of solar radiation being trapped?
qh: 'ग्रीनहाउस प्रभाव' मुख्य रूप से किस प्रकार के सौर विकिरण के फंसने (trap) के कारण होता है?
e: Greenhouse effect mainly bhoomi se nikalne wali 'outgoing long-wave terrestrial radiation' (infrared) ke trap hone se hota hai. Bhoomi suraj ki kiranein sokh kar garam hoti hai aur phir lambi (long-wave) infrared kiranein chhodti hai; CO2, methane, water vapour jaise greenhouse gases inhi lambi kiranein ko sokh kar unhe wapas bhej dete hain, jisse tapman badhta hai. Aane wali (incoming) short-wave UV ya visible roshni saaf-saaf guzar jaati hai - isliye wo trap nahi hoti. Cosmic rays ka is se koi sambandh nahi. Exam point: greenhouse effect = outgoing long-wave infrared ka trap hona (incoming short-wave nahi).

qe: The term 'Latent Heat' is associated with:
qh: 'गुप्त ऊष्मा' (Latent Heat) का संबंध किससे है:
o: Change of state of matter (e.g., vapor to liquid) without changing temperature
e: 'Latent heat' wo chhupi hui garmi hai jo padarth ki avastha (state) badalne ke samay li jaati ya chhodi jaati hai - jaise barf pighalne, paani ubalne ya bhaap se paani ki boond banne ke samay - aur is dauran tapman nahi badalta. Isi liye barf pighalte waqt tapman 0 degree C par ruka rehta hai (latent heat of fusion 80 cal/g) aur bhaap banne par garmi sonkh (absorb) leti hai, aur condensation par chhod deti hai. Direct aag ki garmi ya hawa ki raftar alag cheezein hain. Exam point: latent heat = state change ki chhupi garmi (bina tapman badle) - yahi baadal ke plain (burst) ka kaaran hai.

qe: The process of 'Hydration' in rocks leads to:
qh: शैलों में 'जलयोजन' (Hydration) की प्रक्रिया क्या करती है?
o: Expansion and swelling of minerals after absorbing water
e: Kisi chattaan (rock) mein rasayanik kriya ke roop mein jab paani ke anu (molecules) khanij ke andar ghus kar usse jod lete hain (hydration), to khanij ka aayatan (volume) badh jaata hai aur wo fail (swell) jaata hai. Isi failaav se chattaan mein darar padti hain, wo kaali-mamli (soft) hoti hai aur aage tootne lagti hai - jaise gypsum ka anhydrite se banna, hematite ka limonite mein badalna. Isi wajah se registan aur jalua ilaakon mein aisi chattaan jaldi weathering se tutte hain. Pighal kar lava banna ya sone mein badalna nonsensical hai. Exam point: hydration = paani sonkh kar khanij ka failna (expansion + softening) - rasayanik weathering ka roop.

qe: What is the primary difference between 'Weathering' and 'Erosion'?
qh: 'अपक्षय' (Weathering) और 'अपरदन' (Erosion) के बीच प्राथमिक अंतर क्या है?
o: Weathering involves movement; Erosion is static
Weathering is static (on-site); Erosion involves transportation of material
e: Weathering aur erosion mein mukhya antar yahi hai ki weathering wahan hi (in-situ) hoti hai jahan chattaan padi hai - usmein sirf tutna (disintegration) hota hai, koi movement nahi. Erosion mein tootta (gaad) kisi agent (nadi, hawa, glacier, lehar) dwara kisi doosri jagah tak baha (transported) liya jaata hai, aur phir wahin jama (deposited) ho jaata hai. Isliye weathering 'sthir' (static) hai aur erosion mein gate (kinetic) energy tatha dhuank (transportation) shamil hai. Dono ek hi cheez nahi hain. Exam point: weathering = sthir (on-site tootna), erosion = toot kar le jaana (remove + transport) - dono milkar relief ko barabar karte hain.

qe: In the context of 'Plate Tectonics', which plate is a 'Major Plate'?
qh: 'प्लेट विवर्तनिकी' के संदर्भ में, कौन सी प्लेट एक 'मुख्य प्लेट' है?
e: Prithvi ki 'major plates' saat badi plate hain - Pacific, North American, South American, Eurasian, African, Indo-Australian aur Antarctic. Ismein Antarctic Plate shamil hai. Nazca, Cocos, Arabian, Caribbean, Philippine aur Juan de Fuca jaise plates 'minor' ya chhoti plates hain. Ye chhoti plates bhi bahut ahem hain (Andes Nazca se, Himalaya Indo-Australian se banta hai) par 'major plate' ki list mein nahi aati. Exam point: 7 major plates = Pacific, N-American, S-American, Eurasian, African, Indo-Australian, Antarctic; baaki sab minor.

qe: Which seismic wave moves like a 'Slinky' or sound wave (Push-Pull)?
qh: कौन सी भूकंपीय तरंग 'स्लिंकी' या ध्वनि तरंग (पुश-पुल) की तरह चलती है?
e: P-wave ko 'slinky' (spring) ya dhwani (sound) ki tarah ki leher kehte hain kyunki ye compressional (dhakka) ya longitudinal wave hai - ismein hawa ke kan (particles) leher ki disha ke saath aage-piche hote hain (push-pull), jaise spring ko khinchne-par chhodne se usmein movement banti hai. Ye solid, liquid, gas teenon mein chalti hai aur sabse tez (5-8 km/s) hoti hai, isliye seismograph par sabse pehle P-wave record hoti hai. S-wave transverse hai (right angle par hilti hai), R-wave rolling, L-wave horizontal. Exam point: P = primary + push-pull (slinky) + sabse tez + sab medium; S = shear + solid only.

qe: Which mineral is Assigned Hardness 10 on the Mohs Scale?
qh: मोह स्केल पर किस खनिज को कठोरता 10 दी गई है?
e: Mohs scale par hardness 10 sabse sakht khanij Diamond hai. Ye shuddh (pure) carbon ka crystal hai jo zameen ki 150-200 km gehrai mein tez dabaav aur garmi mein banta hai aur volcano ke rashte (kimberlite pipe) se upar aata hai. Uske carbon atoms ekdum kas kar jude hote hain, isliye wo sabse zyada khurach resistance rakhta hai. Talc 1 par, Calcite 3 par aur Quartz 7 par hote hain - sab isse mulaayam. Exam point: 10 = Diamond, 9 = Corundum, 8 = Topaz, 7 = Quartz; iske ulta sira (1) Talc hai.

qe: The 'Geoid' shape of the Earth results in higher gravity at the ______.
qh: पृथ्वी के 'जॉइड' आकार के कारण गुरुत्वाकर्षण कहाँ अधिक होता है?
e: Prithvi ke ghoomne se jo apakendriya bal (centrifugal force) banta hai, uski wajah se equator par bhoomi bahar ubhri (bulge) hui hai aur dhruv (poles) chapte (flattened) hue hain. Isi 'geoid' aakaar ka nateeja ye hai ki pole (dhruv) equator ke muqable prithvi ke kendra (centre) ke nazdik hain, isliye wahan gurutvakarshan (gravity) thoda zyada (9.83 m/s2) hota hai, aur equator par thoda kam (9.78 m/s2) - kyunki gravity kendra ki doori ke ulat anusaar ghatti hai. Pahadon par morkar (local) gurutvakarshan ka asar saamanya (normal) hota hai. Exam point: geoid = poles par zyada gravity + equator par kam gravity (centrifugal ke karan).

qe: Which element is the second most abundant in the Earth's crust?
qh: पृथ्वी की क्रस्ट में दूसरा सबसे प्रचुर मात्रा में पाया जाने वाला तत्व कौन सा है?
e: Prithvi ki chattaan (crust) mein sabse zyada Oxygen (lagbhag 46% weight) hota hai aur uske baad Silicon (lagbhag 27%) - isliye in dono ko 'sial' bhi kehte hain. Silicon dioxide (silica) ke roop mein ye ret, quartz aur silicates mein milta hai aur engineering, glass aur semiconductor industry ka mukhya aadhar hai. Aluminum teesre (8%) sthaan par aur iron chautha (5%) - haan, core mein loha sabse zyada hai par crust mein nahi. Exam point: crust mein sabse zyada - Oxygen (1), Silicon (2), Aluminum (3), Iron (4).

qe: The term 'Mafic' rocks implies they are rich in:
qh: 'मैफ़िक' चट्टानों का तात्पर्य है कि वे भरपूर हैं:
e: 'Mafic' naam Magnesium aur Ferrous (iron) se bana hai. Mafic chattaan mein magnesium aur loha zyada tatha Silica kam (45-52%) hota hai, isliye ye gehra (dark) rang wali, bhaari aur sakht hoti hai aur iski magma patli hone ke karan shaant bah kar lava plateau banati hai. Basalt (extrusive) aur gabbro (intrusive) iske mashhoor udaharan hain; Deccan Trap isi mafic lava se bana. Felsic rocks mein Silica aur Feldspar zyada hota hai aur wo halke rang wale hote hain (granite). Exam point: Mafic = Magnesium + Iron (dark, low silica, basalt); Felsic = Feldspar + Silica (light, granite).

qe: What is 'Regolith' in the context of soil layers?
qh: मिट्टी की परतों के संदर्भ में 'रेगोलिथ' क्या है?
e: Regolith zameen ki satah ka wo dheela (loose) aur un-consolidated padarth hai jo niche padi matra chattaan (bedrock) ke upar faila hota hai. Ismein mitti, pathron ke toote bhag, ret, silt aur khanij ka malba shamil hota hai aur yahi paudhon ki jar (roots) tatha building ki neev (foundation) ka adhar banata hai. Weathering se regolith banta hai aur waqt ke saath iski upari parat se mitti (soil) banti hai. Magma, inner core ya pure water isse alag hain. Exam point: regolith = dheela/weathered padarth ka parat + soil ka janm-sthaan (bedrock ke upar).

qe: A 'Batholith' is specifically which type of igneous feature?
qh: 'बैथोलिथ' विशेष रूप से किस प्रकार की आग्नेय विशेषता है?
e: Batholith ek bahut bada (100 square km se zyada) intrusive igneous rock mass hai jo gehre (deep-seated) magma chamber ke thande hokar sakht hone se banta hai. Ye discordant hota hai (aas-paas ki paraton ko kaat kar nikalta hai) aur bottomless hota hai; ghulav (erosion) se upari parat hatne par ye satah par khula dikhta hai - jaise Chota Nagpur ka granite aur Sierra Nevada. Vertical wall dike, horizontal sheet sill aur chhota sataheen pat (lava) isse alag hain. Exam point: batholith = giant deep-seated magma chamber + bottomless + discordant.

qe: In the process of 'Subduction', which plate goes under?
qh: 'प्रविष्ठन' (Subduction) की प्रक्रिया में कौन सी प्लेट नीचे जाती है?
e: Subduction (dhansav) mein wahi plate neeche jaati hai jiska ghanatva (density) zyada aur bhaar zyada hota hai - aam taur par samundri (oceanic) plate continental plate ke neeche dhansati hai. Isse deep trench, jwalamukhi ka dhaar (island arc) aur bhukamp bante hain, jaise Nazca plate South American plate ke neeche (Andes bana) aur Pacific plate ke neeche Japan. Umar (older) ka hona hamesha kaaran nahi hota, aur 'None' galat hai. Exam point: subduction = bhaari/ghane (denser) plate neeche - oceanic plate continental ke neeche.

qe: Which property of minerals refers to the 'Color of Powder'?
qh: खनिजों का कौन सा गुण 'चूर्ण के रंग' को संदर्भित करता है?
e: Streak khanij (mineral) ko safed tile par ragadne se banne wale powder ka rang hota hai. Ye khanij ki pehchan ka sabse bharosemand (reliable) test hai kyunki bahri satah ka rang weathering, dhool ya nami se badal jaata hai lekin powder ka rang wahi rehta hai - jaise Hematite ka streak laal, pyrite ka hara-kala aur galena ka grey hota hai. Hardness khurachne ki khinchat, lustre roshni ki chamak aur cleavage phatne ki disha batati hai. Exam point: streak = powder ka rang (tile test) - sabse vishwasniya (reliable) pehchan ka hathiyar.

qe: The 'Normal Lapse Rate' is valid for which layer?
qh: 'सामान्य ह्रास दर' किस परत के लिए मान्य है?
e: Normal lapse rate (6.4 degree C per km tapman ka girna) keval troposphere par lagu hota hai, kyunki yahi parat zameen ki satah se garam hoti hai aur yahan hawa upar uthte hue failti (expand) hai. Stratosphere mein ozone UV sokh kar tapman badhata hai (isliye wahan lapse rate nahi lagu), mesosphere mein tapman tez girta hai par wo apne hi niyam se, aur exosphere mein tapman bahut badh jaata hai. Isi liye weather, baadal aur hawa ka vertical mix troposphere mein hota hai. Exam point: normal lapse rate = 6.4 degree C/km - sirf troposphere mein lagu (inversion mein ulta).

qe: What creates the 'Magnetic Field' of the Earth as discussed in the core sections?
qh: कोर अनुभागों में चर्चा के अनुसार पृथ्वी का 'चुंबकीय क्षेत्र' क्या बनाता है?
o: Convection in the liquid outer core
e: Prithvi ka chumbakiya kshetra (magnetic field) bahri core ke taral (liquid) loha-nickel ke convection aur prithvi ke ghoomne (rotation) ke milkar 'geodynamo' se banta hai. Bahri core mein garm padarth upar aata hai, thanda neeche jaata hai - isi convection se vidyut dhaara (electric current) banti hai, aur current se chumbakiya kshetra paida hota hai; isi field ke karan compass north-south dikhata hai aur solar wind se suraksha milti hai. Thos chattaan, suraj ki roshni ya samundar ki lehrein isse alag hain. Exam point: magnetic field = bahri core ka taral loha-nickel convection + rotation (geodynamo).

qe: Which layer of the atmosphere is 'Coldest'?
qh: वायुमंडल की कौन सी परत 'सर्वाधिक ठंडी' है?
e: Vayu mandal ki sabse thandi parat mesosphere hai, jahan tapman lagbhag -100 degree C tak (polar region mein -110 degree C) gir jaata hai. Yahan ozone ki garmi nahi pahunchti, aur CO2 infrared ke roop mein garmi chhod deta hai, isliye tapman lagatar girta hai. Troposphere zameen se garam hoti hai, stratosphere ozone se, aur exosphere bahut patli magar tapman 1000 degree C se bhi upar tak (kanak patle hote hain isliye garmi mehsoos nahi hoti). Exam point: sabse thandi = mesosphere; sabse garam = thermosphere; exosphere = sabse bahar (patli).

qe: The term 'Sial' is associated with which elements?
qh: 'सियाल' शब्द किन तत्वों से जुड़ा है?
e: 'Sial' Silicon aur Aluminum ka mel hai. Ye khamandali (continental) chattaan ka naam hai, jismein silica (SiO2) aur aluminum oxide ki prabhutva hoti hai; iska ghanatva kam (lagbhag 2.7) hota hai isliye ye halki granitic chattaan Sima (ocean floor) par tairti hai. Gold, silver, iron ya lead sial ka hissa nahi hain, aur 'Silicon + Magnesium' to Sima hai. Exam point: Sial = Silicon + Aluminum = mahadeep (granite); Sima = Silica + Magnesium = samundar tal (basalt); Nife = Nickel + Iron = core.

qe: Which seismic wave travels fastest through 'Solids, Liquids, and Gases'?
qh: कौन सी भूकंपीय तरंग 'ठोस, तरल और गैस' तीनों में सबसे तेज चलती है?
e: P-wave (primary) vahi leher hai jo solid, taral (liquid) aur gas - teenon mein chalti hai aur sabse tez (satah ke nazdik 6-8 km/s) hoti hai. Iski khaas baat ye hai ki ye compressional (dhakka-push-pull) wave hai jismein padarth ke kan ek doosre se takrate hain, isliye ise chalne ke liye sirf padarth ki kam se kam sakht chahiye - humare saans ki hawa mein bhi ye chal jaati hai (dhwani ki tarah). Isliye seismograph par sabse pehle P-wave ka nishaan aata hai jaise bhukamp 'pehle ek dhakka bhar' mehsoos hota hai. S-wave solid mein hi chalti hai. Exam point: fastest + sabhi medium (solid/liquid/gas) mein chalti = P-wave.

qe: The 'Asthenosphere' is primarily made of which rock type?
qh: एस्थेनोस्फीयर मुख्य रूप से किस शैल प्रकार से बनी है?
e: Asthenosphere ki chattaan mainly Peridotite hai. Ye ek ultramafic (bahut zyada magnesium-iron wali), bhoori-hari chattaan hai jo olivine, pyroxene aur poti (mica jaise) khanijon se banti hai aur 100-350 km gehrai par semi-fluid (plastic) hoti hai - isi par tectonic plates tairte hain aur magma yahin se upar aata hai. Granite khamandali Sial ki chattaan, Basalt samudri tal ki, aur chalk (Chalk) calcium carbonate (limestone ki ek kism) hai - ye asthenosphere ki chattaan nahi hain. Exam point: asthenosphere = peridotite (ultramafic) + plastic/semi-fluid + magma ka source.

qe: What defines the 'Texture' of a soil?
qh: मिट्टी के 'टेक्सचर' (Texture) को क्या परिभाषित करता है?
o: Relative proportions of sand, silt, and clay
e: Soil texture ka matlab mitti ke kanon (particles) ke aakaar aur unke proportion (sand, silt, clay) se hota hai - yahi batata hai ki mitti kitna paani rok sakti hai aur kitna hawa jaane deti hai. Sand ke kan bade, silt madhyam aur clay sabse chhote hote hain; clay sabse zyada paani rok leti hai isliye chenat (sticky) ho jaati hai, sandy mitti paani turant nikal deti hai, aur teenon ka mila hua loam sabse upjaau. Rang, bhaar ya umar texture tay nahi karte. Exam point: soil texture = sand/silt/clay ka anupat aur unka aakaar (particle size) - loam sabse aadarsh.

qe: Which type of 'Process' is 'Volcanism'?
qh: 'ज्वालामुखीयता' (Volcanism) किस प्रकार की प्रक्रिया है?
e: Volcanism (jwalamukhi ki kriya) ek endogenic (prithvi ke andar se aane wali) shakti kaam hai - yani iska pehla srot (source) prithvi ke andar ki garmi, plate ka takrav aur asthenosphere/mantle ka magma hai. Isliye ise 'constructive process' bhi kehte hain kyunki ye zameen ko banane aur uncha karne mein bhaag leta hai. Exogenic (bahri) shaktiyan nadi, hawa, glacier aur samundar ki lehrein hain jo relief ko ghisa (erode) kar barabar karti hain; atmospheric (mausam) cheezein mausam se juda hai. Exam point: volcanism = endogenic (build/unchen karne wali shakti) - jaise bhukamp aur parvat nirmaan bhi endogenic hain.

qe: The term 'Nife' refers to Earth's core because of:
qh: 'निफे' शब्द पृथ्वी के कोर को संदर्भित करता है क्योंकि:
e: 'Nife' ka pura naam Nickel aur Ferrous (Iron) hai. Prithvi ka core mainly loha (iron) aur nickel se bana hai, isliye uski shorthand 'NIFE' hai - NI (Nickel) + FE (Ferrous = iron). Isi bhaari loha-nickel ke karan core ka ghanatva (10 se 13 g/cm3) sabse zyada aur tapman 5000 degree C se bhi zyada hota hai; bahri core taral hai aur inner core thos. Nickel aur Fluorine, Nitrogen ke saath iron ka mel nonsense hai. Exam point: Nife = core (Nickel + Iron); Sima = ocean crust; Sial = continent - teeno ka shorthand yaad rakho.

qe: What creates 'Domes' on the crust according to endogenic theory?
qh: एंडोजेनिक सिद्धांत के अनुसार क्रस्ट पर 'गुंबद' कौन बनाता है?
o: Domal uplift and pressure from rising convection currents
e: Prithvi ki satah par kuch jagah 'domes' (giradaar ubhaar) endogenic theory ke anusaar mantle ke andar uth rahi garam dhara (convection currents) ke karan bante hain. Ye dhara upari mantle aur satah ke niche jama (push) karti hain, isliye chattaan dheere-dheere ubhar kar giradaar (dome) aakaar le leti hai. Jaise Colorado plateau aur bahut se mineral-rich dome (iron ore ke saath). Tide, rain ya wind ke bahri (exogenic) karak is prakiya se alag hain. Exam point: domal uplift = endogenic (convection current ka dabav) - agey chalkar isi se plateau aur dome mountains bante hain.

qe: Which seismic wave is the most 'Destructive'?
qh: कौन सी भूकंपीय तरंग सर्वाधिक 'विनाशकारी' है?
e: Bhukamp ki lehron mein sabse zyada tabahi (destructive) 'Surface waves' karti hain - yani Rayleigh aur Love waves. Ye lehrain zameen ki satah par hi chalti hain, inki rafthar kam hoti hai lekin hilne ki matra (amplitude) bahut bada hota hai, isliye imaratein, pul aur sadkein isse sabse pehle gir jaate hain. P-wave sabse pehle pahunchti hai par halki si dhakka deti hai, S-wave medium khatra deti hai, aur body waves andar chalti hain. Exam point: surface wave (Rayleigh + Love) = sabse destructive + slowest; P = fastest + harmless.

qe: The 'Geoid' shape implies Earth is flattened at the:
qh: 'जॉइड' आकार का तात्पर्य है कि पृथ्वी कहाँ चपटी है?
e: Geoid ka matlab prithvi ka asli aakaar hai jo perfect gol nahi balki chapta-nikal (oblate spheroid) hai - dhruv (poles) chapte (flattened) aur equator par ubhe (bulge) hue. Iska kaaran prithvi ka apne axis par ghoomna hai, jisse apakendriya bal (centrifugal force) equator ke kanon ko bahar khincha leta hai; isliye equatorial radius polar radius se lagbhag 21 km zyada hai. Troughs ya samundar ki satah aise shape ka varnan nahi karti, aur equator to ubhara hua (bulged) hai chapta nahi. Exam point: geoid = poles par chapta + equator par ubha + poles par zyada gravity, equator par kam.

qe: Which mineral has a hardness level of 1?
qh: किस खनिज का कठोरता स्तर 1 है?
e: Mohs scale par sabse mulaayam (softest) khanij Talc hai jiski hardness 1 hoti hai. Ise nakhun ya unglI se aasani se khurach kar powder ban sakta hai; ye magnesium silicate hydrate hai aur soapstone (dhone ka patthar) ka mukhya hissa hota hai, isliye talcum powder aur ceramic mein istemal hota hai. Calcite 3 par, Quartz 7 par aur Diamond 10 par aata hai - sab talc se sakht hain. Exam point: 1 = Talc (sabse mulaayam), 2 = Gypsum, 3 = Calcite, 4 = Fluorite - Mohs scale ka pehla sira yaad rakho.

qe: Which 'Exogenic' process levels out the heights created by 'Endogenic' forces?
qh: कौन सी 'बाह्य' प्रक्रिया 'आंतरिक' बलों द्वारा बनाई गई ऊँचाइयों को समतल करती है?
e: Endogenic (andar ki) shaktiyan - plate takrav, orogeny, volcanism aur domal uplift - zameen ko uncha karti hain aur relief (unchai-gahrai) paida karti hain. Unko barabar karne ka kaam exogenic (bahri) shaktiyan karti hain - sabse mukhya 'Weathering aur Erosion' hai, jisme nadi, hawa, glacier, samundar ki lehrein aur bhumi-jal (groundwater) unchaai ko ghisa kar neeche ka gaad (base level) tak dhoti hain aur deposit karti hain. Isi 'gradation' ke karan chattaan ka chakra chalta rehta hai. Domal uplift, volcanism aur earthquakes khud endogenic hain. Exam point: endogenic = uncha karti hai (build), exogenic (weathering + erosion) = barabar karti hai (level down).

qe: The term 'Bravais Lattice' relates to which geological material?
qh: 'ब्रेवाइस लैटिस' शब्द किस भूवैज्ञानिक पदार्थ से संबंधित है?
e: 'Bravais Lattice' khanij (mineral) ke andar atoms ke sthir (fixed) teen-aayami (3-D) jamav ki banaawat ko kehte hain. Khanij ke andar ke parmanu (atoms) ek nishchit jaali (lattice) ki tarah jude rehte hain aur unke anukrama (arrangement) se hi khanij ke teeno aayat (crystal form), cleavage (phatne ki disha) aur khaas gunavatta (properties) tay hoti hain. Isi lattice ke aadhar par hi 7 crystal systems (cubic, tetragonal, hexagonal etc.) banti hain - aur Auguste Bravais ne 14 lattice dhaanche (patterns) samjhaye. Ocean water, soil horizons ya rock ka type isse alag hai. Exam point: Bravais lattice = khanij ke atoms ka repeating 3-D jaal (internal atomic arrangement).

qe: The 'Grand Canyon' is a larger version of a ______.
qh: 'ग्रैंड कैनियन' किसका एक बड़ा संस्करण है?
e: Grand Canyon (Colorado nadi, USA) duniya ka sabse mashhoor aur bada gorge hai - lagbhag 446 km lamba, 29 km chauda aur 1.6 km gehra. 'Gorge' ek gehri, sankri (narrow) ghati hoti hai jismein khadi deewarein (steep walls) hoti hain; jab ye bahut badi ho jaati hai to use 'canyon' kehte hain, isliye Grand Canyon ek bade gorge ka udaharan hai. Cliff khadi deewar hai (kinare wali), plunge pool jal-prapat ke niche ka gaddha, aur river bank nadi ka kinara. Exam point: gorge = nadi ka gehra aur tang kattav; aaj ke lambe gehre canyons ka sabse bada namuna Grand Canyon (Colorado nadi).

qe: Which type of 'Moraine' is found in the middle of a combined glacier?
qh: एक संयुक्त हिमनद के बीच में कौन सा 'हिमोढ़' (Moraine) पाया जाता है?
e: Medial moraine wo gaad (debris) ki dhaar hai jo har (har) mein - yani glacier ke beech (middle) mein - dikhti hai. Ye tab banti hai jab do valley glaciers ek doosri ghati mein milkar ek bada glacier ban jaate hain; dono ki lateral (kinare wali) moraines aapas mein mil kar beech mein aa jaati hain. Iske alawa terminal moraine glacier ke ant (snout) par, lateral kinaron par, aur ground moraine tal par faili hoti hai. Exam point: medial moraine = beech mein dhaar (do glacier ke milne ka pramaan) - combined glacier ke beech mile.

qe: What defines the 'Texture' of soil?
qh: मिट्टी के 'टेक्सचर' (Texture) को क्या परिभाषित करता है?
o: The size and proportions of sand, silt, and clay particles
e: Mitti ka texture (banaawat) uske kanon (particles) ke aakaar aur sand, silt tatha clay ke anupat (proportion) se tay hota hai. Sand ke kan sabse bade (2 mm se 0.05 mm), silt madhyam (0.05 se 0.002 mm) aur clay sabse chhote (0.002 mm se kam) hote hain. Clay ki matra zyada hone par mitti paani ko kas kar rok leti hai aur chipak (sticky) ho jaati hai; sandy mitti paani turant nichod (drain) deti hai; aur teenon ka santulit mel 'loam' sabse upjaau mitti maana jaata hai. Mitti ka rang, umar ya dhoop ka samay texture se alag cheezein hain. Exam point: soil texture = sand + silt + clay ka anupat aur unka aakaar (particle size) - isise mitti ki paani rokne ki khamta aur upjaau-ta tay hoti hai.

qe: A 'Hanging valley' is formed when:
qh: एक 'लटकती घाटी' (Hanging valley) तब बनती है जब:
o: A small tributary glacier joins a large main glacier valley
A river flows over a mountain
e: Hanging valley (latakti ghati) tab banti hai jab ek chhoti sahayak (tributary) glacier badi mukhya glacier ki ghati mein milta hai. Chhota glacier kam gehra kattav karta hai, isliye uski ghati ka tal bada glacier ki ghati ke tal se kahin upar (uncha) reh jaata hai; barf pighalne ke baad us chhoti ghati ka paani uncha se niche jal-prapat ki tarah girta hai. Isi karan Himalaya aur Alps mein aise jharnay milte hain. Jwalamukhi ka dhansav, hawa ka erosion ya nadi ka pahadi par behna isse alag hain. Exam point: hanging valley = glacier ki ghati ka uncha tal + jal-prapat (tributary glacier ka asar).

qe: The 'Geoid' shape implies Earth is bulged at the:
qh: 'जॉइड' (Geoid) आकार का तात्पर्य है कि पृथ्वी कहाँ उभरी हुई है?
e: Geoid ka matlab hai prithvi ka asli aakaar jo perfect gol nahi - ye equator par bahar ubha (bulging) hai. Iski wajah prithvi ka apne axis par ghoomna hai: ghoomne se apakendriya bal (centrifugal force) utpann hota hai jo equator ke kanon ko bahar ki taraf khinchta hai aur wahan ki chattaan ko ubhar deta hai; isliye equatorial radius (6378 km) polar radius (6357 km) se 21 km bada hai. Neeche ya top par ubhaar ka matlab gol parantu kone (edges) nahi hota. Exam point: geoid = equator par ubha (bulge) + poles par chapta (flattened) - rotation ka nateeja.

qe: What is 'Erosion' as defined by kinetic energy?
qh: गतिज ऊर्जा द्वारा परिभाषित 'अपरदन' क्या है?
o: Breaking and moving materials through geomorphic agents
e: 'Erosion' ko kinetic energy ke roop mein aise samjha ja sakta hai ki bhautik (geomorphic) agents (nadi, hawa, glacier, lehrein, bhumi-jal) apni gati ki urja se chattaan aur mitti ko tod-te (breaking) hain aur unhe utha kar door le jaate hain (moving). Isliye erosion = tootna + dhuank (transportation) dono kadam; waise hi erosion ke baad jamaav (deposition) hota hai. 'Pahad uncha karna' endogenic kaam hai, chattaan jamna (solidification) igneous ka, aur dono is varnan se alag hain. Exam point: erosion = kinetic energy se tootna + baha kar le jaana (breaking and removal) - weathering se alag.

qe: Which layer is the main source of magma for volcanoes?
qh: ज्वालामुखियों के लिए मैग्मा का मुख्य स्रोत कौन सी परत है?
e: Jwalamukhi (volcano) ke liye magma ka mukhya source Asthenosphere hai - upper mantle ka 100 se 350 km ki gehrai wala dheela (plastic) hissa. Yahan geedh (pressure) aur garmi ke karan chattaan thodi pighli hui (partially molten) rehti hai; jab dahak se garm stambh (mantle plume) upar aata hai ya plate dhansati hai, to ye magma banta hai, jama hota hai aur chattaan mein daraar se upar nikal kar jwalamukhi phata hain. Crust ke andar magma ki chhoti kothariyan (chambers) banti hain par asli source asthenosphere hai; inner core bahut gehra aur thos hai, aur hydrosphere paani ka kshetra hai. Exam point: jwalamukhi ka magma = asthenosphere (upper mantle) se - not from core.
